programme.desc: Jamie heads to Greece, to the island of Skopelos, starting on the mainland in Thessaloniki. Inspired by meze plates and traditional island cuisine he cooks up a smoky aubergine flatbread and a lemony chargrilled chicken with tzatziki and rice.

programme.title: Making Couscous in Tunisia
programme.desc: Jamie explores Tunisia to meet traditional couscous makers, eat delicious street food, and get invited to cook with local chefs on a beach. Inspired by everything he sees, Jamie cooks crispy prawn parcels and a chicken and merguez sausage stew.

programme.title: Inspirational Spanish Tapas
programme.desc: Jamie's soaking up inspiration in Spain with tapas, flavor-charged rice dishes, and spectacular seafood. He cooks a stunning pork chop with peppers and aioli and a surf and turf skewer of prawns, mushrooms, and local ham.

programme.title: Stunning Seafood of Marseille
programme.desc: Jamie heads to Marseille in the south of France. Inspired by their stunning seafood, the traditional flavors of Provence, and the multicultural dishes being served up there, he cooks up a steak with a twist and a sublime courgette and olive tart.

programme.title: The Compleat Al
programme.desc: A colorful reality marries an equally vivid imagination in a hilarious portrait of musician-satirist Alfred Matthew "Weird Al" Yankovic's personal life and career.

programme.title: The Bodyguard From Beijing
programme.desc: A bodyguard's assignment to safeguard a murder witness is complicated by the growing love between them.

programme.title: The Gambler V: Playing for Keeps
programme.desc: Cardsharp Brady Hawkes searches for his son, who is on the run with outlaws Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid.

programme.title: Murderball
programme.desc: This documentary introduces the U.S. quad rugby team -- a team composed entirely of young paraplegic men. Using special wheelchairs and very little protection, the players play full-contact competitive rugby, using rules only slightly altered to accommodate their limitations. The film follows the team as they discuss the sport, their lives, and how they ended up in their chairs to begin with, while they play their way to the 2004 Paralympic Games in Athens, Greece.

programme.title: Bloodfist II
programme.desc: The world kickboxing champion (Don "The Dragon" Wilson) retreats to Manila, lands in a mess and fights his way out.

programme.title: The Infiltrator
programme.desc: In 1986, federal agent Robert Mazur (Bryan Cranston) goes undercover to infiltrate the trafficking network of Colombian drug kingpin Pablo Escobar. Working with fellow agents Kathy Ertz (Diane Kruger) and Emir Abreu (John Leguizamo), Mazur poses as a slick, money-laundering businessman named Bob Musella. Gaining the confidence of Roberto Alcaino (Benjamin Bratt), Escobar's top lieutenant, Mazur must navigate a vicious criminal underworld where one wrong move could cost him everything.

programme.title: Itsy Bitsy
programme.desc: An ancient mysterious relic unleashes a giant prehistoric spider that terrorizes a single mother and her two children in their new house.

programme.title: Heathers
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: Castle Falls
programme.desc: After decades of neglect, Castle Heights Hospital is packed with dynamite and ready to be demolished. However, no one knows that a gang leader, now in prison, hid $3 million in stolen cash inside the abandoned building. Now, three desperate parties want the money -- and they have exactly 90 minutes to find it and get out alive.

programme.title: The Imposter
programme.desc: Filmmaker Bart Layton chronicles the tale of Frederic Bourdin, a con artist who seemingly tricked a Texas family into believing he was a relative who disappeared years earlier.

programme.title: Guardians
programme.desc: A team of former Soviet superheroes, assembled during the Cold War to combat a dangerous scientist, is dispatched against destructive robots.

programme.title: The Decline of Western Civilization Part III
programme.desc: In this documentary, filmmaker Penelope Spheeris captures the life of Los Angeles "gutter punks": homeless teenagers who prefer anarchy and chaos to organized society. Many of the film's subjects come from abusive households and have developed alcohol and drug problems. While living on the streets, they must panhandle, squat in abandoned apartment buildings and fight off skinheads to survive. The film also includes performances by several notable Los Angeles punk bands.

programme.title: Capricorn One
programme.desc: Three astronauts (James Brolin, Sam Waterston, O.J. Simpson) are about to launch into space on the first mission to Mars. But when a mechanical failure surfaces that would kill the three men, NASA removes them from the Capricorn One capsule. To prevent a public outcry, NASA launches the capsule unmanned and requires the astronauts to film fake mission footage in a studio. However, the plan is compromised when an ambitious journalist (Elliott Gould) discovers the conspiracy.

programme.title: Once Upon a Time in China
programme.desc: A man (Jet Li) must protect his martial-arts school while sorting out his feelings for a young woman (Biao Yuen) who is his aunt by adoption.

programme.title: Movie Movie
programme.desc: This spoof of 1930s American films features two movies and a trailer, with the same cast members acting in all three. "Dynamite Hands" follows an up-and-coming boxer (Harry Hamlin) with a heart of gold who stumbles into a life of excess when he falls for a nightclub singer (Trish Van Devere) and meets a sleazy gangster (Eli Wallach). In "Baxter's Beauties of 1933," a Broadway producer (George C. Scott) learns that he is dying and attempts to create one last hit show.

programme.title: Yakuza Wolf
programme.desc: A vengeful man goes after the Japanese yakuza for killing his father and must rescue his sister, who's been sold into slavery at an elite club.

programme.title: Going All the Way
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: The Company of Wolves
programme.desc: Wolves and werewolves lurk throughout the dreams of young Rosaleen (Sarah Patterson), who imagines that she must journey through a dark forest to live with her grandmother (Angela Lansbury). When Rosaleen meets a rugged hunter in the woods, she discovers that she has an animal-like attraction to him, leading to a macabre turn of events. The lupine-centric film also features stories within the main tale, told by both Rosaleen and her grandma, all of which have a supernatural bent.

programme.title: Lawnmower Man 2: Beyond Cyberspace
programme.desc: Jobe (Matt Frewer) exists as a malevolent consciousness in virtual reality and seeks to discover the technology to hack into all the world's computers. Jobe contacts Peter (Austin O'Brien), who had been a friend during his corporeal existence, to assist him, but the young man realizes Jobe's evil intent. Peter calls on Benjamin (Patrick Bergin), a brilliant computer engineer, to help thwart Jobe's scheme for world domination, and a battle rages throughout cyberspace and in the real world.

programme.title: Red Riding: 1983
programme.desc: Ten years after the body of a mutilated girl was found in Yorkshire, another young girl is missing. Lawyer John Piggott (Mark Addy) is asked to re-examine the conviction of a disabled man who confessed to the earlier murders and now claims he did so under intense police pressure. As Piggott looks into whether the Yorkshire police tortured their suspect, Detective Jobson (David Morrissey) starts to regret his brutal past and reveals a secret that casts the entire case in a new light.

programme.title: The Gunman
programme.desc: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.

programme.title: Aguirre: The Wrath of God
programme.desc: Don Lope de Aguirre (Klaus Kinski), a ruthless Spanish conquistador, vies for power while part of an expedition in Peru to find El Dorado, the mythical seven cities of gold. Accompanied by his daughter, Flores (Cecilia Rivera), Aguirre faces off against his superior, Don Pedro de Ursua (Ruy Guerra), and grows increasingly volatile after seizing control of the group. As Aguirre presses deeper into the Amazonian jungle, he descends further into madness.

programme.title: Operation Seawolf
programme.desc: During World War II, Germany looks to its last remaining weapons and soldiers to defeat the Allies. Led by Capt. Hans Kessler, a grizzled submarine commander, the German navy sends U-boats across the sea for a daring mission to attack the U.S. homeland. Meanwhile, the American military devises its own strategy to hunt down and destroy all enemy subs before they reach their target.

programme.title: Slacker
programme.desc: Austin, Texas, is an Eden for the young and unambitious, from the enthusiastically eccentric to the dangerously apathetic. Here, the nobly lazy can eschew responsibility in favor of nursing their esoteric obsessions. The locals include a backseat philosopher (Richard Linklater) who passionately expounds on his dream theories to a seemingly comatose cabbie (Rudy Basquez), a young woman who tries to hawk Madonna's Pap test to anyone who will listen and a kindly old anarchist looking for recruits.

programme.title: The Adventure Continues
programme.desc: Brady Hawkes, Billy Montana and Jeremiah Hawkes are on a train bound for a huge gambling event when the train is taken over by a gang of vicious killers in search of money.

programme.title: The Lawnmower Man
programme.desc: The eccentric Dr. Lawrence Angelo puts mentally disabled landscaper Jobe Smith on a regimen of experimental pills and computer-simulated training sequences in hopes of augmenting the man's intelligence. In time, Jobe becomes noticeably brighter and also begins to fare much better with the opposite sex. As he develops psychic powers, he realizes that those around him have taken advantage of his simplicity his whole life, and he plots a bloody revenge.

programme.title: Push
programme.desc: After his father, an assassin, is brutally murdered, Nick Gant vows revenge on Division, the covert government agency that dabbles in psychic warfare and experimental drugs. Hiding in Hong Kong's underworld, Nick assembles a band of rogue psychics dedicated to destroying Division. Together with Cassie, a teenage clairvoyant, Nick goes in search of a missing girl and a stolen suitcase that could be the key to accomplishing their mutual goal.

programme.title: Voyagers
programme.desc: With the future of the human race at stake, a group of young men and women -- bred for intelligence and obedience -- embark on an expedition to colonize a distant planet. When they uncover disturbing secrets about the mission, they defy their training and begin to explore their most primitive natures. As life on the ship descends into chaos, they soon become consumed by fear, lust and an insatiable hunger for power.

programme.title: The Darkest Hour
programme.desc: Young entrepreneurs Sean (Emile Hirsch) and Ben (Max Minghella) meet stranded travelers Natalie (Olivia Thirlby) and Anne (Rachael Taylor) at a hot Moscow nightclub. Their whole world changes in an instant when an alien attack devastates the city and everything goes dark. Joined by a Swedish businessman (Joel Kinnaman), the youths emerge from hiding days later and must somehow fight back against a nearly invisible enemy that could find and disintegrate them at any moment.

programme.title: Knowing
programme.desc: Fifty years after it was buried in a time capsule, a schoolgirl's cryptic document falls into the hands of Caleb Koestler, the son of professor John Koestler (Nicolas Cage). John figures out that the encoded message accurately lists every major disaster from the past five decades, and predicts three future calamities -- one a global cataclysm. When his warnings fall on deaf ears, John enlists the help of the prophetic author's daughter and granddaughter to try to avert the ultimate disaster.

programme.title: The Giver
programme.desc: Jonas (Brenton Thwaites) lives in a seemingly idyllic world of conformity and contentment. When he begins to spend time with The Giver (Jeff Bridges), an old man who is the sole keeper of the community's memories, Jonas discovers the dangerous truths of his community's secret past. Armed with the power of knowledge, Jonas realizes that he must escape from their world to protect himself and those he loves -- a challenge no one has ever completed successfully.

programme.title: Snowpiercer
programme.desc: A post-apocalyptic ice age forces humanity's last survivors aboard a globe-spanning supertrain. One man will risk everything to lead a revolt for control of the engine and the future of the world.

programme.title: Push
programme.desc: After his father, an assassin, is brutally murdered, Nick Gant vows revenge on Division, the covert government agency that dabbles in psychic warfare and experimental drugs. Hiding in Hong Kong's underworld, Nick assembles a band of rogue psychics dedicated to destroying Division. Together with Cassie, a teenage clairvoyant, Nick goes in search of a missing girl and a stolen suitcase that could be the key to accomplishing their mutual goal.

programme.title: Cash Out
programme.desc: Tempted by what could be his biggest score ever, professional thief Mason joins forces with his younger brother to rob a bank. However, when the heist goes awry, the thieves find themselves trapped inside, surrounded by SWAT teams, the FBI and Interpol. Things get even more tense when Mason eventually talks to the lead negotiator -- his former lover.

programme.title: Confidence
programme.desc: In this glossy neo-noir caper, expert grifter Jake Vig (Edward Burns) inadvertently crosses volatile crime boss the King (Dustin Hoffman) and, to make it right, he must agree to con banker Morgan Price (Robert Forster). He assembles his team, including Lily (Rachel Weisz) and Gordo (Paul Giamatti), but things get complicated fast with the arrival of Special Agent Gunther Butan (Andy Garcia), who has been tracking Jake for years. As the con goes down, Jake can't say who's double-crossing whom.

programme.title: Force of Nature
programme.desc: A policeman and a former cop battle a gang of thieves as they search for $55 million inside an evacuated building during a hurricane.

programme.title: Fortress
programme.desc: Robert is a former CIA agent who lives a life of tranquility at a secret resort in the woods. One day, his estranged son drives to the camp for a visit -- but he's followed by Robert's old nemesis, Balzary. As Balzary and his squad launch an all-out attack, father and son retreat to a high-tech bunker that has steel walls and advanced weapons.

programme.title: Inherit the Viper
programme.desc: For siblings Kip and Josie, dealing opioids isn't just their family business -- it's their only means of survival. When a deal goes fatally wrong, Kip decides he wants out for good. But his attempt to escape his family's legacy soon ignites a powder keg of violence and betrayal, endangering Kip, Josie and their younger brother.

programme.title: Life of Crime
programme.desc: Double-crosses and plot twists abound when a corrupt real-estate developer (Tim Robbins) decides not to pay a ransom to his wife's (Jennifer Aniston) kidnappers (John Hawkes, Yasiin Bey).

programme.title: Long Gone Heroes
programme.desc: Gunner is a special forces soldier who returns to the field of battle to save his kidnapped niece in South America. He and his team soon discover that her disappearance is part of a corrupt private operation that hits way too close to home.

programme.title: Marauders
programme.desc: FBI agents (Christopher Meloni, Dave Bautista) uncover a conspiracy while trying to nail a group of deadly bank robbers.

programme.title: No Escape
programme.desc: American businessman Jack Dwyer, wife Annie and their two young daughters arrive in Southeast Asia to begin a new life. As his company plans to improve the region's water quality, the family quickly learns that they're right in the middle of a political uprising. Armed rebels attack the hotel where they're staying, ordered to kill any foreigners that they encounter. Amid the chaos, Jack must find a way to save himself and his loved ones from the violence erupting all around them.

programme.title: Paradise City
programme.desc: Ryan Swan must carve his way through the Hawaiian crime world to wreak vengeance on the kingpin who murdered his father.

programme.title: Redemption
programme.desc: Joey, an alcoholic war veteran assumes a new identity after returning from a traumatic tour in Afghanistan and becomes a vigilante in a bid to atone for his sins.

programme.title: Trauma Center
programme.desc: Alone and trapped in a locked-down hospital isolation ward overnight, an injured young woman must escape a pair of vicious killers who are after the only piece of evidence that can implicate them in a grisly murder: the bullet in her leg.

programme.title: Secrets of Inner Earth
programme.desc: In the nearly 2,000-year-old text called "The Zohar," there is a curious passage that describes hidden realms beneath the surface of the Earth, each of which is said to be populated by both human and non-human intelligences.

programme.title: Cosmic Impacts
programme.desc: Meteor impacts have altered the world, creating the environment for the rise of humankind and delivering metals essential to an advanced civilization; evidence could reveal that celestial objects have been directed to Earth by alien intelligence.

programme.title: City of the Gods
programme.desc: Researchers suggest that the ancient site of Teotihuacan in central Mexico was once home to a highly advanced, perhaps extraterrestrial, civilization; excavations at Teotihuacan have unearthed discoveries out of place in the ancient world.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens on Location: Evidence of Alien Life
programme.desc: Following investigators across the globe as they go to the sites where signs of alien life have been found, Giorgio Tsoukalos takes a look back at incredible evidence that could offer definitive proof that humans are not alone in the universe.

programme.title: Aliens in Our Airspace
programme.desc: Terrifying encounters at 40,000 feet; pilot accounts of UFOs taking control of their aircraft; entire jumbo jets disappearing into thin air; since the dawn of aviation, pilots have experienced unexplainable events in the sky.

programme.title: Aliens and Robots
programme.desc: Robots are being programmed to do everything from performing surgery on humans, to investigating other planets; humanoid robots are quickly reaching a level of sophistication that was thought to exist only in science fiction.

programme.title: Alien Air Force
programme.desc: Since 2017, the Navy has been releasing photos and videos of unidentified aerial phenomena, and ancient astronaut theorists suggest the images are nearly identical to accounts from centuries ago.

programme.title: The Pharaoh's Curse
programme.desc: According to legend, a curse was placed on the tomb of King Tutankhamun; researchers theorize that the curse came about as the result of alien technology with the purpose of protecting the truth about an otherworldly event as well as an alien device.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens on Location: Evidence of Alien Life

programme.title: Aliens in Our Airspace

programme.title: Aliens and Robots

programme.title: Alien Air Force

programme.title: The Pharaoh's Curse

programme.title: The Disclosure Event
programme.desc: In 2021, the United States government broke a 70-year precedent of denying UFOs and released a groundbreaking report on Unidentified Aerial Phenomena.

programme.title: The Secrets of Stonehenge

programme.title: Merry Matrimony
programme.desc: Brie, an advertising executive, lands her dream assignment organizing the perfect Christmas wedding for a fashion magazine. If she succeeds, she could make partner at her firm. The only catch is that she unknowingly has been paired up witha high powered fashion photographer who also happens to be her estranged ex. Will they be able to pull off the campaign or will the past sabotage the project before it begins? Stars Jessica Lowndes and Christopher Russell.

programme.title: 'Tis the Season for Love
programme.desc: An out-of-work actress returns to her quaint hometown where a Christmas romance proves the life she once left behind could turn out to be even better than Broadway. Stars Sarah Lancaster, Brendan Penny and Gwynyth Walsh.

programme.title: A Nutcracker Christmas
programme.desc: A rising ballet star is ready to take the stage in her dream role when she receives the shocking news that her sister has died. Years later, she has vowed never to dance again, but a chance encounter with an old flame may change her mind.

programme.title: Karen Kingsbury's The Bridge Part 2
programme.desc: Based on Karen Kingsbury's bestselling novel, The Bridge, Molly and Ryan, college students from two different worlds, fell in love at Belmont University their freshman year. After unknowingly being manipulated to break up by Molly's controlling, media mogul father, they are reunited seven years later to save the bookstore that changed their lives. Stars Wyatt Nash, Katie Findlay, Faith Ford and Ted McGinley.

programme.title: Christmas in Conway
programme.desc: Hoping it will be the perfect Christmas present for his wife (Mary-Louise Parker), a man (Andy Garcia) plans to construct a Ferris wheel in his backyard.

programme.title: Our Italian Christmas Memories
programme.desc: When their mother leaves town for her first vacation in years, the Colucci siblings - Anna, Roberto, and Ella - reunite over the holidays to care for their beloved but ailing grandfather, Vincent. Anna is back in town for the first...

programme.title: The Wishing Tree
programme.desc: With guidance from a widowed professor (Jason Gedrick), a troubled teen (Richard Harmon) becomes a volunteer during the holidays.

programme.title: A Heavenly Christmas

programme.title: Christmas Everlasting
programme.desc: Christmas is fast approaching and years of long workdays employed at New York's top corporate law firm are about to pay off now that Lucy Toomey will be made partner after the New Year. However, when her older sister with special needs, Alice, unexpectedly passes away, Lucy dreads returning back to Nilson's Bay, Wisconsin to handle her sister's estate.

programme.title: Double Holiday
programme.desc: A young Jewish woman, who has always been responsible for planning and executing the office client Christmas celebration, takes her role very seriously. This year, though, she is determined to have a date. Making things more complicated...

programme.title: Karen Kingsbury's The Bridge
programme.desc: The sweeping tale of Molly Callens and Ryan Kelly, two young students who share a profound friendship their first semester in college. At their favorite bookstore and coffee shop, The Bridge, they spend countless hours studying and inspiring the other to dream their 10-year goal. They bond with the owners of The Bridge, Charlie (McGinley) and Donna Barton (Ford), a couple who designed the bookstore as a place where people can connect and be part of an extended family.

programme.title: A World Record Christmas
programme.desc: This Christmas Eve, the city of Brookswood is attempting to break a world record for wrapping the most Christmas presents in one hour. This gives Charlie, a local boy living with autism, an idea to break a world record of his own. He...

programme.title: Christmas in Conway
programme.desc: Hoping it will be the perfect Christmas present for his wife (Mary-Louise Parker), a man (Andy Garcia) plans to construct a Ferris wheel in his backyard.

programme.title: One Christmas Eve
programme.desc: A series of mishaps disturbs the plans of a recently divorced mom (Anne Heche) for her two kids on their first Christmas without dad.

programme.title: Enchanted Christmas
programme.desc: Interior designer Laura returns to Utah to spearhead the renovation of an old hotel in time for the annual Christmas Eve show run by Ricardo, her ex-boyfriend and dance partner. When Laura steps in to dance in the finale with Ricardo, she is pulled between her job, her family, and her reawakened feelings for Ricardo. Stars Alexa PenaVega, Carlos PenaVega.

programme.title: A Rose for Christmas
programme.desc: Andy is a passionate artist whose family has been building Rose Parade floats for generations. When her Dad gets sick, Andy is forced to take the helm and supervise the construction and decoration of their client's float. And to make...

programme.title: Tale of Two Hearts
programme.desc: Cassie's precious family heirloom - a beautiful red ruby, The Heart of Middleton - goes missing from the History of Halloween in Middleton museum exhibit just in time for the anniversary festival and masquerade gala.

programme.title: Wedding of Dreams
programme.desc: In the sequel to Summer of Dreams, it's been a year since Debbie's smash hit "Wonderland." Now living in a small town, she's found true love and left the music industry behind to teach kids the value of their own musical talents. But when her manager begins to pull her back into the limelight to celebrate the 20th anniversary of her first single, "Out of the Blue," Debbie has to decide which will come first Äì music or love?

programme.title: Christmas Song
programme.desc: Christmas time and the Carter and Cresswell High Schools were forced to merge due to budget cuts. Both music teachers, Ken Stoddard and Amy Dalton are concerned they may have to cut one of the music programs with one of them losing theirjob. Their fate is to be decided in a televised city-wide Christmas Carol Contest. Ken and Amy's budding romance becomes evident to the students and the kids worry that the contest outcome will drive a wedge between the couple.

programme.title: Looks Like Christmas
programme.desc: When two type-A single parents battle it out for control of the Christmas holiday at their kid's middle school, they get more than they bargained for when they learn a little something about the true meaning of Christmas, while opening themselves up for the possibility of a new romance. Stars Anne Heche and Dylan Neal.

programme.title: A Nutcracker Christmas
programme.desc: A rising ballet star is ready to take the stage in her dream role when she receives the shocking news that her sister has died. Years later, she has vowed never to dance again, but a chance encounter with an old flame may change her mind.

programme.title: Christmas at Cartwright's
programme.desc: Nicky is a single mom, unemployed and broke at Christmas and desperate to find a job in order to make her young daughter's holiday a happy one. With the aide of an angel, she gets a job as a department store Santa and also happens to...

programme.title: Poison in a Pear Tree - Part 1
programme.desc: Christmas shop owner Emily Lane uses secret skills to investigate a murder when a poisoned cookie links her to the crime. Detective Sam Wilner navigates the holidays with daughter Violet. Stars Sarah Drew and Peter Mooney.

programme.title: Home for the Holidays
programme.desc: Host Tamera Mowry-Housley greets ten family pairs of bakers at the holiday baking barn, where they first must prove themselves with pie, and then heat things up with some exquisite yule logs.

programme.title: USS Christmas
programme.desc: It's Christmastime in Norfolk, Virginia. Maddie Johnson is a reporter for the Norfolk Register who grew up in a military family. Maddie, her sister Lieutenant Amelia Breslan, and her mother Elizabeth are about to embark on a holiday...

programme.title: A Majestic Christmas
programme.desc: An architect returns to her hometown during the holidays to turn a historic playhouse into a modern multiplex, much to the town's objections.

programme.title: A Heavenly Christmas
programme.desc: From Hallmark Hall of Fame. Eve Morgan, a workaholic finds herself tethered to her guardian angel, Pearl, as she learns to become a Christmas angel in Heaven. Despite being the worst recruit in the history of Christmas, Eve is assigned...

programme.title: Cancel Christmas
programme.desc: Santa Claus discovers children have become too greedy and must prove otherwise if he doesn't want his favorite holiday canceled. His mission is to teach two incorrigible children the importance of charity. Enlisting their help to aid a handicapped boy inspires the magic of the holiday season, and the children's joy in giving ensures Christmas is going to be better than ever this year. Stars Judd Nelson and Natalie Brown.

programme.title: The Great Turkey Escape
programme.desc: Five teams of master cake and sugar artists create what happens when all the Thanksgiving turkeys decide to make a break for it.

programme.title: When Toys Come Alive
programme.desc: The five teams show the judges what happens when too much holiday magic happens and newly minted toys come alive, escape from their boxes and go crazy.

programme.title: Critter Christmas
programme.desc: The four remaining teams of cake and sugar artists must create the most bizarre visions of a Christmas party in the animal kingdom.

programme.title: North Pole Wedding
programme.desc: Raven-Symoné challenges the four remaining teams of master cake and sugar artists to imagine the most romantic wedding the world has ever seen at the North Pole; judges Shinmin Li and Erin Acevedo decide which team will go home with $25,000.

programme.title: Reindeer Auditions
programme.desc: In the first qualifying round, the three teams of cake and sugar artists must showcase an unlikely understudy who dreams of winning a spot to pull Santa's sleigh; two teams move on in the competition and the judges send one team home.

programme.title: A Cake-mas Carol
programme.desc: In the second qualifying round, three teams are challenged to showcase Charles Dickens' "A Christmas Carol" in a way the world has never seen before by completely reimagining the iconic ghost of Christmas past, present or future.

programme.title: Wild Thanksgiving
programme.desc: In the final qualifying round, three teams have to showcase how two animals that don't ordinarily get along can celebrate Thanksgiving together in the animal kingdom.

programme.title: The Ultimate Snowball Fight
programme.desc: With the qualifying rounds complete, six teams of masterful cake and sugar artists face off in a challenge to imagine the perfect way to win the ultimate snowball fight.

programme.title: Intergalactic Holidays
programme.desc: The five remaining teams of cake and sugar artists are challenged to imagine friendly aliens celebrating their own holidays on another planet; at the end of the face-off, the field of competition narrows with one team's elimination.

programme.title: Holiday Sing-Along
programme.desc: The four remaining teams of master cake and sugar artists are challenged to bring the story of a carol to life using their imagination, with cake.

programme.title: Merry Grinchmas!
programme.desc: In the penultimate battle, three teams of master cake and sugar artists bring Dr. Seuss' iconic "How the Grinch Stole Christmas" to life by re-imagining the world-famous story as a big-screen epic in a whole new movie genre.

programme.title: Santa's New Ride
programme.desc: With $25,000 and the title of Holiday Wars Champion at stake, the last two teams of cake and sugar artists must showcase the wildest, most powerful, modernization imaginable for Santa's new ride.

programme.title: Champion Cake Off
programme.desc: The reigning champions of "Halloween Wars" and "Holiday Wars" face off in a New Year's themed battle involving team mascots and champagne-inspired cakes; the winning team gets a trip to New York City for the biggest New Year's party in the world.

programme.title: Platform 9 3/4
programme.desc: The bakers create an edible 2-foot-tall showpiece with a magical effect.

programme.title: Gringotts Wizarding Bank
programme.desc: The teams are in Gringotts Wizarding Bank, where James and Oliver Phelps ask the bakers to create 3-foot showpieces inspired by the bank's main hall, tunnels and vaults.

programme.title: Diagon Alley
programme.desc: In a salute to the famed shops of Diagon Alley, hosts James and Oliver Phelps challenge the bakers to make 50 handheld desserts to feed a crowd of Harry Potter fans, who vote on a winner; judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef decide which team must go.

programme.title: The Forbidden Forest
programme.desc: James and Oliver Phelps host as pairs of professional bakers create edible showpieces on the actual Harry Potter film sets; guest actors from the films share behind the scenes experiences as they join judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef.

programme.title: Dumbledore's Office
programme.desc: James and Oliver Phelps ask bakers to create a four-foot-tall showpiece inspired by Albus Dumbledore's office items; Harry Potter alumna Bonnie Wright joins judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef to decide which teams advance to the final showdown.

programme.title: The Great Hall
programme.desc: Creating a showpiece that reaches at least 6 feet tall and commemorates at least one event that takes place in the Great Hall; the bakers must also include two culinary effects and incorporate at least two tasting elements; surprise guests arrive.

programme.title: The House Duels
programme.desc: James and Oliver Phelps assign eight pairs of pastry wizards into the four Hogwarts Houses and ask them to create a showpiece with at least one tasting element; Judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef decide which bakers move on to the next challenge.

programme.title: Wizard's Journey
programme.desc: In front of the Knight Bus, James and Oliver Phelps ask the remaining six teams to make transportation-inspired showpieces that incorporate classic English desserts; guest Devon Murray joins Judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef.

programme.title: The Edible Artifacts
programme.desc: Inspired by Polyjuice Potion, James and Oliver Phelps challenge the five remaining teams to recreate two items as hyperrealistic edible showpieces; judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef decide which team made the most convincing and delicious artifact.

programme.title: Up to No Good
programme.desc: Hosts James and Oliver Phelps challenge the baking teams to create supersized "Harry Potter" artifacts that reveal something from within; special guest Afshan Azad joins judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef.

programme.title: Magical Beasts, Beings, and Creatures
programme.desc: James and Oliver Phelps ask the remaining four baking teams to create showpieces that bring a Harry Potter creature to life, along with a bold smoky or spicy tasting element; special guest Warwick Davis joins judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef.

programme.title: The Goblet of Fire
programme.desc: For the finale in the Great Hall, James and Oliver Phelps ask the bakers to create showpieces celebrating the Goblet of Fire; guest judges Warwick Davis, Afshan Azad and Devon Murray join Carla Hall to award the Wizards of Baking trophy.

programme.title: Elf's Downhill Derby
programme.desc: Jeff Mauro welcomes three teams to the first qualifying round; the talented cake and sugar artists must create a derby car fit for Santa's elves; judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira decide who will move on and who heads home for the holidays.

programme.title: Hanging with Old St. Nick
programme.desc: Three new teams face off in the second qualifying round as Jeff Mauro challenges them to imagine how Santa spends time with his BFF; Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira send two more teams to the main competition and one group goes dashing home.

programme.title: Thanksgiving Turkey Trot
programme.desc: In the final qualifier, Jeff Mauro tasks three new teams with crafting a turkey and rider to race in the first annual Turkey Trot; Judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira decide whose Thanksgiving creations will move on and whose will not.

programme.title: Reindeer's New Hobby
programme.desc: The six remaining teams face off as Jeff challenges them to envision a hobby for Santa's reindeer to enjoy when they aren't pulling the sleigh; Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira judge the designs before flying one team home.

programme.title: Ugly Sweater Party
programme.desc: Jeff Mauro challenges the five remaining teams to create a woodland creature that is throwing an ugly sweater party for all its forest friends; at the end of the festive fiesta, judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira eliminate one more team.

programme.title: Time Travelin Santa
programme.desc: Jeff Mauro and the Holiday Wars time machine send the remaining four teams back in time; each group must create a Santa from a specific period in history; judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira decide who will move forward.

programme.title: A Very Peanuts Christmas Tree
programme.desc: Jeff Mauro invites the remaining teams to create a Christmas tree featuring Charles Schulz's beloved Peanuts characters; two teams will face off in the finale for a trip to Iceland.

programme.title: North Pole Talent Show
programme.desc: Santa throws a North Pole talent show and the final two teams showcase the secret talents of the town's brave residents; Jeff Mauro, Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira crown the champion.

programme.title: They're Called 'Classics' for a Reason
programme.desc: Chefs put their spin on Thanksgiving dinner; in the first round, they reinvent a classic side; they are asked to make an entire turkey dinner in just one hour and incorporate an ingredient from the very first Thanksgiving.

programme.title: Pies and a Leftovers Surprise
programme.desc: The four remaining chefs take Thanksgiving classics to new heights; in round one, the chefs turn sweet pies into a holiday side; the winner receives a huge advantage in round two during which the chefs take on everyone's leftovers.

programme.title: A Feast to Remember
programme.desc: The remaining three chefs are pushed to the limits of their creativity; in the first round, crucial kitchen equipment is off limits for competitors; in the final round, the last two chefs must make a full Thanksgiving meal in just three hours.

programme.title: Bang for Your Buck
programme.desc: Six of America's best chefs begin their journey to being crowned the Ultimate Thanksgiving Challenge Champion; host Giada De Laurentiis sets up their first challenge: transforming a low-cost item into an extraordinary Thanksgiving appetizer.

programme.title: Untraditional Thanksgiving
programme.desc: Giada asks the five competing chefs to put a Thanksgiving spin on a classic dish; the winner receives an advantage point.

programme.title: Thanksgiving Week
programme.desc: Giada De Laurentiis challenges the four remaining chefs to embrace Thanksgiving week by creating their version of Friendsgiving dinner; the chefs are also paired up to compete as a team using a nontraditional Thanksgiving protein.

programme.title: $25,000 Thanksgiving
programme.desc: Giada De Laurentiis challenges the three final chefs to make a dish that represents the person they're most thankful for, and they each have to incorporate a different type of squash.

programme.title: 'Tis the Season Open House
programme.desc: Autumn-inspired food, including chai chocolate truffles, white velvet soup, spicy cocktail puffs and jam cocktails.

programme.title: Classic Thanksgiving
programme.desc: Holiday dishes with a modern spin, including pumpkin Alfredo lasagna rolls, crispy truffled turkey and caramelized apple semifreddo cake.

programme.title: Friendsgiving Party
programme.desc: A cocktail-style Thanksgiving celebration with appetizer-sized versions of beloved holiday dishes, like stuffing arancini, turkey Waldorf bites, charred Brussels sprout crostini and a mulled cosmo cocktail.

programme.title: Santa's Grab Bag
programme.desc: Roasted fennel with Parmesan; creamy lobster pasta; chocolate almond cheesecake; citrus berry vermouth spritz.

programme.title: Holiday Desserts
programme.desc: Indulgent desserts and sparkling cocktails, including orange mousse with ginger snap crumble, peppermint patty sandwich cookies, hazelnut torte with chocolate espresso frosting and lemon hazelnut spritz cocktails.

programme.title: Kids' Gingerbread House Party
programme.desc: Giada treats her daughter Jade and friends to a party, where each guest makes their own gingerbread house; kid-friendly treats like s'mores popcorn, pizza grilled cheese, veggie forest with Parmesan ranch dip and frozen hot chocolate affogatos.

programme.title: Christmas at Giada's
programme.desc: Giada hosts a Christmas dinner for family and friends; on the menu, tortellini in Parmesan brodo, risotto with clams, braised lamb shanks with escarole and radicchio and a chocolate candy cane tower.

programme.title: Halloween Open House
programme.desc: Giada hosts a Halloween open house for neighborhood trick-or-treaters and their parents; Giada creates a spooky menu for her guests which includes Coconut Bones, Spooky Chicken Finger Sammies, Witches' Brooms and Here's Looking at Boo Treats.

programme.title: Happy Hour
programme.desc: Giada De Laurentiis hosts a fancy, vintage-inspired cocktail party and serves throwback recipes with a modern twist like bacon onion dip, a spiked gelatin mold and a Korean shrimp cocktail.

programme.title: Thanksgiving Feast
programme.desc: Giada De Laurentiis asks her Thanksgiving guests to each bring something to add to a large antipasti platter; spicy turkey breast cacciatore; smoky candied carrots and walnut gremolata; simple wilted greens; chocolate chunk hazelnut pie.

programme.title: Thanksgiving Brunch
programme.desc: The morning after Thanksgiving, Giada De Laurentiis feeds her guests with a brunch made from Thanksgiving leftovers; crispy turkey bites; cheesy root vegetable bake; sweet potato puffs; rye-spiked chai lattes.

programme.title: Christmas Sing-Along
programme.desc: Giada De Laurentiis throws a pre-Christmas party for the kids; holiday sing-along; cheesy chicken flautas; veggie voodle salad; chocolate-covered chips; apple pie soda à la mode.

programme.title: Christmas Dinner at Giada's
programme.desc: Giada De Laurentiis' family members exchange Secret Santa gifts; stuffed tricolore pork loin; roasted acorn squash agrodolce; chopped romaine and radicchio salad; black and white brownie ice cream cake.

programme.title: Chicken and Pie Party
programme.desc: One of Trisha Yearwood's favorite spots in Nashville is The Loveless Cafe; she spends the day putting a spin on her favorite dishes from the restaurant with recipes like cheesy angel biscuits and cornbread crusted fried pork chops.

programme.title: Giada's Turkey Day Feast
programme.desc: Giada has a step-by-step approach for planning and executing Thanksgiving; lemon and pea Alfredo; sweet and savory kale salad; prosciutto-wrapped turkey; for dessert, mascarpone cannoli cheesecake.

programme.title: That's a Wrap! Party
programme.desc: It's the day after Thanksgiving, and that usually means three things: college football, Christmas shopping and Thanksgiving leftovers; Giada marks the official start of the Christmas season with wrapping gifts and delicious food.

programme.title: Christmas Cocktails
programme.desc: A Christmas cocktail party and silly Santa gift exchange; holiday appetizers and favorite karaoke tunes; spinach artichoke panini bites; warm citrus marinated olives; chocolate coconut cake and burnt citrus cocktails.

programme.title: Santa's Cookies
programme.desc: Giada De Laurentiis and her daughter Jade host a Christmas party for Jade and her friends; Giada prepares a batch of holiday cutout sugar cookies that the kids can decorate using a variety of fun toppings and frosting.

programme.title: Night Before Christmas Party
programme.desc: In Italy, the night before Christmas is celebrated with the Feast of the Seven Fishes, and Giada De Laurentiis hosts a family Christmas Eve dinner that honors this tradition.

programme.title: Holiday Kick-Off Brunch
programme.desc: Giada De Laurentiis kicks off the season with a buffet brunch that features the flavors of autumn; bacon cranberry scones with citrus basil butter; sweet potato; kale Spanish frittata; smoked salmon waffles with waffle bar; apple raspberry sangrias.

programme.title: Giada's Italian Thanksgiving
programme.desc: A look back at some great game day and tailgating recipes; jalapeno-stuffed curly dogs, buffalo pierogies, baked chicken tenders with cheese cracker breading and no-bake rocky road bars.

programme.title: Small Bites Pot-Luck Party
programme.desc: Giada De Laurentiis hosts an open house and makes a variety of Italian-themed appetizers; goat cheese-stuffed baby peppers; crispy chicken meatballs; shrimp fra diavolo bites; chocolate Christmas tree brownies; a whiskey spritz cocktail.

programme.title: Name That Holiday Tune Party
programme.desc: Giada hosts a party where guests are asked to come dressed as their favorite holiday song; guests enjoy Giada's festive menu that includes a mozzarella bar, chicken piccata skewers, slow-roasted mustard salmon and a Sparkling Cosmo Punch.

programme.title: Winter Wonderland Party
programme.desc: Giada hosts a holiday party for kids and transforms the house into a winter wonderland; guests get to make their own snow globes and enjoy a menu of creamy tomato soup, triple chocolate hot cocoa, crispy chicken sandwiches and Italian flag cookies.

programme.title: Family Christmas Dinner

programme.title: Dear Deadly

programme.title: The Murder Channel

programme.title: Lost Biblical Treasures
programme.desc: The legendary Holy Grail, believed to be a relic of the Last Supper of Christ, has eluded searchers for 2,000 years and the quest continues today. Or has it actually been found as some claim and are its legendary powers real? Will scientists ever decipher the Copper Scroll found near the Dead Sea and learn the way to a 2,000 year old treasure?

programme.title: Biblical Women
programme.desc: Who was Mary Magdalene? A fallen woman rescued by Jesus or was she Christ's beloved disciple. An investigation into the mystery surrounding her identity produces startling insights. What message did the Virgin Mary bring to Fatima and reveal in 1917? A prophecy from biblical times? Learn the surprising answer.

programme.title: Early Years of Jesus
programme.desc: Even the Bible is silent about Jesus' life from the ages of 2 to 12 and 13 to 30. Will an investigation into these so-called silent early years reveal that Jesus was aware of His own divinity . . . even as a child? Why is the record of most of His life missing? Are the so-called silent early years of Jesus really lost? Or has the truth never been told? The answers you'll find here may surprise you!

programme.title: Noah's Ark and the Biblical Flood
programme.desc: Nearly 200 ancient cultures recorded an all-encompassing flood; all with astonishing parallels to the biblical flood account of Noah's Ark. Was there a deluge of such proportion that it covered the entire earth? Was the entire population of the earth wiped out but for a handful of people? Is the artifact on Mt. Ararat really Noah's Ark? Has modern technology finally answered these questions?

programme.title: Biblical Authors
programme.desc: The Bible is the most widely read book in the history of the world. But does anyone know who really wrote it? What are the facts behind this immortal manuscript? New scientific research and theological insight may provide new clues. What can the Dead Sea Scrolls tell us about the origins of the Bible? Discover how modern technology may finally unravel this age-old mystery.

programme.title: Biblical End Times
programme.desc: The Bible warns of cataclysmic disasters that will fulfill the End Time prophecy. Is it possible the ancients foresaw the wars, natural disasters and strife of the 21st Century? What about the prophecies of others from Nostradamus to Father Malachi O'Morgain? Are these warnings just stories from the ancient past or will we witness the End Times in our generation?

programme.title: The Shroud: Face to Face
programme.desc: Robert Orlando's documentary portrays Jesus' crucifixion as a transformative true crime story. It uses New Testament insights, expert interviews, and digital recreations to examine the Shroud of Turin. Bloodstains align with gospel accounts, suggesting authenticity. Orlando hopes to renew interest in Christian history.

programme.title: The Tomb of Jesus
programme.desc: The Real Discoveries team visit two tombs each believed to be the tombs where Jesus was laid to rest and later rose. However, Jesus could not have been laid and risen from both tombs. Is there any evidence to support the fact that either of these sites is the genuine one? Find out as we journey to discover the Tomb of Jesus!

programme.title: Third Day
programme.desc: On the third day after Jesus' crucifixion, eyewitnesses reported that they found an empty tomb and had an encounter with a living, breathing Jesus of Nazareth. What proof do we have that the resurrection really happened? This intriguing documentary digs deep into the biblical and historical accounts and explores these questions: Did the disciples steal the body?

programme.title: Prophecies of the Passion
programme.desc: Prophecies of the Passion is an extraordinary look at the Messianic prophecies fulfilled during the final week of Christ's life on earth. The Gospels clearly describe Jesus' betrayal, arrest, death, and resurrection. Remarkably, these events were foretold by Hebrew prophets-in specific detail... centuries before they actually occurred.

programme.title: John
programme.desc: John was called by Jesus from the shores of the Sea of Galilee to come and follow him. For 3 years he was one of the inner-band of disciples, witnessing the transfiguration. After the death of Jesus, he was first at the tomb to discover that Jesus had risen. He became leader of the church at Ephesus where he wrote the Gospel of John. In the mines of Patmos, he had a wonderful vision of God.

programme.title: Peter
programme.desc: The Galilean fishmonger, Peter, emerged as pre-eminent amongst the apostles. We look at his controversial life and career ending with his martyrdom in Rome and his place in laying the foundation of the Catholic Church.

programme.title: Tomb of Jesus: The Evidence
programme.desc: The Real Discoveries team visit two tombs each believed to be the tombs where Jesus was laid to rest and later rose. However, Jesus could not have been laid and risen from both tombs. Is there any evidence to support the fact that either of these sites is the genuine one? Find out as we journey to discover the Tomb of Jesus!

programme.title: Judas
programme.desc: Judas has been the symbol of evil and treachery but does he deserve this reputation? Why has he continued to fascinate writers, actors and artists? It is time to re-examine his role in the Jesus story and in the centuries that followed.

programme.title: Jesus' Silent Years: Where Was Jesus All Those Years?
programme.desc: The Bible is silent about Jesus' life from the ages of 2 to 12 and 13 to 30. Are these silent early years of Jesus really lost? The answers may surprise you!

programme.title: Jesus The Desire Of Ages
programme.desc: Jesus: The Desire of Ages tells the familiar story in a fresh way, through the eyes of those who knew and loved the Son of Man. An inspiring and triumphant music score combined with imaginative visual artistry will grip your heart as you experience the reality of Jesus' ultimate sacrifice.

programme.title: Charlton Heston Presents The Bible: Behind the Scenes
programme.desc: Never-before-seen documentary footage takes you on an amazing adventure behind the scenes, to see first-hand how this epic multi-national production was filmed on the very ground where it happened From the Creation to the Resurrection, Heston captures the passion of the Bible through the power of the spoken word, the way its mysteries and legends were originally passed down for generations.

programme.title: The Week That Changed The World
programme.desc: The resurrection happened. It's not just the belief of Christians, it's borne out by history, archaeology, and science. This documentary takes viewers step by step through the events of Holy Week-shedding light on the key players, unraveling the political intrigue, and answering long standing questions about what happened, and why. Professor of ancient history and world-renowned expert Dr. Paul L.

programme.title: Biblical Women
programme.desc: Who was Mary Magdalene? A fallen woman rescued by Jesus or was she Christ's beloved disciple. An investigation into the mystery surrounding her identity produces startling insights. What message did the Virgin Mary bring to Fatima and reveal in 1917? A prophecy from biblical times? Learn the surprising answer.

programme.title: Herod's Temple: The Temple Jesus Knew
programme.desc: Jerusalem, rich in historical and Biblical heritage, is the home of the Temple Mount, one of the world's most recognizable and visited sacred sites. Now, travel back in time to see it the way Jesus and his disciples did over 2,000 years ago. They knew it as Herod's Temple. We remember it as the Temple Jesus knew.

programme.title: The Passion
programme.desc: The tragedy and victory of the New Testament. Follow Jesus through the Last Supper, His betrayal by Judas in Gethsemane, His trial before Pilate and the crowds, His Crucifixion, and the joyful triumph of His Resurrection and Ascension. He is Risen.

programme.title: Path Of The Wind
programme.desc: As an ex-convict, Lee Ferguson's biggest desire is to leave his past behind and make a fresh start with Katie, his new love. But when Lee finds out Katie is a Christian, his pre-conceived ideas and her moral standards clash. Through engaging action and drama, this film explores temptation, sin, forgiveness and redemption, while helping seekers and believers understand one another!

programme.title: Mystery of the Shroud
programme.desc: In a tomb located in Jerusalem's Hell Valley, on land bought with Judas Iscariot's bloodstained silver, a sensational discovery was made. Vital information has been uncovered to paint a picture of what Jesus' grave would have looked like and what his burial process involved. One of the key moments in Christian history is made real and contemporary through this exciting archaeological discovery.

programme.title: I Believe In Easter
programme.desc: Learn how the church adapted and transformed pagan tradition into the celebration of the Resurrection. See how culture, emperors, apostles and popes have influenced how we celebrate Easter today.

programme.title: The Last Hours of Jesus Christ
programme.desc: From his arrest to his resurrection, a lot of questions still surround the last hours of Jesus' life. Recent discoveries and eXperts' analysis shed some light on this enigma. Did Jesus really dies on the cross? Follow this investigation on one of History's biggest mysteries.

programme.title: The Final 24 Hours of Jesus' Life
programme.desc: Seth explores the final 24 hours in the life of Jesus Christ.

programme.title: Jesus of Nazareth
programme.desc: The life, ministry and message of Jesus Christ. Here is the story of His humble birth in a Bethlehem manger, His baptism in the River Jordan and of His calling of the disciples. Witness Jesus' temptation in the wilderness, the Sermon on the Mount, the healing of the blind and many miracles.

programme.title: Mary Magdalene
programme.desc: From very early on, Mary was given the title 'Apostle of the Apostles'. We follow her career as a close follower of Jesus and, contrary to popular belief, show how she is a role model for the Christian life and a powerful feminist voice.

programme.title: James and Jude
programme.desc: James and Jude were the brothers of Jesus, who like Jesus, grew up in their father's carpenters shop in Nazareth. It was only after Jesus' death and resurrection that they became his followers, with James heading up the Jerusalem Church. Each of them wrote letters to the believers with James encouraging them to do good deeds as well as believe.

programme.title: Jesus
programme.desc: This production aims to stimulate interest on the part of a Biblically illiterate generation to want to know more about the Gospels and the extraordinary life, death, resurrection and meaning of Jesus.

programme.title: Biblical Women: Was Mary Magdalene a Saint or Sinner?
programme.desc: An investigation into the identity of Mary Magdalene, one the Bible's best known women, produces startling insights. Who was she? A fallen woman rescued by Jesus or Christ's beloved disciple?

programme.title: Jeremy's Egg
programme.desc: Twelve-year-old Jeremy is terminally ill and the only special-needs child in second grade. One day his teacher gives her students plastic eggs with the instructions to fill them with something that symbolizes Easter and new life.

programme.title: My Son My Savior
programme.desc: From the makers of the award winning biblical dramas, Road to Emmaus and Come Follow Me, comes My Son, My Savior, a powerful portrayal of the life of Jesus as seen through the eyes of his mother, Mary.

programme.title: Jesus' Birth: Is the Miracle to Christmas True?
programme.desc: Two thousand years ago Jesus Christ was born. Did He really exist? Experience the joy and wonder of those who witnessed the Christmas miracle - the birth of Jesus Christ.

programme.desc: In Christian theology the nativity marks the birth of Jesus in fulfillment of the divine will of God, to save the world from sin. John used baptism as the central symbol or sacrament of his messianic movement. John baptized Jesus.

programme.desc: In the first years, why did James, referred to as the 'brother of the Lord,' appear to be the veritable successor to Jesus? Did Jesus have brothers? Why do some of the Gospels proclaim the virginity of Mary, Jesus' mother? Why did his family believe that Jesus was 'crazy?' Were his mother and his brother opposed to the group of twelve disciples?

programme.desc: Howard (Alan Ruck) and Joanne (Catherine Mary Stewart) are happily expecting their first child. They live in a world where genetic alteration is rampantly purchased on the black market...but nothing comes without a price in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: I Hear You Calling
programme.desc: After intercepting a strange phone call, a tenacious reporter (Ally Sheedy) finds herself in a deadly game of cat and mouse. The only clues to the mystery: a strange man with violet eyes and missing persons who leave behind a pile of purple ash.

programme.title: Mind Over Matter
programme.desc: When an accident puts Dr. Stein's (Mark Hamill) colleague, Rachel, in a coma, he uses his newly-created invention to reach her brain and tell her he loves her. However, Stein discovers that love takes strange turns when it enters the virtual world.

programme.title: Beyond The Veil
programme.desc: After flashbacks of an alien abduction lead him to attempt suicide, Eddie Wexler (Michael O'Keefe) is institutionalized, with a doctor who seems intent on forcing him to relive his "memories." Is Eddie insane? Or is the doctor more than he seems?

programme.title: First Anniversary
programme.desc: As he celebrates his first anniversary, Norman (Matt Frewer) thinks he's the luckiest man alive. But suddenly, his lovely wife doesn't seem the same and he can't stand to be around her. Is he going crazy or are his instincts telling him something?

programme.title: Straight And Narrow
programme.desc: Problem child Rusty (Ryan Phillippe) finds himself thrown into a private school bent on straightening him out with some unorthodox methods. Rusty has eluded their control so far, but can he escape from this prison of the mind?

programme.title: Trial By Fire
programme.desc: On the first day of his presidency, Charles Halsey (Robert Foxworth) is faced with the first galactic foreign policy decision. As aliens are approaching Earth, the peace-loving president must determine if they are invaders or benevolent explorers.

programme.title: Worlds Apart
programme.desc: In a bizarre twist of fate, Nancy McDonald (Bonnie Bedelia) receives a distress call from Lindy (Chad Willett), a former lover, who was lost in space twenty years earlier. And he has a message: He's alive...and he desperately needs her help.

programme.title: The Refuge
programme.desc: A man (James Wilder) finds himself in what seems to be a refuge in a post-apocalyptic world, lorded over by a sadistic industrialist (M. Emmet Walsh) who pits his guests against one another for enjoyment...but all is not what it seems to be.

programme.title: Inconstant Moon
programme.desc: When a lonely physics professor Stanley Hurst (Michael Gross) realizes the sun is going to burn out, he knows that he and humanity have only a few hours to live. In that time, Stan resolves to make up for lost years.

programme.title: From Within
programme.desc: Howie (Neil Patrick Harris), a boy with intellectual disabilities, is the last unaffected person in a town overrun by a strange, parasitic madness. On his own for the first time, Howie has only himself to rely upon if he wants to save his sister!

programme.title: The Heist
programme.desc: After a friend's betrayal cost him his Army career, Lee Taylor (Costas Mandylor) helps a self-styled militia Major hijack an Army shipment. Expecting missiles, they find a mysterious cargo and a lone Army Guard who warns of its deadly capability.

programme.title: Afterlife
programme.desc: Convicted of a murder he didn't commit, Linden Stiles can either accept execution or become the subject of a military experiment. Choosing to live, he finds himself slowly dehumanized by the alien DNA that has been injected into him.

programme.title: The Deprogrammers
programme.desc: With Earth under alien rule, humanity has been programmed into slavery. A band of rebels kidnap Evan (Erich Anderson), one of the alien leader's slaves. After a twist of fate, Evan agrees to assassinate his former master...with devastating results.

programme.title: Paradise
programme.desc: When three young women age and die within hours, a small town is turned upside down. How does Helen (Maxine Miller), a doctor's aging mother, play into these deaths? The answer to the puzzling mystery of fragile youth is soon to be revealed.

programme.title: The Light Brigade
programme.desc: On a desperate mission to survive, a young military cadet (Will Wheaton) learns the difference between heroic ideals and the bitter realities of war as he and his dying comrades prepare a strike against the aliens who may have condemn them to death.

programme.title: Out Of Body
programme.desc: What really happens during an out-of-body experience? Scientist Rebecca (Peri Gilpin) is so desperate to find out that she decides run an experiment on herself. But not everyone is happy of the lengths science will go to for empirical proof.

programme.title: The Sentence
programme.desc: Inventor Dr. Jack Henson (David Hyde Pierce) comes up with a "virtual prison" where criminals serve a life sentence in just a few, cost-efficient hours. When an innocent man's life is at stake, the doctor must submit himself to his own invention.

programme.title: Bits Of Love
programme.desc: In a post-apocalyptic underground bunker, a virtual reality world begins to turn on its inventor (Jon Tenney) after he becomes romantically involved with -- and then spurns -- the holographic interface (Natasha Henstridge) that controls the system.

programme.title: Second Thoughts
programme.desc: A mentally challenged man (Howie Mandel) is made more intelligent by a machine that transfers people's memories and experiences into his head, but kills its victims. And he soon discovers that the mind can be a minefield in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Re-Generation
programme.desc: After a couple's son dies, an experimental procedure harvests the boy's nerve cells, allowing the mother to give birth to a genetically identical child. But soon it becomes clear that this fetus is not just identical...it is actually Justin himself.

programme.title: Last Supper
programme.desc: A man's family is turned upside down when he discovers that his son's college sweetheart is the same woman he rescued from a secret military experiment twenty years before...only she has not aged a day since. Peter Onorati and Fred Savage star.

programme.title: Stream Of Consciousness
programme.desc: When "the Stream" -- an artificial system providing information to all society members through computer chips implanted in their brains -- begins to malfunction, an unlikely, "primitive" man (George Newbern) may be the mankind's only hope.

programme.title: Dark Rain
programme.desc: After a chemical war renders the world's population unable to conceive healthy children, a mother and father must escape from a sinister government agency intent on using their miraculously healthy newborn to repopulate the species.

programme.title: The Camp
programme.desc: In a society imprisoned for generations by extraterrestrial who invaded Earth, an electronics expert (Harley Jane Kozak) discovers that not only are her human jailers really machines, but they also have been holding prisoners for nearly a century.

programme.title: Heart's Desire
programme.desc: A preacher descends upon the 18th century town of Heart's Desire and offers to share his extraordinary powers with four outlaws. But who is this stranger and why has he given these outlaws such deadly powers? Caspar Van Dien and Esai Morales star.

programme.title: Tempests
programme.desc: Attempting to deliver serum to a plague-stricken planet, a pilot (Eric McCormack) and his crew crash land on an unknown moon. Bitten by an alien spider while fixing the ship, the pilot's mind wanders between alternate realities...in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: The Awakening
programme.desc: A woman unable to feel emotions gets a new lease on life when a brain implant allows her to experience feelings for the first time. But, when the implant malfunctions, driving her towards insanity, she is shocked at the real cause of her problems.

programme.title: New Lease
programme.desc: A remorseless, uncaring scientist (Stephen Lang) and his partner (Michael Ontkean) discover a way to bring life back to the recently deceased. But after the scientist is killed and brought back to life himself, will he choose to live differently?

programme.title: Double Helix
programme.desc: Brilliant geneticist Martin Nodel (Ron Rifkin) unlocks a secret code imprinted on human DNA. But when he tests this code on himself, his "instincts" draw him to a remote location where he finds a trip...to The Outer Limits. Ryan Reynolds co-stars.

programme.title: Dead Man's Switch
programme.desc: When it is not known if aliens headed to Earth are friend or foe, five people are placed in secret bunkers to man switches that, if not pressed at specified intervals, will set off mass destruction that will destroy everything, alien or human alike.

programme.title: Hearts And Minds
programme.desc: Engaged as soldiers on a distant planet to prevent a race of alien bugs from stealing minerals that provide the Earth's energy, a woman (Christine Elise) and her troops accidentally discover that the real enemy may not be the aliens at all.

programme.title: Music Of The Spheres
programme.desc: When a seemingly harmless audio signal from space causes physiological changes in Earth's youth, a young scientist races against time to discover what exactly is happening and why. Could the changes be necessary for the survival of the planet?

programme.title: In Another Life
programme.desc: A despondent man finds himself torn between killing himself and killing his co-workers. Before he can do either, he's pulled into The Outer Limits where there are hundreds of versions of him, each with a different life and a different character.

programme.title: The Revelations Of 'Becka Paulson
programme.desc: A woman's life changes dramatically when she accidentally shoots herself in the head which causes her to not only grow more intelligent, but also to realize how dull her life was before the photo in a picture frame started talking to her.

programme.title: Bodies Of Evidence
programme.desc: When an incident at a space station leaves three people dead, the captain of the ship returns to Earth to face murder charges. Is the captain a murderous madman? Or has he actually seen the face of evil floating in the zero-gravity of deep space?

programme.title: Feasibility Study
programme.desc: The residents of a suburban neighborhood have their lives turned upside down when a four block section of their subdivision is ripped from the earth by a mysterious force and transported to a distant planet. David McCallum and Laura Harris star.

programme.title: A Special Edition
programme.desc: Muckraking TV journalist Donald Rivers (Alan Thicke), host of "The Whole Truth," has the show of a lifetime: rock solid-proof that the government and private defense contractors have been engaging in secret genetic cloning.

programme.title: In The Zone
programme.desc: Using an experimental treatment, a scientist (Pat Morita) helps an aging athlete (Adrian Pasdar) end his career on a high note by accelerating his reflexes for one last match. But with victory comes side-effects...courtesy of The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Rite Of Passage
programme.desc: In a society controlled by aliens, a mother rebels when she is forced to give up her child to Mother, a wise alien who acts as a parent to all infants. Determined to get the child back, she embarks upon a dangerous quest that will change her world.

programme.title: Criminal Nature
programme.desc: When Genetic Engineering creates super-babies, some suffer from Genetic Rejection Syndrome (GRS), making them stronger and more deadly. A detective (Gary Cole) must stop his GRS son, a suspected killer, but must take a serum to become more like him.

programme.title: The Hunt
programme.desc: Hunters pay to hunt androids that have a chip that keeps them from harming humans. However, secretly planted data allows the androids to disable the chip, and the balance of power shifts between men and machines! Starring Ron White and Doug Savant.

programme.title: Relativity Theory
programme.desc: Xenobiologist Teresa Janovitch (Melissa Gilbert) is on a military team searching an uninhabited planet for minerals. When the team is attacked by aliens and a retaliation is successful, Janovitch makes a shocking discovery about the victims.

programme.title: Josh
programme.desc: Reporter Judy Warren (Kate Vernon) tracks down Josh (Alex McArthur), a recluse who performs miracles. Alien or angel? All that Judy knows is that now the military is involved and she doesn't trust them. If she can help Josh, will she find the truth?

programme.title: Glyphic
programme.desc: A medical specialist (Peter Flemming) examines a case involving an epidemic that killed a number of children in a small town. Through hypnosis, he probes the mind of a surviving child (Rachel Leigh Cook) and unravels a memory of "alien" proportions.

programme.title: Identity Crisis
programme.desc: As part of a top-secret program, the brain content of a military Captain (Lou Diamond Phillips) is temporarily transferred to an android to create a superior soldier. But, when things go wrong, can the transfer be reversed? Also starring Robert Joy.

programme.title: The Vaccine
programme.desc: A group of hospital patients and their nurse, Marie Alexander (Maria Conchita Alonso), survive a global, terrorist bio-attack. A vaccine arrives, but there are only three doses. Who will be chosen? Will it be survival of the fittest?

programme.title: Fear Itself
programme.desc: Bernard (Ayre Gross) is haunted by images from his past and the tragic death of his sister...a death he caused. An experimental treatment brings positive results, but also a dangerous side effect: Bernard can now transfer his fear to others!

programme.title: The Joining
programme.desc: When a transport ship Captain (C. Thomas Howell) is rescued after surviving a devastating crash on Venus, strange things begin to happen when he returns to Earth. He did what it took to survive on Venus, but could the price of survival be too high?

programme.title: To Tell The Truth
programme.desc: A scientist (Gregory Harrison) in a colony on another planet urges evacuation when he discovers that a radioactive star will soon pass over. He has been wrong before, though, and at great cost. Will the truth be accepted in time to save the colony?

programme.title: Mary 25
programme.desc: Charlie Bouton (Tom Butler) and Melburn Ross (Michael Shanks) create Mary 25, a nanny robot. When Bouton falls in love with Mary and mistreats his wife, a woman whom Ross once loved, the lines between human and machine become dangerously blurred.

programme.title: Final Exam
programme.desc: A negotiator (Brett Cullen) tries to find out why a grad student (Peter Stebbings) is threatening to detonate a deadly, self-made bomb, unless the government kills five people for him. Why those five people? Is it revenge? And can he be stopped?

programme.title: Monster
programme.desc: Four telekinetic people are recruited by the CIA, who hopes to use their talents to assassinate a war criminal. Their powers produce unexpected side-effects; however, and the killers may soon find that they are the prey. Robert Guillaume stars.

programme.title: The Origin Of Species
programme.desc: When Dr. Nodel (Ron Rifkin) is joined on an alien ship by a small group of students to communicate with aliens, it appears that they've all been led into a trap. Have the aliens led them astray? Ryan Reynolds also stars. Sequel to "Double Helix"

programme.title: Nightmare
programme.desc: A battle cruiser is captured by the enemy Ebonites on planet N-1-8-4. Imprisoned, the crew is interrogated by The Voice, an unseen Ebonite. Who will be the first to snap? And what will happen then? Starring Maurice Dean Wint and Steven Bauer.
