programme.title: The Cold Light of Day
programme.desc: Young business consultant Will Shaw (Henry Cavill) flies to Spain for a vacation aboard his family's sailboat. When Will returns from some on-shore shopping, his family is gone and will be killed if he does not deliver a missing briefcase within 24 hours. As it turns out, his father (Sigourney Weaver) is not a cultural attaché but a spy, and Will is in over his head. He must find a way to turn the tables on his enemies, or he and his family will all die.

programme.title: Extortion
programme.desc: A family stranded on an island in the Bahamas believe it is being rescued by two fishermen but come to realize it is being held hostage until it hands over $1 million.

programme.title: The Next Three Days
programme.desc: Life for John and Lara Brennan (Russell Crowe, Elizabeth Banks) is miserable after she is convicted of a murder she says she did not commit. Three years later while struggling with the demands of work and raising his son alone, John is still trying to establish her innocence. When her final appeal is rejected, Lara becomes suicidal, forcing John to exercise the only option he has left: Break her out of prison.
A desperate man takes part in an underworld game of Russian roulette in which gamblers place bets on who will survive.

programme.title: Mechanic: Resurrection
programme.desc: Living undercover in Brazil, master assassin Arthur Bishop (Jason Statham) springs back into action after an old enemy (Sam Hazeldine) kidnaps the woman (Jessica Alba) he loves. To save her life, Bishop must kill an imprisoned African warlord, a human trafficker (Toby Eddington) and an arms dealer (Tommy Lee Jones), all while making the deaths look like accidents. When things don't go exactly as planned, Bishop turns the tables on the people who forced him out of retirement.

programme.title: The Bank Job
programme.desc: A recently released convict and his criminally inclined best friend execute a daring daytime bank robbery.

programme.title: War on Everyone
programme.desc: Two corrupt cops, who make money blackmailing criminals, come up against one who may be far more dangerous than both of them.

programme.title: Traitor
programme.desc: When straight-arrow agent Roy Clayton (Guy Pearce) assumes command of a special FBI task force, he becomes entangled in a web of covert operations. All the clues in Clayton's investigation point to Samir Horn (Don Cheadle), a former Special Ops soldier who now aids terrorists. But as Clayton digs deeper and contradictory evidence begins to emerge, he begins to question Horn's motives.

programme.title: Raw Deal
programme.desc: When efforts to prosecute mob boss Luigi Patrovita are repeatedly derailed thanks to a mole in the FBI, the only choice is to bring in an outsider -- specifically, Mark Kaminsky, a disgraced agent who leaps at a chance for reinstatement. After FBI chief Shannon gives him his orders, Kaminsky fakes his death and reemerges as an ex-con named Brenner. Undercover and accountable to no one, the former Fed tears up the mob from the inside.

programme.title: The Way of the Gun
programme.desc: They make no excuses. They don't ask forgiveness. Their story is without compromise, brutal and simple. For contemporary desperados Parker and associate Longbaugh, crime means survival at any cost. Their impromptu plan to kidnap surrogate mother Robin, just weeks from delivering the son of Hale and Francesca Chidduck, seems to be a fast way to cash in on a fat ransom and head for the border. But their haste does indeed make waste.

programme.title: Catch .44
programme.desc: The plan of three women (Malin Akerman, Nikki Reed, Deborah Ann Woll) to intercept a drug shipment for their boss (Bruce Willis) goes horribly wrong.

programme.title: War on Everyone
programme.desc: Two corrupt cops, who make money blackmailing criminals, come up against one who may be far more dangerous than both of them.

programme.title: Traitor
programme.desc: When straight-arrow agent Roy Clayton (Guy Pearce) assumes command of a special FBI task force, he becomes entangled in a web of covert operations. All the clues in Clayton's investigation point to Samir Horn (Don Cheadle), a former Special Ops soldier who now aids terrorists. But as Clayton digs deeper and contradictory evidence begins to emerge, he begins to question Horn's motives.

Their impromptu plan to kidnap surrogate mother Robin, just weeks from delivering the son of Hale and Francesca Chidduck, seems to be a fast way to cash in on a fat ransom and head for the border. But their haste does indeed make waste.

programme.title: Catch .44
programme.desc: The plan of three women (Malin Akerman, Nikki Reed, Deborah Ann Woll) to intercept a drug shipment for their boss (Bruce Willis) goes horribly wrong.

programme.title: Killing Them Softly
programme.desc: When rival crook Johnny Amato (Vincent Curatola) hatches a plan to rob a card game run by mob lackey Markie (Ray Liotta), he picks a low-rent thug named Frankie (Scoot McNairy) to do the job. Frankie picks a less-than-ideal partner (Ben Mendelsohn) to help him, but despite their combined incompetence, they manage to make off with the mob's money. In retaliation, Markie's bosses hire Jackie Cogan (Brad Pitt), a mob enforcer, to eradicate those responsible.

programme.title: Dig
programme.desc: Held hostage by a dangerous couple, a widower and his daughter must work together to outsmart their captors and survive the night.

programme.title: The Hunger Games
programme.desc: In what was once North America, the Capitol of Panem maintains its hold on its 12 districts by forcing them each to select a boy and a girl, called Tributes, to compete in a nationally televised event called the Hunger Games. Every citizen must watch as the youths fight to the death until only one remains. District 12 Tribute Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) has little to rely on, other than her hunting skills and sharp instincts, in an arena where she must weigh survival against love.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: After arriving safely home from their unprecedented victory in the 74th Annual Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) discover that they must do a quick turnaround and begin a Victors Tour. As she and Peeta travel throughout the districts, Katniss senses a rebellion is stirring. However, President Snow (Donald Sutherland) proves that he is still very much in control when word comes of a cruel change in the rules for the upcoming 75th Hunger Games.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 1
programme.desc: Following her rescue from the devastating Quarter Quell, Katniss (Jennifer Lawrence) awakes in the complex beneath the supposedly destroyed District 13. Her home, District 12, has been reduced to rubble, and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) is now the brainwashed captive of President Snow (Donald Sutherland). At the same time, Katniss also learns about a secret rebellion spreading throughout all of Panem -- a rebellion that will place her at the center of a plot to turn the tables on Snow.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 2
programme.desc: Realizing the stakes are no longer just for survival, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) teams up with her closest friends, including Peeta (Josh Hutcherson), Gale (Liam Hemsworth) and Finnick for the ultimate mission. Together, they leave District 13 to liberate the citizens of war-torn Panem and assassinate President Snow, who's obsessed with destroying Katniss. What lies ahead are mortal traps, dangerous enemies and moral choices that will ultimately determine the future of millions.

programme.title: The Hunger Games
programme.desc: In what was once North America, the Capitol of Panem maintains its hold on its 12 districts by forcing them each to select a boy and a girl, called Tributes, to compete in a nationally televised event called the Hunger Games. Every citizen must watch as the youths fight to the death until only one remains. District 12 Tribute Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) has little to rely on, other than her hunting skills and sharp instincts, in an arena where she must weigh survival against love.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: After arriving safely home from their unprecedented victory in the 74th Annual Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) discover that they must do a quick turnaround and begin a Victors Tour. As she and Peeta travel throughout the districts, Katniss senses a rebellion is stirring. However, President Snow (Donald Sutherland) proves that he is still very much in control when word comes of a cruel change in the rules for the upcoming 75th Hunger Games.

programme.title: Fez, Morocco
programme.desc: Andrew discovers Morocco's culinary fare, from lambs head to pigeon pie.

programme.title: Sardinia
programme.desc: Andrew is back for another exotic food adventure, this time in Sardinia.

programme.title: Montreal
programme.desc: Andrew heads up north for a taste of the joie de vivre in Montreal.

programme.title: Jamaica
programme.desc: Andrew tries unique dishes that combine island flavors with African traditions.

programme.title: Mexico City: Corn Smut & Ants
programme.desc: Andrew travels to Mexico City and eats stewed pig knuckles in one of the city's most notorious barrios; he feasts on worms and ant eggs in the desert outside the metropolis.

programme.title: Lisbon: Snails and Sardines
programme.desc: Crashing surf to harvest barnacles from the rocky shore; feasting on mounds of mollusks at a huge snail festival; making the world's best canned fish.

programme.title: Ireland: Ancient Bog Butter
programme.desc: Ultimate smoked salmon; pigeon with bog oak; 3 thousand-year-old butter.

programme.title: Brooklyn
programme.desc: Andrew feasts on sea robins, bacteria candy, and spleen sandwiches.

programme.title: Newfoundland
programme.desc: Fried cod cheek and tongues; moose pie; chicken fried seal flipper.

programme.title: Faroe Islands: Spoiled Sheep
programme.desc: Andrew goes to the Faroe Islands for sheep's head and boiled seagulls.

programme.title: Spleen Soup and Sriracha
programme.desc: Fried fish fins; honey from Africanized bees; the country's hottest sauce.

programme.title: Eyeballs and Abalone
programme.desc: Andrew travels to Hawaii's Big Island, where he pulls fresh water prawns straight out of hidden streams; he feasts on tuna eyeballs at the local grocery store.

programme.title: Kazakhstan
programme.desc: Hunting for rabbits with a golden eagle; a blow while milking a horse; sheep brains to fermented camel milk and smoked horse sausage.

programme.title: Taipei
programme.desc: Andrew visits Taipei, Taiwan and faces down stinky tofu in a mountainside factory, learns the secret to turning eggs into hard-as-iron street food, and masters pulling the longest and strongest noodles.

programme.title: Rome
programme.desc: In Rome, Andrew feasts on lamb brains, river eels and a stuffed pig.

programme.title: Dubai
programme.desc: Milking camels, fermenting fish in the desert sun, making musical organ meat mush and manna from heaven.

programme.title: Panama
programme.desc: Chicken foot souse; iguana meat and eggs; beef lung; aphrodisiac smoothies; Chinese-Panamanian kosher cheese.

programme.title: Ho Chi Minh City
programme.desc: Andrew travels to Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam and while hitting the city streets at night, he feasts on sucking snails and duck tongues and on the outskirts of town he hunts for rice field rats, and gets a taste of farm-raised porcupine.

programme.title: Peruvian Amazon
programme.desc: Wrestling giant paiche fish; grilled coconut grubs and smoked jungle rodents; giant biting ants with a shaman.

programme.title: San Antonio
programme.desc: Andrew heads to San Antonio for cow heads, calf balls and raw quail egg.

programme.title: Guatemala
programme.desc: Fresh bull testicle ceviche and possum Sunday dinner in Guatemala where ancient flavors are still alive.

programme.title: Croatia's Dalmatian Coast
programme.desc: Ancient tastes in Croatia like roasted dormice and giant offal kebabs to baked rooster and grilled frog.

programme.title: Paris Reborn: Cow Heads, Caves
programme.desc: Mushrooms harvested in underground caves; brined ham delivered to the presidential palace; aging artisanal French cheese.

programme.title: Philadelphia
programme.desc: Cheese-steak and shad cake to turkey neck and pig liver in Philadelphia where pride brings good food.

programme.title: Oaxaca
programme.desc: Winged ants, grilled intestines, grasshoppers and dried beef hearts enjoyed in Mexico's culinary capital.

programme.title: Amsterdam
programme.desc: Unique re-inventions of traditional Dutch recipes in Amsterdam from goose croquettes to insect-filled nuggets to smoked local eel and hollow pig head.

programme.title: Kansas City Snoots and Spleens
programme.desc: Andrew tours Kansas City for pig snoots, backyard woodchuck and BBQ.

programme.title: Jerusalem
programme.desc: Andrew travels to Jerusalem for tastes older than the city itself; he tries cow udder, veal brain, turkey balls and mullet roe.

programme.title: Madrid
programme.desc: Andrew visits Madrid for pig heads, organ omelets and duck liver jewelry.

programme.title: Senegal
programme.desc: Andrew harvests ancient sea salt, roasts a sheep's head and fishes the wild waters in Senegal's West African culture.

programme.title: North Carolina
programme.desc: Andrew tastes pig appendix and raw turtle testicle; hunting feral hogs and brewing ancestral pot likker.

programme.title: The Bronx
programme.desc: In the Bronx, Andrew tries coyote and raw clams from Long Island Sound.

programme.title: Okinawa
programme.desc: Andrew visits Okinawa, Japan, to taste poisonous pufferfish and raw goat.

programme.title: Shanghai
programme.desc: Andrew goes to Shanghai for softshell turtle, snail shells and live snake.

programme.title: Stockholm
programme.desc: Putrefied herring; smoked sperm; reindeer testicle; aged horse meat; high-end hot dogs; whiskey goose blood soup.

programme.title: Cyprus
programme.desc: Stuffed grape leaves and pork belly in Cyprus; curdling goat milk and sampling sun-dried goat; the world's oldest cookie.

programme.title: Lewis and Clark Trail
programme.desc: Andrew follows in the footsteps of Lewis and Clark while experiencing the bountiful cuisine of the Pacific Northwest; sampling Pacific lampreys, forages for edible barnacles and harvests for sea salt on this culinary adventure.

programme.title: The Southern BBQ Trail
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern eats his way through the Southern BBQ Trail; dry-aged brisket in Atlanta; liver nip dumplings in South Carolina; raccoon hash in Hull, Georgia.

programme.title: Civil War
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern sinks his teeth into the foods that have sustained soldiers and civilians since the lean times of the Civil War and shaped a region's cuisine, from barbecued raccoon and squirrel stew to tooth-cracking hard tack.

programme.title: Road Tripping Route 66
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern sets off on historic Route 66, where he tries ranch dressing soda, judges a calf fry cook-off and dines at some of the most iconic diners along the world-famous highway; quail stew, onion burgers and ox tail.

programme.title: Great Lakes
programme.desc: From pork shoulder cooked underground to hearty pasties and whitefish plucked from the tumultuous Lake Superior, Andrew Zimmern explores the cuisine of the individualistic Upper Peninsula in Michigan.

programme.title: The Pacific Coast Highway
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern cruises up the most scenic highway in America on a seafood-sampling adventure; hagfish fishing in the Pacific, eating the slimy reproductive organs of sea urchins and foraging for juicy gooseneck barnacles.

programme.title: Magnificent Mississippi River
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern follows Mark Twain's path down the Mississippi River for a slice of Americana; floating from meal to meal, he tries frog legs on a cargo ship, hunts wood duck, grills huge fish ribs and learns the art of Deep South pheasant pot pie.

programme.title: Cajun Country Trail
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern heads south to explore Louisiana's Cajun country; from blood sausage to chewy ginger cakes, seafood gumbo to wild hog heart, Andrew finds that Cajun country is rife with edible resources and French-inspired recipes from the past.

programme.title: Twin Cities
programme.desc: Old-fashioned is combined with modern innovation to create some interesting comfort foods in Minneapolis and St. Paul.

programme.title: New Orleans
programme.desc: Bizarre Foods America visits the Big Easy where the food and the culture are a mix of Southern traditions and modern influence. Andrew eats stuffed pig stomach and smoked raccoon served with a side of live jazz.

programme.title: Seattle
programme.desc: Andrew visits Seattle, where the food scene can be high-tech or ruggedly simple. He's an eyewitness to how complicated gadgets create brand-new tastes, and he visits an all-natural farm to eat cow placenta.

programme.title: Boston
programme.desc: Andrew visits Boston to prove that a traditional city can be a breeding ground for new food trends. He meets a group of Harvard scientists, and a Cambodian family that injects new food traditions into a Boston suburb.

programme.title: Detroit
programme.desc: Andrew finds out if it is food that keeps Detroit's motor running. Andrew visits Motown and gets revved up about tasting some of the city's food, including iconic soul food and lamb brain sandwiches, in the heart of Arab America.

programme.title: West Virginia
programme.desc: West Virginia's culinary delights are celebrated, including fresh deer organs after a kill, groundhog burgoo, and a roadkill cook-off.

programme.title: Charleston
programme.desc: Andrew gets a taste of the rewards from hard work and discovers the true flavor of Charleston's food scene.

programme.title: Savannah

programme.desc: Bryant befriends a troubled teen and introduces him to martial arts. As Bryant's mysterious and dangerous past catches up to him, he is forced into a life and death struggle to clear his name, save the boy and get back all he left behind.

programme.desc: During a routine prison work detail, convict Piper (Laurence Fishburne) is chained to Dodge (Stephen Baldwin), a cyberhacker, when gunfire breaks out. programme.title: Medusa Deluxe
programme.desc: Talented and cutthroat hairstylists at a competition find one of their own murdered before judging can begin. Winding through neon-lit halls, competitors unspool long-simmering resentments and lies as they search for the killer among them.

programme.title: Shottas
programme.desc: Deported from the United States, two drug dealers (Ky-Mani Marley, Spragga Benz) travel to Miami and continue their violent ways.

programme.title: The Mighty Quinn
programme.desc: Police chief Xavier Quinn (Denzel Washington) investigates the gruesome murder of Donald Pater, one of the wealthiest residents on a Caribbean island. He was found decapitated in his Jacuzzi. Although the local political establishment, especially crooked Governor Chalk (Norman Beaton), insists that small-time thief Maubee (Robert Townsend) is responsible, Xavier has his doubts. This view is complicated by the police chief's personal history with Maubee: The men have been friends since childhood.

programme.title: Hendrix
programme.desc: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix (Wood Harris) innovates 1960s rock 'n' roll, then dies of a drug overdose at 27.

programme.title: Shottas
programme.desc: Deported from the United States, two drug dealers (Ky-Mani Marley, Spragga Benz) travel to Miami and continue their violent ways.

programme.title: Lila & Eve
programme.desc: After the senseless murder of her son (Aml Ameen), a grief-stricken mother (Viola Davis) joins forces with another woman (Jennifer Lopez) for vigilante justice.

programme.title: Cut Throat City
programme.desc: When Hurricane Katrina devastates New Orleans, four desperate friends band together to pull off a daring heist in the heart of the city.

programme.title: Night Train
programme.desc: Greed and betrayal ensnares three people (Danny Glover, Steve Zahn, Leelee Sobieski) when they find a stash of diamonds aboard a train.

programme.title: Christmas in Compton
programme.desc: Big Earl (Keith David) runs a Christmas tree lot in Compton, and he demands success from all of his employees. His son causes a lot of trouble when he crosses the line to prove he can be successful.

When a student writes the police code for homicide, 187, inside a textbook owned by teacher Trevor Garfield (Samuel L. Jackson), he feels threatened. The principal dismisses the incident, but, soon after, Trevor is stabbed by the same student. Fifteen months later, a physically and emotionally scarred Trevor relocates to California and takes up substitute teaching. To his dismay, his new school is as full of dangerously undisciplined students as the last one, driving Trevor over the edge.

programme.title: The Last Black Man in San Francisco
programme.desc: Jimmie and his best friend Mont try to reclaim the house built by Jimmie's grandfather, launching them on a poignant odyssey that connects them to their past, even as it tests their friendship and sense of belonging in the place they call home.

programme.title: Chaos
programme.desc: A veteran detective is teamed with a rookie cop when they are sent to negotiate with a bunch of criminals holding a bank hostage. It transpires that a master thief has planted a computer virus that will drain funds from the bank's accounts. The detective faces a race against time to catch the thief and stop the randomly evolving computer virus, which models its behavior on the bewildering principles of chaos theory.

programme.title: Foxy Brown
programme.desc: Unable to pay back the $20,000 he owes the mob, small-time hustler Link (Antonio Fargas) instead gives up the identity of an undercover cop (Terry Carter) who happens to be dating his sister, Foxy Brown (Pam Grier). When gangsters later kill the cop, Foxy is quick to make the connection and swears vengeance. Posing as a prostitute, and with the help of a group of neighborhood vigilantes, she gradually tracks down the hit men, their Mafia bosses and her own brother.

programme.title: Candyman: Farewell to the Flesh
programme.desc: As her brother stands trial for the killing of an outspoken New Orleans professor, inner-city schoolteacher Annie Tarrant begins hearing rumors of the Candyman, a murderous, knife-handed figure of urban legend. Skeptical of the Candyman's existence, Annie follows the procedure for summoning him and suddenly finds herself celebrating the most horrifying Mardi Gras of her life. Meanwhile, Annie's mother harbors a dark family secret.

programme.title: Soda Cracker
programme.desc: A Chicago police officer practices his own brand of justice to take down the killers who murdered his partner.

programme.title: Breakin' 2: Electric Boogaloo
programme.desc: Disappointed with her small part in the chorus line of a Los Angeles show, jazz dancer Kelly (Lucinda Dickey) quits and heads home. Her father (John Christy Ewing) disapproves of Kelly's friendship with street dancers Ozone (Adolfo "Shabba-Doo" Quinones) and Turbo (Michael "Boogaloo Shrimp" Chambers), and encourages her to pursue an opportunity to perform in Paris. Ignoring his wishes, Kelly teams up with her friends for a break-dancing benefit show to save an endangered community center.

programme.title: Reasonable Doubt
programme.desc: A prosecutor (Dominic Cooper) commits a fatal hit-and-run, then manipulates the case so that the man who was arrested for the crime is acquitted. After the trial, he discovers that his actions have freed a guilty man.

programme.title: Snipes
programme.desc: Erik Triggs is a good-natured Philadelphia teen and aspiring rapper who works at a hip-hop record label. There he hangs with rising superstar Prolifik during the day and works on his own music after hours. However, when Prolifik is kidnapped and his unreleased album is stolen, the record label's sleazy owner, Bobby Starr, assumes Erik and his friend Malik are responsible. The two soon find themselves on the run.

programme.title: Single Cylinder Special
programme.desc: We show you how to have lots of fun building engines on a budget. We dive into the world of small engines doing a multi-stage build on a 212 CC Go-Kart engine, and we test some easy, bolt-on upgrades on the chassis dyno and behind the wheel.

programme.title: Ignition & Cooling Upgrades Gets This '79 Ford Ranchero Square Body Road Ready
programme.desc: We help one of our viewers get their automotive project back on track, on today's Driveway Rescue.

programme.title: Twin Big Blocks Dyno'd Together Part 2
programme.desc: Today, it's do or die. We connect TWO 496 Big Block Chevy engines to the dyno to find out exactly how much power two of the same engine will make running in tandem!

programme.title: Can a Stock Cast SBC Crank live at 7000 RPM and 570+ HP?
programme.desc: E85 fuel promises high-octane performance for almost any engine. We put it to the test in our revamped 360ci "Compression Obsession" Small Block Chevy.

programme.title: Backyard Engine Build
programme.desc: Out of the shop and into the yard! We take a weekend to rebuild a 350ci small block Chevy V8 engine like you would at your home. We'll trade in our professional gear for tools you might have at your house to show you how to get the most out of your build.

programme.title: What Happens If You Just Add A Stroker Kit To A Stock Mopar Magnum?
programme.desc: We show what happens when our 360 Magnum engine gets fifty extra cubic inches from a forged stroker kit.

programme.title: Diagnosing Problems On A Caprice Wagon To Get It Up And Running
programme.desc: We found an old Caprice wagon and diagnosed some problems to get it back on the road. After getting it running, we head to the hills of Kentucky for the Pineville Hill Climb, a grassroots racing event that adds some local flair.

programme.title: Mocking Up a New 1974 Bronco
programme.desc: It's time to mock everything in place in our 1974 Bronco. We'll also have the frame blasted and powder coated, the body in epoxy, and assembled to the frame.

programme.title: Complete Rebuild Of An AMC 304 Including Adding Port Fuel Injection
programme.desc: We take the original anemic 304 powerplant from an AMC Javelin, and turn it into a high-tech muscle car bullet with some bite!

programme.title: Extreme Diesel Rigs at Ultimate Callout Challenge
programme.desc: LT & Austin purchase a 2011 Sierra Denali HD, plus they are on the road in Indy for coverage of the Ultimate Callout Challenge.

programme.title: Swapping In A Performance Clutch On The Spec Miata Racecar - Part 3
programme.desc: The crew starts tearing into the drivetrain and suspension of their Spec Mazda Miata racecar to help it perform better on the track.

programme.title: How Can an Old 408ci Windsor Make 500HP?
programme.desc: We've got the tips and techniques for Stroking a 408 ci Windsor. So, what does it take to make big power?

programme.title: Shifting Our 1963 Ford Falcon Into Hyperdrive
programme.desc: Now that we've dumped the engine, it's time to drop in the clutch as we install a manual transmission into our 1963 Ford Falcon. We're hoping this will help get our Black Bird off the endangered species list.

programme.title: Tired Supercharged Coyote Mustang Interior Gets an Overhaul
programme.desc: The Detroit Muscle crew creates a custom exhaust with some TIG Tech, and they lay out a new living room for our EBC Supercharged Coyote Mustang.

programme.title: SCCA SPEC Mustang Part 1
programme.desc: Engine Power embarks on a new project for SCCA's inaugural SPEC Mustang class. We'll take a 2008 Mustang GT and begin getting it ready for this entry level, but competitive class.

programme.title: Can We Make This Stock '91 Suburban Unbreakable?
programme.desc: In the series launch we take a 1991 Chevy Suburban and transform it into 'Project Unbreakable.' We test the Suburban at on off-road track, then return to the studio to tear it down to the frame, create a full build-plan, get the engine work underway, and begin fabrication.

programme.title: Hear That Hemi: Bringing A 1970 Hemi Cuda Back To Life
programme.desc: HEMI Cuda', need we say more? The Detroit Muscle crew tune up a rare 1970 HEMI Barracuda for its busy owner. We wake the elephant sleeping under the hood, and take joy ride!

programme.title: Building a Small Block Ford Race Engine
programme.desc: Endurance is the name of the game in building a fresh Small Block Ford race engine.

programme.title: Lifting Big with 8" BDS Coilover Conversion and 35" Tires
programme.desc: We jack up the '14 Silverado and add big wheels, tires, and brake upgrades.

programme.title: Running Our '69 Camaro Through the Wringer
programme.desc: With the SeaFoam Camaro finished up, it is time to see what all those upgrades have done for our Restomod Giveaway. Then we help a viewer with some repairs on their vehicle on another Driveway Rescue

programme.title: Building a Windsor Stroker - There's No Replacement for Displacement
programme.desc: There's a surefire way to make more horsepower for our Windsor, Make it a Stroker! Plus, all new dyno room - Meet Cellblock D!

programme.title: Hellcat Dodge Charger Hits the Road
programme.desc: We put the final touches to our '69 Hellcat Powered Dodge Charger, getting it ready to hit the road!

programme.title: Will Race Fuel And A Bigger Cam Improve Power On The Chevy 350 Dyno Mule?
programme.desc: We just can't stop searching for more power from our Small Block Chevy! It's getting high-octane race fuel, more aggressive timing, and a bigger cam.

programme.title: Supercharging Our Drift Trailblazer To Push It Past the 500 HP Threshold
programme.desc: Part 4 of the Drifting Trailblazer. Jeremy and Jimmy wear out some tires with their drifting Trailblazer SS, after pushing it past 500HP on the dyno.

programme.title: Brake the Pavement
programme.desc: The EBC Brakes and Pedal Commander Dodge Charger gets its final touches on brakes and cosmetics before hitting the track.

programme.title: Toughening Up The '91 Suburban With New Axles And A 4-Link Coilover Kit
programme.desc: Our GMC "Unbreakable" Suburban gets its new suspension along with a good sanding and paint job to help get it ready for the real world.

programme.title: 302 vs. 305 Round 2
programme.desc: The second round of putting data behind the classic 302 SBF vs. 305 SBC debate happens on this episode as Pat and Frankie bring back the Bowtie and Blue Oval in their Small Displacement Showdown. The viewers asked and we listened... so the next round of budget minded upgrades focus on testing what many consider to be each engines best production cylinder heads from the 90's.

programme.title: How-To Custom Paint Graphics in 2 hours
programme.desc: Project Sydewinder get some custom paint and graphics plus demystifying older car terms and labels.

programme.title: Squeezing the Heartbeat Of Our '69 Camaro Between the Fenders
programme.desc: The guys down in Engine Power have finished beefing up our '69 Camaro' s engine with some high-performance parts, now we have to install it and upgrade the drive train so it can hold it's own with today's modern muscle.

programme.title: Rebuilding The Rusted Out Chassis On Our Square Body
programme.desc: A 50 year old tow truck gets a newly fabricated rear chassis to return it to its former glory.

programme.title: Dropping Our '53 Willy's Wagon Body On Its New Chassis
programme.desc: The Carcass duo fab up some custom body mounts for a first look at the Chevy M1010 and Willys Wagon combo. Plus, a sneak peak at the powerhouse that will drive it all.

programme.title: Adding JDM Styling Cues To The 1978 Datsun 280Z Heritage Restomod
programme.desc: The Carcass crew makes body modifications to our 1978 280Z that take on some JDM styling cues. And we're in the paint booth to show you how to make your paint come out smooth as glass.

programme.title: Over 13:1 on Pump Gas! Chevy 350 Dyno Mule - Part 2
programme.desc: We finish our 350 ci Small Block Chevy with high-performance induction, then we put it to the test in the dyno cell!

programme.title: Axles On, Powertrain In
programme.desc: With the Land Cruiser FJ60 plan in motion, the build speeds up. The engine bay gets cleaned up and painted, the freshly rebuilt axles go back under the truck, and the powertrain finally goes in, setting the stage for the next wave of the project build.

programme.title: Chevy C-10 - Part 2: Building the Foundation
programme.desc: The MCT guys start the teardown of their C-10 Chevy. They'll mockup of the front suspension, getting their Chevy closer to the ground for better handling. Plus install a big brake kit for improved stopping power.

programme.title: Mustang Sydewinder at the Mid America Ford and Shelby Nationals
programme.desc: Our Mustang Cobra project "Sydewinder" hits the track at the Mid America Ford and Shelby Nationals! 600+Horsepower and set up for the track, the Foxbody beast is loose!

programme.title: UTV Refurb: General Maintenance
programme.desc: Generally, when you think of trucks, the letters UTV may not come to mind, but today, we're here to change your point of view. The guys tear down a 2019 Polaris General and build it back up to be a lean, mean off-roading machine with all-new suspension, brakes, and some performance upgrades to make this the ultimate utility-train vehicle.

programme.title: Building a Mini Monster Mud Truck from a Surplus Military Ambulance
programme.desc: Jeremy and Jimmy take suggestions from the Powernation team on what to do with their Chevy M1010, before taking this huge military ambulance out on the trails.

programme.title: Chevy C-10 - Part 1: Auto Cross Pretender
programme.desc: Music City Trucks takes their new C-10 project on a wild ride, putting it to the test, to get a better idea of what improvements this old Chevy needs to make it a custom cruiser.

programme.title: Fat Stack - Part 14: Clean, Mean, and Candy Green
programme.desc: Our 1971 Chevy Caprice, Project Fat Stack, ROARS to life after almost a year of work. Tommy and Peyton give the nitty gritty on exhaust installation and finish the interior. Fat Stack turns heads in downtown Nashville to the delight of the Broadway crowd.

programme.title: 69 GTO Part 7 - Midnight Masterpiece
programme.desc: Clutch performance - Today Tommy and Joel install a new third pedal and show you the do's and don'ts on how to bleed the transmission to make your ride run smooth. Then, the dash gets an upgrade but its aesthetic stays true to its retro-glory.

programme.title: Hot Rod Godzilla
programme.desc: We get our hands on Ford's new 7.3 liter pushrod V-8 Godzilla engine and see how it stacks up against the other BIG 3 swap engines. After doing a baseline test, we'll make some modifications by throwing the Engine Power touch on it and see what this beast lays down in the dyno cell.

programme.title: Boost-Ready Stroker LS3
programme.desc: We've got big plans for this aluminum block! That includes stroking it to 419ci, along with a fully-forged rotating assembly that's ready for a power adder!

programme.title: 69 GTO Part 8 - Power Moves
programme.desc: Wired and inspired - The guys enter the winding maze of wiring as they install a new ECU. Then, it's out with the old and in with the new as Joel upgrades the sound deadening and Tommy puts a new shine on the original taillights.

programme.desc: Survivors of Nazi atrocities recognized Archbishop Trifa as having led an attack against Jews during WWII.

programme.title: Broken Promises
programme.desc: When a popular teacher is found dead of what appears to be an accidental gunshot wound, his family is suspicious. A tape recorded by the victim before his death provides clues to what happened.

programme.title: Time Will Tell
programme.desc: In this international case of extortion, murder and stolen identities, scam-artist Albert J. Walker assumes the identity of co-worker Ronald Platt.

programme.title: Second Shot at Love
programme.desc: When a surgeon is found dead in his home, police assume it was suicide. The investigation reveals otherwise.

programme.title: Journey to Justice
programme.desc: A child was killed in a hit-and-run. The prosecutor has an accident reconstruction expert come to trial.

programme.title: Video Diary
programme.desc: When a convenience store employee is found dead, police find the murder has been caught on a security camera.

programme.title: Deadly Knowledge
programme.desc: Police investigate a missing college girl and discover her double life: attending school by day and working as a call-girl by night. Her body is found and investigators find her killer.

programme.title: Missing in Time
programme.desc: A woman was reported missing after a fight with her husband. Police were suspicious of a suspect who reported a fire in his car. Two tiny drops of blood were found in the interior. A tiny clue inside the suspect's watchband helped solve the case.

programme.title: Missing Pearl
programme.desc: In 1991, Maine resident Pearl Smith is missing after an argument with her husband Bill Bruns. But when an investigation turns up a blood trail that leads to the couple's basement, police are sure they'll find the victim's body.

programme.title: Man's Best Friend?
programme.desc: In 1989, 4-year-old April Loveless was found dead in the backyard of her Texas home. Her mother Debbie Loveless and stepfather John Miller told police that she was attacked and killed by the family dogs. Investigators did not agree.

programme.title: Hand Delivered
programme.desc: In 1995, police in San Diego, California are baffled by a pair of hands found in a dumpster. Through further investigation, they determine that the hands are those of missing person Don Hardin.

programme.title: Death Play
programme.desc: In 1993, Marie Robards suffered the loss of her father due to a heart attack - but it was more sinister.

programme.title: Fire Dot Com
programme.desc: In 1996, 17-month-old Josh Hinson died in a fire which a federal agency ruled was intentionally set by Josh's mother Terri Strickland. Using the then-emerging resources of the Internet, Terri Strickland undertook her own investigation.

programme.title: Mistaken For Dead
programme.desc: In 1988, when a patient dies unexpectedly in the office of California neurologist Richard Boggs, police begin what they think will be a routine investigation. Soon they uncover a bizarre story of corpse stealing, fake identity and sexual perversion.

programme.title: Frozen Evidence
programme.desc: One investigator's quick thinking helps him capture a shoe impression made in snow before it melts away.

programme.title: Soft Touch
programme.desc: In 1992, 22-year-old Dawn Bruce is brutally murdered in her Virginia apartment. Investigators notice a blood smear on a pillowcase that appears to have been made by one of the killer's fingers.

programme.title: Church Disappearance
programme.desc: In 1981, six-year-old Cassie Hansen disappeared from her St. Paul, Minnesota church during an evening service.

programme.title: Photo Finish
programme.desc: Professional photographer Charles Rathbun claims model Linda Sobek died during a consensual sexual encounter gone wrong, but Sobek's corpse and some high-tech digital imagery tell a more sinister story.

programme.title: Whodunit
programme.desc: In 1998, an evening out at a Maryland murder mystery theatre performance turns into a real-life whodunit when the badly burned body of Stephen Hricko is discovered in his hotel room after a fire.

programme.title: Horse Play
programme.desc: In 1980, Michigan resident Shannon Mohr died in what was reported to be a horseback riding accident by her new husband David Davis. After her death, Shannon's family reported to police their suspicions that Davis seemed far from grief-stricken.

programme.title: Treads and Threads
programme.desc: For 15 months, a serial killer was strangling prostitutes in Florida then taunting police by leaving the bodies in plain sight. The only clues were a tire impression and some threads.

programme.title: Killer's "Cattle" Log
programme.desc: When police in the Great Plains are called about a dead body, they do a background check on the victim.

programme.title: Skin of Her Teeth
programme.desc: In 1994, a human skull retrieved from an Ohio pond reveals a ghastly crime. Markings on the skull indicate that the victim had been stabbed multiple times and that the teeth had been removed with needle-nose pliers.

programme.title: Bad Blood
programme.desc: In rural Canada, Dr. John Schneeberger is accused of sedating and sexually assaulting one of his female patients and his stepdaughter. DNA tests demonstrate that the doctor is innocent, but the patient insists that he sedated and raped her.

programme.title: Pure Evil
programme.desc: In a search for the killer of two teenagers in Texas, a behavioral profile led to suspect Jason Massey, and hard science proved the profile was correct. Massey was executed by lethal injection on April 3, 2001.

programme.title: Root of All Evil
programme.desc: A suspect's former lover comes forward with a tale of murder, mutilation and cremation, but there's no way to test the story's validity until a plant pathologist and a dendrochronologist conduct tests where the cremation supposedly occurred.

programme.title: Where the Blood Drops
programme.desc: Susie Mowbray was charged for her husband Bill Mowbray's death, but her son was convinced of her innocence.

programme.title: Sibling Rivalry
programme.desc: In 1991, San Francisco pornographer Artie Mitchell was murdered in his home. His brother and business partner Jim is found near the scene carrying a rifle and later confesses to shooting Artie. The question is whether the shooting was premeditated.

programme.title: Pastoral Care
programme.desc: In 1981, New York correctional officer Donna Payant disappeared and was later found in a landfill. The medical examiner not only identified the cause of death but also found an important clue.

programme.title: Double Trouble
programme.desc: In 1995, when off-duty Maine State Trooper Vicky Gardner is attacked by Steven Fortin during a routine stop, it triggers a chain of events which jumpstarts a stalled murder case in New Jersey.

programme.title: Cats, Flies & Snapshots
programme.desc: When 19-year-old Lori Auker left her Pennsylvania home for work and never arrived, it took space-age technology, cat hairs and insects to pinpoint the image of the woman's abductor.

programme.title: Naked Justice
programme.desc: Forensic computer analysis, blood spatter analysis and a painstaking investigation lead police to a lawyer husband Michael "Mick" Fletcher with a motive to kill his wife since he was having a sexual affair with judge Susan Chrzanowski.

programme.title: Treading Not So Lightly
programme.desc: A fan of murder mysteries and forensic science shows uses what she learned from TV to determine who was responsible for the accident which permanently injured her 4-year-old daughter.

programme.title: Shopping Spree
programme.desc: Lisa Manderach and her daughter Devon left their Pennsylvania home to go shopping but didn't return home.

programme.title: The Cheater
programme.desc: Exploring how an American hit single from 1966 -- "The Cheater" by Bob Kuban and the In-Men -- foreshadowed the demise of the group's lead singer, Walter Scott.

programme.title: Forever Hold Your Peace
programme.desc: When Chris Ochoa confessed to the 1988 rape and murder of Nancy DePriest, the case was closed. 8 years later, Achim Marino confessed to the same crime. Can DNA evidence identify the real perpetrator?

programme.title: Reel Danger
programme.desc: When two boys are brutally attacked, investigators rely on evidence fished out of a nearby pond. It became the first case where diatom analysis was used to place a suspect at the scene of the crime.

programme.title: Who's Your Daddy
programme.desc: In 1988, the body of a young woman was discovered in an Ohio river. Most of the evidence had been washed away, but the victim's 6-year-old son unwittingly told investigators all they needed to know - without saying a word. The clue was in his genes.

programme.title: The Alibi
programme.desc: In 1991, a high school girl vanished after attending a party. The prime suspect had two alibi witnesses for the night she disappeared. A solid alibi can often overcome circumstantial evidence, but forensic evidence is another matter.

programme.title: Purr-fect Match
programme.desc: When police discovered the body of Douglas Beamish's estranged wife, authorities linked 20 cat hairs found on her jacket to a cat owned by Beamish's parents. It was the first time animal DNA was used to solve a criminal case.

programme.title: Bio-Attack
programme.desc: When more than 700 Oregonians contracted food poisoning from a unique strain of salmonella in 1984, investigators uncovered a secret plot to influence local elections.

programme.title: A Shot in the Dark
programme.desc: A woman is found dead from a gunshot wound and police suspect her husband, however, forensic teams prove what really happened, and the truth is stranger than fiction.

programme.title: Without a Prayer
programme.desc: In 1995, the founder of American Atheists disappeared with one of her sons, her granddaughter and $500,000 in gold coins. The police investigated several suspects, including David R. Waters, who worked for American Atheists.

programme.title: A Clutch of Witnesses
programme.desc: Two people witness a truck driving over an unconscious man and flee into a nearby bar, but when the police turn up, the truck, the man and the witnesses are gone.

programme.title: Scout's Honor
programme.desc: In 1984, a passerby finds the torso of a woman in a cardboard box. A forensic entomologist analyzes nearby insect activity to determine when the victim was killed.

programme.title: A Touching Recollection
programme.desc: The investigation into the kidnapping and rape of an 18-year-old Ohio woman is aided when the victim returns hours after the incident occurred. With her help, the police are able to track the assailant to his front door.

programme.title: A Leg to Stand On
programme.desc: The police investigate when a severed leg is discovered among garbage. Conventional means of identifying the victim are impossible, leading investigators to rely on DNA, forensic anthropology and toxicology.

programme.title: Partners in Crime
programme.desc: A coroner finds telltale clues on the badly burned body of a murder victim, sending police in pursuit of a couple of killers.

programme.title: Within a Hair
programme.desc: In 1996, Indiana police identified Richard Alexander as the "River Park Rapist" who assaulted four women that year. Later, DNA analysis casts doubt on his conviction.

programme.title: Chief Evidence
programme.desc: After the murder of Seattle residents, evidence from the couple's dog eventually ties a murderer to the scene.

programme.title: A Bitter Pill to Swallow
programme.desc: Soon after becoming pregnant by Dr. Maynard Muntzing, firefighter Michelle Baker's health quickly deteriorates. Eventually, she raises suspicions that Muntzing is doing her harm.

programme.title: Sip of Sins
programme.desc: In the 1980s, a trio of unsolved murders occurred in Wichita Falls, Texas. Later, a fourth murder from the same time period provided the police with far more than they realized.

programme.title: Telltale Tracks
programme.desc: The disappearance of Philadelphia college athlete Aimee Willard is investigated after her car is found on the roadside. When her body is found, the police find unusual marks and DNA evidence that eventually lead to her killer.

programme.title: Ghost in the Machine
programme.desc: While investigating an apparent overdose suicide, detectives recover incriminating files from a computer.

programme.title: Frozen in Time
programme.desc: A woman disappeared along a California highway in 1991. Three years later, the case was solved when a man's refrigerated truck was looked upon with suspicion.

programme.title: Cold Storage
programme.desc: The 1987 disappearance of Houston resident Tracy Jo Shine is recalled. The investigation went cold until 2000 when a "cold case squad" learned that the woman's ex-boyfriend Michael Neal had bragged about killing her.

programme.title: The Metal Business
programme.desc: When a 62-year-old man opens a car restoration business and becomes seriously ill, his doctors cannot find the cause, but forensics can; identification of a highly toxic metal in the victim's blood leads to his poisoner.

programme.title: Dressed to Kill
programme.desc: After 6-year-old Michelle Lee Dorr went missing, her father confessed to murdering her. But investigators soon poked holes in his story, leaving the case unsolved for 14 years.

programme.title: Palm Print Conviction
programme.desc: The 1996 investigation into 48-year-old Martha Hansen's murder is helped by a legal requirement that bars have video cameras installed on the premises.

programme.title: A Vow of Silence
programme.desc: When the mail-order bride of a former army sergeant goes missing, investigators look into the deaths of the man's previous two wives.

programme.title: Elephant Tracks
programme.desc: The murders of an elderly couple leave police stumped until, two years later, they receive a major break.

programme.title: A Bag of Evidence
programme.desc: While investigating the murder of 9-year-old Jessica Knott, police use a garbage bag to connect a suspect.

programme.title: Tooth or Consequences
programme.desc: An investigation into the murder of Katie Poirier is stymied by the lack of a body. Finally, investigators use a single tooth found among some charred remains to identify her.

programme.title: Sniffing Revenge
programme.desc: Janet Overton died suspiciously in 1988, and the investigation hit a dead end when the autopsy indicated no foul play was involved. A telephone tip and the sensitive nose of a forensic examiner indicated otherwise.

programme.title: Sleight of Hand
programme.desc: Discovering that an assault suspect is left-handed is crucial to a police investigation dating back 16 years.

programme.title: Scratching The Surface
programme.desc: The only clue recovered from a shooting is a twelve-guage shotgun. Scientists use unique methods to lift the serial number from the weapon to trace it to its owner

programme.title: Fire Proof
programme.desc: A serial arsonist starts several fires that cause millions of dollars worth of damage and the deaths of three people. He is discovered, partly through the use of forensic hypnosis.

programme.title: X Marks the Spot
programme.desc: When a serial killer was terrorizing the city of St. Louis, the FBI didn't need lab tests, fingerprints or any of the usual methods. All they needed was a computer.

programme.title: All Charged Up
programme.desc: In the case of the Center City Rapist and the murder of Shannon Schieber, Philadelphia authorities use an anonymous letter and geographic profiling to hone in on a suspect.

programme.title: Breaking the Mold
programme.desc: A three-year-old develops a respiratory condition. His father has Alzheimers. An investigator reveals that their ill health is due to mold in their modern home.

programme.title: House Call
programme.desc: A murder investigation in Florida crosses jurisdictions from New York and Jamaica. The police rely on cell phone mapping, wiretapping and a host of forensic evidence to link a suspect to a murder.

programme.title: The Sniper's Trail
programme.desc: In 2002, the eyes of the world were on Virginia and Maryland. A serial sniper was on the loose, killing innocent, unsuspecting citizens. Just how was he caught?

programme.title: Plastic Fire
programme.desc: A woman convicted of killing her mother in a car fire is granted a new trial. An expert witness has a different opinion as to how the fire started and, if proven, would clear the woman of any culpability.

programme.title: Last Will
programme.desc: Authorities track a kidnapper who let his victim write a last will and informed the family of her murder.

programme.title: Dessert Served Cold
programme.desc: A man died in his home after a history of heart disease. Rumors surfaced that the death was no accident.

programme.title: The Music Case
programme.desc: In 1999, a 12-year-old was found murdered in her home in Minnesota. Despite a meticulous search of the home and an exhaustive investigation, police had no suspects.

programme.title: Paintball
programme.desc: In 1962, the people of the small town of Hanford, California lost their sense of peace when one of their own, 15-year-old Marlene Miller, was murdered.

programme.title: Sign Here
programme.desc: A mother of two vanishes after a shopping trip. Her body is discovered a month later. Witnesses say they saw the victim being forced into a car by an unknown person.

programme.title: Shadow of a Doubt
programme.desc: A woman is shot to death in her store just one day before she is to testify against the man accused of robbing her. The robber becomes the prime suspect, but he has a solid alibi.

programme.title: Tourist Trap
programme.desc: In 1993, the state of Florida was known for more than just Disney World. Worldwide attention focused on a rash of robberies which targeted tourists.

programme.title: Once Bitten
programme.desc: At a murder scene, investigators find a shoe-print, several foreign hairs, and unknown fingerprints. But they believe the most telling piece of evidence is the bite mark on the victim.

programme.title: All Wet
programme.desc: A woman's death in Pennsylvania triggers a homicide investigation into another woman's death in North Carolina.

programme.title: Shot of Vengeance
programme.desc: A nurse experiences a variety of flu-like symptoms. None of her doctors are able to discover the cause, until she visits the gynecologist for a routine check-up.

programme.title: Dinner and a Movie
programme.desc: Time of death becomes pivotal after a pregnant woman is found murdered in her air-conditioned bedroom.

programme.title: A Wrong Foot
programme.desc: Police were puzzled by an obscure print found at a crime scene where one man had been killed and two teenage girls were seriously injured.

programme.title: Order Up
programme.desc: A man is found dead in his home, and his ex-wife has a perfect alibi. To determine time of death, investigators need to know when the victim ate his last meal.

programme.title: When the Dust Settled
programme.desc: A union official is executed in his home not long after a strike by the union membership. Neither his wife nor anyone in the neighborhood heard any gunshots.

programme.title: A Welcome Intrusion
programme.desc: A man tells police he shot an intruder who killed his wife. Forensic evidence disproves that story later on.

programme.title: Within Arm's Reach
programme.desc: A police officer accused of killing his estranged wife insists she committed suicide. Investigators say it was murder - that it was physically impossible for the woman to have shot herself.

programme.title: Private Thoughts
programme.desc: When Firefighters found an entire family dead inside their home it looked like a murder-suicide, but there were several inconsistent clues in the rubble.

programme.title: Brotherhoods
programme.desc: Two men were murdered in their beds. The next night, arson destroyed a family planning clinic. Investigators find a link between the two separate crimes.

programme.title: Hair of the Dog
programme.desc: With no forensic evidence inside a murder scene, investigators were baffled. But they suspected that the victim's dog had witnessed the crime.

programme.title: Breaking News
programme.desc: A young TV news producer is raped and murdered in her apartment. Investigators turn to the Commonwealth of Virginia's DNA Databank.

programme.title: All the World's a Stage
programme.desc: Police are dispatched to the scene of a shooting, and discover the victim's husband is one of their own: a homicide detective who says his wife accidentally shot herself in the head.

programme.title: The Big Chill
programme.desc: A woman who suffered from mental illness is found dead. Was it due to natural causes, suicide or murder?
