programme.title: Vivir del cuento
programme.desc: Un empleado usa el nombre de su patrón para cometer fraude y es despedido, pero a su vez el patrón engaña a su ex-suegro.

programme.title: El beisbolista fenómeno
programme.desc: Un excelente beisbolista muere y supuestamente su espíritu entra en un vagabundo que empieza a jugar como todo un profesional.

programme.title: Extraña Cita
programme.desc: Una bella joven trata de vengarse de la muerte de su padre y sufre humillaciones mientras lo hace.

programme.title: Los tales por cuales
programme.desc: Un ranchero llega a un pueblo donde se atribuyen varios delitos al cacique y lo salva de varios atentados.

programme.title: La familia Pérez
programme.desc: Una familia, excesiva en sus pretensiones, aprende varias lecciones sobre humildad, amor y unión familiar.

programme.title: Una gallega en México
programme.desc: Una española tiene su panadería frente a una carnicería y riñe constantemente con el dueño aunque sus hijos se aman.

programme.title: Sor Alegría
programme.desc: Una mujer que vive de parranda en parranda conoce la miseria de los barrios bajos y decide convertirse en monja.

programme.title: Adiós Juventud
programme.desc: Al terminar sus estudios, un estudiante de medicina deja a su enamorada quien lo había mantenido durante años.

programme.title: Cuánto vale tu hijo
programme.desc: Un niño es atropellado por un auto al salir de la escuela y el conductor ofrece dinero a su familia, quien lo rechaza.

programme.title: Si leyeras mi carta
programme.desc: Una casa guarda un gran secreto sobre una misteriosa mujer. Un hombre extraño dice conocer a Leonora y se empeña en buscarla.

programme.title: Qué Noche Aquella
programme.desc: Una mujer de economía arruinada quiere casar a su bella hija con un tímido capitán, pero este aburre a la joven.

programme.title: Ladrón que roba a ladrón
programme.desc: Un bandido es herido durante un atraco y su cómplice obliga a un médico a curarlo, luego se esconden en un pueblo.

programme.title: Mujeres del Paraíso
programme.desc: Un médico siente compasión por la joven ciega que vio desnuda en el río y junto con un colega decide operarla.

programme.title: Una Luz en mi Camino
programme.desc: Un compositor ciego se enamora de una pobre sirvienta.

programme.title: No te engañes corazón
programme.desc: Una joven desea cantar ópera, pero su maestra la desanima, y, por otro lado, ama a su novio, pero su madre quiere casarla con un hombre viejo.

programme.title: El halcón solitario
programme.desc: Un comandante celebra la culminación de los estudios de su hermano, pero una banda de villanos rapta al profesional.

programme.title: El Farol de la Ventana
programme.desc: Un forastero se enamora de la hija de una mujer amnésica que cree que él es el hijo que el mar se llevó cuando era pequeño.

programme.title: El rebozo de Soledad
programme.desc: Alberto Robles es un médico que decide irse de su pueblo debido a la ignorancia y la injusticia que había ahí. Alberto se da cuenta de que está enamorado de Soledad, una mujer que le pide ayuda porque su hermano está muy enfermo, pero cuando le propone matrimonio ella le dice que no quiere casarse con él y huye.

programme.title: Bartolo toca la flauta
programme.desc: Un joven distraído es apresado con falsos cargos porque al cacique de la región le gusta su novia.

programme.title: Tres citas con el destino
programme.desc: El misterio de un hermoso anillo, joya maldita que causó tragedia y muerte a quienes lo tuvieron en sus manos.

programme.title: Hasta que llovió en Sayula
programme.desc: Cuando dos rancheros piden alargar el plazo para pagar una deuda y salvar su rancho, uno de ellos gana la lotería.

programme.title: El Señor Tormenta
programme.desc: Las intrigas que se viven dentro del mundo de la lucha libre mexicana.

programme.title: El despertar del sexo
programme.desc: Un joven termina su carrera y hace planes junto con su novia, pero se enfrenta a una fuerte tentación.

programme.title: División narcóticos
programme.desc: Unos traficantes obligan a los campesinos de la frontera a sembrar amapola y amenazan de muerte a quién se niegue.

programme.title: Loco y vagabundo
programme.desc: Un vago llega a la capital y un hombre lo contrata para que se haga pasar por su hermano, pero un médico lo descubre.

programme.title: Tormenta en el Ring
programme.desc: Segunda y última película de la serie El Señor Tormenta compuesta de tres episodios: El Asesino, El Secuestro y la Lucha Final.

programme.title: Cutting
programme.desc: From the most trusted inmates, working at the prison barbershop, to inmate assaults on prison staff, or inmates who turn violence against themselves, at Indiana State Prison, "cutting" has many meanings.

programme.title: Purple Pain
programme.desc: Deputies respond to a possible gang beating, but the surveillance cameras don't catch anything; a wounded warrior faces a new battle when he and his girlfriend both get arrested.

programme.title: Taming Wild
programme.desc: A family man gets a decade in jail for manufacturing weapons; a meth addict gives up a prized possession; jail introduces both of these men to a cowboy, some wild horses and the opportunity of a lifetime.

programme.title: Blood Brothers
programme.desc: An inmate takes his fights from the street to the halls of the jail and his boyhood friend follows his example; two brothers turn to crime to support their habits and one faces the prospect of hitting the streets again.

programme.title: The Wrong Fight
programme.desc: A new arrival in the Santa Rosa Correctional Institution raises serious concerns throughout the maximum-security prison; young correctional officer cadets experience the burn as each one takes a pepper spray shot in the eye.

programme.title: Warriors
programme.desc: The prison takes on a military style feel for both the inmates and the officers; a gang unit investigation turns up the heat on a pair of cellmates, before one of them turns on the other.

programme.title: The Hustle
programme.desc: Prison is an underground economy, where some deals are signed in ink and others are signed in blood; a rare look at the schemes, hustles and extortions conducted behind prison walls and the consequences they carry.

programme.title: Red and Whites
programme.desc: A group of prisoners are entrusted with potential weapons, but for the benefit of others; one of them hopes this assignment will result in a life-long bond; back at the jail, an inmate brawl leaves several officers injured.

programme.title: Tipped Off
programme.desc: At Indiana State Prison, visitation is a valued privilege for inmates, but it can also be abused; it's the most common route for contraband to enter the prison; an anonymous tip has put Internal Affairs on high alert.

programme.title: Cuchillo que no corta y amigo que no aporta, si se pierde no importa
programme.desc: Dos jóvenes son amigos desde la infancia, pero uno de ellos encuentra refugio en las drogas, por lo que su amigo buscará salvarlo.

programme.title: Compadre que no llega a las caderas
programme.desc: Un hombre conquista mujeres al por mayor, al hacerles creer ilusiones y dejarlas enamoradas. Un día encuentra su verdadero amor y esta le pide tener hijos, él se niega rotundamente, pues teme perder su libertad.

programme.title: No es buena la venganza
programme.desc: Una chica planea vengarse de su exnovio diciéndole toda la verdad a su esposa. La esposa al enterarse de la verdad planea poner cara a cara a la amante y a su marido.

programme.title: Vale más ladrón arrepentido
programme.desc: Mauro sale del reclusorio y con la ayuda de Don Tomás, decide regresar al pueblo con su familia. Al llegar se encuentra con la indiferencia de su padre, quien nunca creyó en su inocencia. Mauro se da cuenta de que Jacinto no es de fiar.

programme.title: De los parientes como sol
programme.desc: Pedro queda viudo justo cuando su mujer acababa de tener un hijo. Tras este terrible suceso, su hermano y su esposa intentan aprovecharse de él. Después de un tiempo se da cuenta de que su hermano no hace nada y se está aprovechando de él.

programme.title: Hechos son amores y no buenas razones
programme.desc: Una mujer es presa del alcoholismo y no logra ver lo que su nuevo novio quiere hacerles a sus hijas. El novio de la joven esposa entrena mujeres solas y secuestra a sus hijos para forzarlas a ser mulas del narcotráfico.

programme.title: Me he de Comer esa Tuna
programme.desc: Dos mujeres mayores pelean por el amor de Tomás, el dueño del café El Dicho. Isabel, su nieta, se pone muy celosa de ver que su abuelo podría fijarse en otra mujer a pocos meses de la muerte de su abuela.

programme.title: Brasa trae en el seno, la que cría hijo ajeno
programme.desc: Tras la muerte de su esposa, un hombre planea casarse con su antigua secretaria, quien está decidida a matar a sus hijos para quedarse sola con él. Es por eso que la hija del hombre y su abuela emprenden una misión para desenmascararla.

programme.desc: Today we meet Dr Toni. He's an L.A. based celebrity chiropractor looking for a luxurious home in Park City, Utah. He wants a home large enough to host parties for family and friends. But he also wants a quiet retreat to relax.

programme.title: Dreaming Big Estates
programme.desc: We meet Michael and Kelly who are in search for a luxury home. Viviana is taking them through some the most beautiful mega mansions in Montecito and Santa Barbara, California.

programme.title: Full Throttle Dream Homes
programme.desc: We meet Steven. He is looking for a place to spend his weekends that will accommodate his love of Motor Sports. Viviana is taking him through some of the most desirable properties in this one-of-a-kind Motor Sports Country Club.

programme.title: The Ultimate Family Escape
programme.desc: We meet John and Laura, a couple who are in search of a family escape luxury home. Viviana takes them through some of the most beautiful mega mansions in Montecito, California.

programme.title: Entertaining in the Desert
programme.desc: We meet married couple Henri and Chris who are in search of a luxury desert home. They need a house with the modern conveniences and a house to entertain at.

programme.title: A Backyard Fit For A Millionaire
programme.desc: Doug and Nicole are searching for a new luxury home in Los Angeles, California. They need a house that's closer to their clients. Will they find their dream home?

programme.title: Kids Clubhouse
programme.desc: Ali and Hana have two very talented young children - and a very noisy and crowded house. To give everyone in this family their own space, Brian and Sarah turn an old garage into a kids' music and arts hangout.

programme.title: Family of Five Funhouse
programme.desc: Love is large, but space is tight for Lara & Mike and their 5 children. Brian and Sarah free up space by building an activity-packed tree house and recreation court for the children, with grilling, dining and lounging areas for the whole family.

programme.title: Stained Glass Studio
programme.desc: Couple Farzana & Reyan have maxed out all living space in their city-sized bungalow, leaving no room for Reyan's at-home stained-glass business or Farzana's writing. Brian and Sarah build Reyan a spacious studio and construct an inspiring deck area.

programme.title: Nana's Wonderland
programme.desc: Janet's love for her nine grandkids is endless. But so is the chaos they bring inside her home when they come visit. To take that energy outside, Brian and Sarah build a fun kid-zone in the backyard, but also a sophisticated adult area for Janet.

programme.title: Sports Bar
programme.desc: Craig and Claudia share their new space with Craig's brother, Craig's parents - and their two massive dogs. To give these new homeowners a place of their own, Brian and Sarah build a sports bar and entertainment hangout in their backyard.

programme.title: Social Central Sunroom
programme.desc: Sonia & Paul are big social connectors in their community with a constant flow of visitors. Brian and Sarah turn their barren backyard into a social hotspot, complete with sunroom, giant chessboard, waterfall and stylish outdoor entertainment spaces.

programme.title: Mid-Century Poolside Retreat
programme.desc: Amy & Terry love nothing more than spending time outside with their daughters. Brian and Sarah build a dream enclosure to hang out in on summer nights, with a swimming pool change room and a new deck where Terry can grill.

programme.title: Luxury Staycation
programme.desc: Since having two kids, Sonia and Peter have resorted to staycations at home, but their backyard is a headache. Brian and Sarah create a luxury vacation destination that includes a pool, spa, outdoor kitchen and a stunning four-season structure.

programme.title: Rustic Barn Rehab
programme.desc: Becki, Shawn and their 3 kids just moved from the city to a smaller country home. To extend their living space, Brian and Sarah build a new deck, a fire pit area, and a 3-season living space, in their first ever barn rehab.

programme.title: To Be Announced
programme.desc: Programming to be announced.

programme.title: Outdoor Kitchen
programme.desc: Marlow, Phil, their 3 small kids, and Phil's parents all live in one crowded house. Brian and Sarah transform their yard into a spectacular space for cooking, entertaining and playing.

programme.title: Pub Paradise
programme.desc: Bachelor Kyle's father Jack has helped him renovate his new home, but the backyard is still unusable. To help Kyle throw the ultimate housewarming party, Brian and Sarah build a sexy sports pub, a lounge area and a fire pit.

programme.title: Outdoor Amphitheater
programme.desc: Jon, Trish, and their two children live in a quintessential family-friendly neighborhood. To give the whole community an outdoor space to enjoy, Brian and Sarah build an outdoor movie theater in their backyard.

programme.title: Inspiring Cake Studio
programme.desc: Tina and her husband Patrick have a home that is overrun with both baking supplies and soccer equipment. To extend this family's living space, Brian and Sarah turn their backyard into one part cake decorating studio and one part soccer field.

programme.title: Farm to Table
programme.desc: Andrea and David are foodies, but hosting in their "builder basic" yard is no fun. Brian and Sarah make their farm-to-table dreams come true, with a veggie garden, dining room, BBQ zone, and a play space for their 2 kids.

programme.title: Cottage in the City
programme.desc: Steve and Tanya are Realtors who just bought their forever home a few doors down from Tanya's parents. To complete their dream home, Brian and Sarah build a dream cottage retreat in their backyard.

programme.title: D.J.'s Den
programme.desc: Cool parents, Michelle and Adrian, are passionate about music and events. Brian and Sarah tune into their needs and amp up their boring backyard with a DJ den, a creative arts-and-crafts wall, and hang-out zones for family jam sessions.

programme.title: Treehouse Village
programme.desc: Debbie, Kevin, and their three children are a newly-blended family. To bring this new family together, Brian and Sarah build an irresistible treehouse village in their backyard.

programme.title: A Space For Dancing and Hanging
programme.desc: Susan's energetic son, Harrison, has no space to dance at home without getting under his mom's feet. Brian and Sarah build a hang-out / dance space for Harrison and create a California-inspired pool and lounge area for Susan.

programme.title: Neighborhood Party House
programme.desc: Nicole and Charles have 3 kids, and their neighborhood parties are getting too big for their front porch. So Brian and Sarah add more entertaining space in the backyard, plus a 4-season garage conversion with a nautical theme.

programme.title: Gentleman's Gym
programme.desc: Mom and son duo, Paul and Catharine, are overwhelmed by Paul's multi-level backyard. Paul also finds his current indoor fitness regime frustrating. Brian and Sarah muscle up to the challenge by building a gym in his backyard, alongside a hot tub.

programme.title: Parisian Escape
programme.desc: Paris lovers, Louise and Rick, want to share their European enthusiasm with their two daughters without racking up the mileage. Brian and Sarah build them a French-inspired urban escape. It's Paris in their backyard! C'est magnifique!

programme.title: Sports & Social Zone
programme.desc: France & Marc's home is being outgrown by their sport-obsessed sons and provides no inspiring space for France to work from home. Brian and Sarah convert a rundown garage into a spot where France can work and carved out safe sports areas.

programme.title: Cozy Leather Cabin Workshop
programme.desc: Brian and Sarah create a backyard for Pam & Kevin that matches their lush forest surrounding complete with a double wrap around deck and a hot tub. The team also build a workshop for Kevin to perfect his craft of leather tooling.

programme.title: Creative Lounge
programme.desc: Dave and Jorge love art and entertaining, but with tenants in their basement and no creative space inside, Brian and Sarah turn their backyard into a creative party lounge and build a shipping container-inspired structure for an industrial feel.

programme.title: Tropical Family Resort
programme.desc: Tammy and Sam are so busy, their backyard has fallen into disrepair and their 2 kids never use it. Brian and Sarah bring this yard back to life, and then some, with a new dining and lounge area and a fully functional pool house.

programme.title: Creative Shipping Container
programme.desc: Kirsten works from the home office, while Joel is a sales representative with a make-shift workspace in their bedroom. To help this couple, Brian and Sarah look to the backyard for space to retrofit an old shipping container into an office.

programme.title: Plunge Pool Paradise
programme.desc: Aarati & Dave both work from home, forcing their living room to be a triple duty working/living/children's play area. Brian and Sarah create a flexible structure, install a sleek and sophisticated plunge pool, and create an outdoor fireplace lounge.

programme.title: Pooch Party Pavillion
programme.desc: Carly & Nate's social media star dog, Dean the Basset Hound, has a lot of four-legged friends visiting, leaving the home feeling cramped. Brian and Sarah make a bar/lounge for pet and owner gatherings, along with a stylish outdoor entertainment area.

programme.title: Mom's Retreat
programme.desc: Melissa and Lee's 3 boys need more room for sports, and Mom needs more peace and quiet! So Brian and Sarah turn the underused backyard into a sports court, a new lounge space, and a luxurious, 3-season Mom's retreat.

programme.title: Life-Sized Sister Playhouse
programme.desc: Sandra & David's eldest daughter, Harlow, was born with vision challenges and their youngest daughter, Delilah, is just learning to walk. Brian and Sarah build a colorful playland for both children, while also building a decked out BBQ & dining area.

programme.title: Craft Studio
programme.desc: Jenn and Josh don't have enough space in their semi-detached home to enjoy their hobbies. Brian and Sarah build a stylish lounge space and convert the existing garage into a multipurpose space for crafting and playing guitar.

programme.title: His and Hers Hideaway
programme.desc: Miriam and Mark are busy parents to four kids under 10 years old. To help these hardworking parents unwind, Brian and Sarah build them a parents-only hideaway in their backyard.

programme.title: Wellness Wonderland
programme.desc: Breanna & Nick's life revolves around socializing and physical activity. Brian and Sarah convert an old, underused shed into a beautiful, zen'd out yoga studio and create backyard partying, lounging and dining areas.

programme.title: Country Supper Club & Coop
programme.desc: Ex-city slickers, Lauren and Mark, miss their friends and family from the city. Brian and Sarah create a country retreat with an outdoor pad, indoor dining lounge, and a chicken coop. When Lauren and Mark's friends visit, they'll never want to leave.

programme.title: Twins Clubhouse
programme.desc: Sham, Ruban and their twin boys aren't using their big, boring backyard. To help this family embrace the great outdoors, Brian and Sarah build a vacation style getaway, with a beach volleyball court and a kid's clubhouse.

programme.title: Hidden Escapes
programme.desc: Explore some unique and unusual hotels in the USA, Finland, Canada and Scotland — from a hotel hidden within one of New York's busiest airport runways to a winter wonderland in the Arctic Circle.

programme.title: Remote Hideaways
programme.desc: Explore some unique and unusual hotels in Jordan, England, Sweden, and Ecuador — from a desert resort that resembles a colony on Mars to a hotel in the clouds.

programme.title: Hidden Retreats
programme.desc: Uncover some truly remarkable and hidden retreats in Canada, Iceland, Sweden and the UK—from underwater sunken hotels to remote retreats surrounded by lava fields.

programme.title: Extreme Escapes
programme.desc: Explore some unique and unusual hotels in Cambodia, Italy, Wales, Sweden and England - from jungle retreats to converted caves.

programme.title: Hilltop Escapes
programme.desc: In search of unique and unusual hotels, travel to the Scottish wilderness, the Welsh mountains, a tower in Greece with a deadly history, and a hotel perched on a glacier in Italy.

programme.title: Invisible Hideaways
programme.desc: Explore some unique and unusual hotels in Uruguay, Sweden, Scotland, Oman and the Netherlands—from a camouflaged fort-like resort perched on the edge of a mountain to mainland Britain's most isolated hotel.

programme.title: Countryside Cabins
programme.desc: Jamie Feilden's 60-acre farm doubles as a charity for urban youth. To fund it, he now plans two prefabricated elliptical cabins on a remote slope. They'll feature timber decks, open-plan living, and green roofs—though weather may delay the build.

programme.title: Forest Treehouse
programme.desc: Delaval and Veronica are restoring 450 acres for conservation and funding it by building a treehouse in Swanton Novers Wood. A Scottish firm constructs it in 7 sections to minimize damage to the woodland habitat on delivery.

programme.title: Scotland's Island Cottage
programme.desc: Builder Justin and wife Emma tackle an ambitious modular home build on Scotland's remote North Uist.

programme.title: The Bushland Treehouse
programme.desc: Paul and Trent want to escape their busy lives to a 600-acre conservation property.

programme.title: Dream Island Home
programme.desc: After years traveling through Europe, Iain and Alyson are ready to put down roots. Their search takes them to Inner Hebridean Island of Skye where they purchase a remote half acre plot, but building a traditional house is a challenge.

programme.title: From Caravan to Dream Home
programme.desc: Sarah and Adam swap caravan life for their dream home in rural Cornwall.

programme.title: Countryside Cabins
programme.desc: Jamie Feilden's 60-acre farm doubles as a charity for urban youth. To fund it, he now plans two prefabricated elliptical cabins on a remote slope. They'll feature timber decks, open-plan living, and green roofs—though weather may delay the build.

programme.title: Love Interrupted
programme.desc: Sally Clements, Nick's ex-girlfriend, arrives at Drovers Run with news that is hard to conceal. She is heavily pregnant with Nick's child, conceived during the brief time when Nick was estranged from Tess.

programme.title: Twice Bitten
programme.desc: Tensions are rife with Kane now living in the cottage with Stevie, and Sally staying in the big house with Nick and Tess. Despite Kane's attempts to get 'straight' work, Stevie's suspicions are aroused when she witnesses him talking to Ray, his old car contact.

programme.title: No Man's Land
programme.desc: All the women of Drovers Run plan take on the big boys of the sheep industry at the annual Wool Board Expo, and Tess especially has thrown herself into various preparations to keep her mind off Sally and baby Harrison.

programme.title: Little White Lies
programme.desc: All the women of Drovers Run plan take on the big boys of the sheep industry at the annual Wool Board Expo, and Tess especially has thrown herself into various preparations to keep her mind off Sally and baby Harrison

programme.title: Rules of Disengagement
programme.desc: Meg heads home early from the city in hopes she can be of some comfort to Tess during her time out with Nick. But Meg has little success getting Tess to open up.

programme.title: Once Were Heroes
programme.desc: The stubborn side of Dave is exposed when he finds an injured horse and believes he has found a descendent, a Waler, of the first settlement horses. Meanwhile, Jodi's life is in a downward spiral as her continued absences from work force Stevie to fire her, and her personal life takes a hit too.

programme.title: Return of the Black Queen
programme.desc: Harry is secretly thrilled when he hears Sandra is back in town, however, their initial meeting doesn't go well when they aren't capable of confessing their love.

programme.title: Do You Read Me...?
programme.desc: Incapacitated by an injured foot, a bored Stevie has become addicted to the two-way radio, which causes her to get involved in with a mystery man. Meanwhile, Sandra offers Kate a farm manager's job.

programme.title: Taking Care of Business
programme.desc: The women of Drovers Run are no longer a team of four. Kate is now working with Sandra as an overseer at Kinsella's. Jodi has gone into business for herself, selling cosmetics, and the work is tough.

programme.title: Old Flames
programme.desc: When Kate organises a reunion of the high school hiking club, she isn't prepared for the old feelings it's about to stir up. For Jodi, the reunion is fraught with tension as she faces her old rival, Natalie, and she ends up introducing Luke as the local mechanic, rather than as her boyfriend.

programme.title: Body Blows
programme.desc: When Harry suffers a stroke, he reconsiders his plans for Killarney and he makes it clear that he favours Nick over Alex.

programme.title: Sins of the Father
programme.desc: Nick discovers that Harry's heart condition could be quite serious and he goes into denial. Helping Tess with the hay, he works recklessly and has a frightful accident with the hay bales.

programme.title: Boy Made Good
programme.desc: Will Hamilton, an old boyfriend from Stevie's school days in Broken Hill shows up at Drovers Run. He is also the father of Rose, a daughter he has no idea exists. Will is at first shocked to learn he is a father but delights Stevie by wanting to know all about their daughter.

programme.title: The Pearl
programme.desc: In trouble again, Luke promises a concerned Jodi that he will extricate himself from the criminal's grasp, but his problems only escalate. Stevie urges Jodi to distance herself from Luke, but Jodi needs to give him one final chance. She rushes to the truck stop and is shattered to discover drugs hidden in Luke's wardrobe.

programme.title: The Prodigal Daughter
programme.desc: Tess's other cousin, Regan, visits Drovers Run and causes a few problems. Ultimately, Stevie must rely on Regan's help to escape a life-threatening farm accident and Regan must face her fears to save Stevie.

programme.title: Love and Obsession
programme.desc: Dave and Regan's flirtation steps up a level when Dave offers to help cure her of her animal phobia. As they fall for each other, Kate realises Regan has a secret she'll do anything to protect.

programme.title: One Long, Long Day
programme.desc: Tess learns Nick has been offered a job in Argentina and she makes the difficult decision that they will go overseas for six months. Meanwhile, Stevie takes care of Charlotte for the afternoon, but when the child goes missing, she turns Drovers Run upside down to find her. As Dave and Regan's romance blossoms, Kate is devastated.

programme.title: Down to Earth
programme.desc: Things are in a state of flux, if not panic, with the imminent departure of Tess and Nick. Stevie is now in charge, and she decides Kate and Jodi need to sort out who's going to take on her old overseer's job.

programme.title: Heart of Gold
programme.desc: When Regan starts the process to mine Drovers Run, the other women put up a fight and vow to stop her.

programme.title: Taking Flight
programme.desc: Today is Harry's birthday and he's in a foul mood. Alex is stuck giving Sandra a lift to Gungellan so that she can get to an appointment. Kate tries to avoid Dave during a birdcall competition, but he makes it difficult.

programme.title: Make Believe
programme.desc: Kate's grandmother comes for a visit and Kate is in hot water because her grandmother believes that she's engaged to Dave and she runs Drovers Run.

programme.title: Heaven and Earth
programme.desc: Harry buys the truck stop and appoints Moira as manager, leaving Terry as a lowly mechanic. The approach of a raging dust storm adds to the troubles at Drovers Run and Stevie struggles to save the life of Tess's horse Oscar.

programme.title: Moonstruck
programme.desc: Stevie borrows a water pump but leaves without the right hose when she learns that Alex won't be taking her to the ball. The wrong hose causes a tank to fill with toxic gas, and Alex shows up to help, but he is overcome by the fumes.

programme.title: If You Build It...
programme.desc: Stevie locks horns with Sandra during a drought but later helps her through a personal crisis, which temporarily eases tensions between them.

programme.title: Out of Time
programme.desc: Stevie thrilled at the prospect of a visit from Rose but things sour when Stevie's sister Michelle arrives with her. Protective of her adopted daughter, Michelle doesn't want the usually rash Stevie to take matters into her own hands and tell Rose the truth about who her real mother is.

programme.title: Betwixt and Between
programme.desc: Caught off guard when Rose discovers a baby's hospital bracelet, Stevie tells a half-truth: she did have a baby, but she put it up for adoption. Rose finds out the whole truth and takes off in the ute, accidentally reversing into the cattle yard gates.

programme.title: Truth or Dare
programme.desc: Patrick, Dave's adventurer brother literally parachutes onto Drovers Run and ensnares Kate's heart. In the wake of Patrick's appearance, Dave must deal with painful memories and a shocking family secret that's been hidden for years.

programme.title: The King and I
programme.desc: Jodi is on top of the world when she receives a birthday gift from the deceased Jack McLeod. Meanwhile, Dave begins training a new veterinary student. Alex wants to get out of doing an interview for local radio, which Harry has delegated to him.

programme.title: Intentions
programme.desc: Dave is forced to question his behaviour when his former student, Catriona, threatens him with a sexual harassment suit. Meanwhile, after confronting Meg about Jack's gift to her, Jodi feels that her whole life has been a lie.

programme.title: Stranger Than Fiction
programme.desc: Meg agonises over Jodi's rejection of her, following the revelation that Jack McLeod is possibly her real father. Jodi reads her mother's novel, which is based on real life and details the mystery surrounding her birth.

programme.title: Twelve and A Half Hours Behind
programme.desc: When Tess returns home to Drovers Run, she discovers the exciting news that she's pregnant. Her joy is soon turned to grief, though, when a call comes from Argentina saying that the plane Nick was traveling on has been reported missing.

programme.title: Anniversary
programme.desc: Tess has been holed up in her room since the news of Nick's death, but she suddenly reappears, strong and composed. She throws herself back into work and declares she wants to hold a party to celebrate Nick's life.

programme.title: Body & Soul
programme.desc: Determined that the Ryan empire continues despite Nick's death, Harry quickly sets about organising his grandson's future, while Alex goes a.w.o.l after Nick's life celebration.

programme.title: New Beginnings
programme.desc: After a vivid dream, Stevie can no longer deny the love she has developed for Alex, but she struggles to tell him. Meanwhile, Harry pushes for his grandson to live near him, despite objections from Sandra, and Jodi gets the results of her DNA test

programme.title: Lost and Found
programme.desc: A week has passed since the fire and Alex's mysterious disappearance, but then he returns with his new fiancée and he unknowingly breaks Stevie's heart. Just when Tess is starting to get on top of things, she gets a call that sets her back: Nick's remains have been found.

programme.title: Truth Hurts
programme.desc: Alex and Fiona's engagement is publicly announced thanks to a meddling Harry. Meanwhile, a jealous Stevie, prompted by Dave, looks into Fiona's past and discovers something shocking. Meanwhile, Tess asks Jodi to move into the main house.

programme.title: Kiss of Death
programme.desc: Stevie is trying to deal with the fact that Alex may never be hers. She brings home a very young guy for the night, a move which ultimately endangers the land of Drovers Run. Meanwhile, Jodi comforts Rob and they are brought closer together when he reveals a secret.

programme.title: Luck Be A Lady
programme.desc: After the crop-dusting incident, Drovers has lost its contracts for organic produce and the women struggle to keep the bank from taking over. Trying to help, Stevie ends up gambling away Drover money.

programme.title: The Real McLeod
programme.desc: Jodi is stunned when Tess offers her half her share of Drovers Run. Tess feels that Jodi should have equity in the family heritage, as well as sharing their current debt. Leo, the pilot who dumped pesticide on Drovers Run, returns and tries to make Harry lift the black ban placed on him.

programme.title: The Calling
programme.desc: Kate falls and when Dave gives her a cursory examination, he notices a small sunspot on her back. After numerous attempts to convince her to see a doctor, Dave abducts Kate and drives her to the Gungellan GP.

programme.title: What Lies Beneath
programme.desc: Nick returns home to Drovers Run but is troubled by shadowy flashbacks of Argentina and his mugging. Meanwhile, Kate secretly goes to see a cancer specialist in the city, but Jodi figures out that something is going on and follows her.

programme.title: Where The Heart Is
programme.desc: Nick is anxious to start up the cattle breeding program he never had the chance to realise in Argentina. Tess and Stevie move Phoenix to a safer paddock, but another visit from the Brumbies leads to the discovery that she is already pregnant, no doubt to the brumby stallion.

programme.title: Deliver Us From Evil
programme.desc: Jodi risks her own life in an attempt to save Rob from the hitman that is hunting him, and with her courage, common sense and bushcraft, they survive the daylight risk. Meanwhile, Dave's brother Patrick returns with a truckload of "liberated" goats.

programme.title: The Big Commitment
programme.desc: When Patrick is blinded in a farming accident, he must rely on Kate for help. Stevie and Fiona take on a dodgy horse dealer, gaining a new-found respect for each other. Meanwhile, Meg and Terry adopt a new dream together.

programme.title: Biting the Bullet
programme.desc: When Regan returns to Drovers Run, she reveals a tragic secret. Though Tess has left, Jodi, Kate, and Stevie allow her to stay. Meanwhile, Fiona learns she is infertile but hides this information from Alex.

programme.title: Second Best
programme.desc: When Harry's stud ram is stolen, the Drovers Run women unmask an unlikely sheep rustler. Stevie ends up as Alex's backup best man in case Nick is not back from Argentina in time for the wedding.

programme.title: The Trouble With Harry
programme.desc: Jodi is driving back to Drovers Run when her phone rings. For a split second, she takes her eyes off the road and collides with a ute that Harry was driving. Meanwhile, the Japanese trade delegation visits to make an export deal with 'Gungellan Fresh'.

programme.title: The Legend of Harry Ryan
programme.desc: As he prepares for his father's funeral, Alex becomes obsessed with finding out why Harry had secreted away so many things. Stevie struggles to tell Alex that she argued with Harry on the day he died, and fears that it might have prompted the heart attack that killed him.

programme.title: Second Chances
programme.desc: Kevin returns unexpectedly and Jodi tells him the news about her real father. He isn't too surprised, though, and Jodi is later devastated to find he was just trying to access her inheritance money.

programme.title: Secrets and Lies
programme.desc: The day before the big wedding has arrived and Stevie makes a shocking discovery that Fiona has been lying to Alex about being pregnant. Meanwhile, Kate decides to try on Fiona's dress and manages to stain it.

programme.title: The Life of Riley
programme.desc: After a group of brumbies are found shot dead, the girls of Drovers Run suspect a handsome stranger named Riley. Meanwhile, Sandra moves back into Killarney in hopes of carrying out Harry's legacy while Alex is absent

programme.title: Wild Horses
programme.desc: Stevie and Riley have gone into partnership to train the brumbies they saved from the national park, but they clash over techniques when they must have a horse ready for sale in one day. Meanwhile, Sandra and Fiona realise they're at a stalemate when they both secure damaging information about the other.

programme.title: The Great Temptation
programme.desc: Regan's horse-riding lessons have paid off. She is feeling confident in her ability and excited by the prospect of riding with the Drovers Cross Country team. After a mistake, Regan discovers that Drovers Run lost a contract to Sandra because she caused a paratyphoid outbreak in some cattle.

programme.title: Suspicious Minds
programme.desc: When evidence begins to mount against Stevie, Kate starts to believe that she could be the cause of Harry Ryan's death and must decide if she should go to the police with her suspicions. Meanwhile, Riley learns a local trainer abuses his horses and plans to do something about it.

programme.title: Days of Reckoning
programme.desc: Kate, who went to the police with her suspicions about Stevie's involvement in Harry's death, struggles to deal with the consequences of her actions. Alex returns from Argentina to find much has changed since he left, and he's got a lot to handle straight away.

programme.title: Scratch the Surface
programme.desc: The women of Drovers Run are determined to discover who killed Harry Ryan. When Leo returns to the district and locks horns with Stevie, she becomes convinced that he is the killer. Meanwhile, Alex discovers that Fiona has lied about her pregnancy.

programme.title: For Better Or Worse
programme.desc: Taking a short cut along the stock route, Moira is horrified when her petrol tanker has a dangerous fuel spill on Drovers Run. Meanwhile, Jodi and Kate struggle to make a decision about the future of the ranch given the possibility that Stevie may go to jail.

programme.title: The Eleventh Hour
programme.desc: Steve is busy trying to tie up loose ends before her trial begins, and Fiona joins the CFS in an attempt to show Alex how she can integrate herself into the town. When Alex and Riley are away from Killarney, doors all over the property are left open.

programme.title: Old Wrongs
programme.desc: Stevie's daughter, Rose, is coming to stay for a month, and it's the first time they've seen each other in two years. Stevie hopes to rebuild their relationship, but Rose is clear that she is only here for work experience.

programme.title: Garden State Ghost
programme.desc: Plumbers, Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson moonlight as Ghost Hunters, leading an intrepid team called T.A.P.S. (The Atlantic Paranormal Society) through investigations of churches, inns and infamous jails.

programme.title: Fort Delaware
programme.desc: Plumbers, Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson moonlight as Ghost Hunters, leading an intrepid team called T.A.P.S. (The Atlantic Paranormal Society) through investigations of churches, inns and infamous jails.

programme.title: Iron Island
programme.desc: Plumbers, Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson moonlight as Ghost Hunters, leading an intrepid team called T.A.P.S. (The Atlantic Paranormal Society) through investigations of churches, inns and infamous jails.

programme.title: So I Married an Axe Murderer
programme.desc: This week TAPS heads to Simsbury, CT to the old Pettibone Tavern to solve the legendary story of the ghost of Abigail. The tavern has been a stop off for George Washington, Harriett Beacher Stowe, John Adams. It was used as a stop off for slaves during the underground railroad. Pettibone's daughter Abigail, was married to a sailor.

programme.title: The Boy in the Brothel
programme.desc: TAPS heads to North Kingstown, Rhode Island to investigate the unexplainable paranormal events that are haunting a local restaurant. Linda, the skeptical owner of the Hoofinfeathers Carriage Inn, is hoping to uncover the truth behind the bizarre stories plaguing her establishment. The reports of disembodied voices and phantom-like apparitions have frightened some of her guests and terrorized her staff.

programme.title: Speaking with the Dead
programme.desc: This week, TAPS returns to Buffalo, NY to investigate the abandoned remains of the Buffalo Central Terminal. Once lively, it was a hub of transportation, but in 1979, the last train left the station and the terminal closed its doors for good. Today, the terminal has started to undergo substantial renovations which some believe stirred up the ghostly entities that dwell there.

programme.title: Ghost of the Sunshine State
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Ocala, Florida to investigate an old inn. The Inn has seen numerous stories from a housekeeper being knocked and held down on the floor to the sighting of a cigar smoking man. Full-bodied apparitions have been spotted everywhere and employees have mentioned on several occasions tripping and falling down the stairs only to be stopped in mid-fall by something and saved from crashing through the wall or window.

programme.title: Oak Alley Plantation
programme.desc: TAPS heads to New Orleans to investigate an old Creole Plantation in the heart of the bayou. Oak Alley Plantation was settled by French settlers and became a booming operation that produced sugar cane and pecans. In the alley of oak trees the sounds of a carriage is heard coming up the lane and sometimes even dust blows up giving the appearance that a carriage is moving towards the home. This is a place where rich history is surrounded by the grim realities of life way back when.

programme.title: Bottled Spirits
programme.desc: This week, a frightened, young mother asks TAPS to help her terrorized son. The first time Heather brought her son Aiden home she noticed what sounded like a man whispering coming through on his radio. This home has been replaced with ghostly shadows and toys that inexplicably turn themselves on at night.

programme.title: Home Town Haunts
programme.desc: This week, TAPS follows up a TAPS Family investigation that may have turned up the paranormal activity in a residential home to 11. Troy LeBlanc's 19th century 4400 sq.ft. Victorian home is with two separate living quarters-Troy lives in the upstairs portion, his parents downstairs. When he first bought the house, there were constant footsteps coming from all over the house and doors would fly open and hit Troy.

programme.title: U.S.S. Hornet
programme.desc: TAPS heads to The Bay area to investigate an aircraft carrier rumored to be the most haunted ship in the Navy, the USS Hornet. A person supposedly committed suicide in the room and a 75-pound wrench was moved by something not human. It is said; on the main hangar there is a helicopter that served in Vietnam. It is rumored that the pilot still walks out of it and then disappears. There are all types of paranormal activity throughout this ship.

programme.title: Live Halloween Results: Haunted Farmhouse
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Topsfield, Massachusetts to investigate an old haunted farmhouse. The owner, Linda is afraid to sleep in her old home that she has raised 3 children in. In the attic, a hand touched Linda, and she fell down the stairs. Doors shut and lock by themselves trapping people. They yell for help, but know one hears them. During the investigation, Jason and Grant have hanger thrown at them twice.

programme.title: All Access
programme.desc: Fresh off the success of the 2008 live Halloween investigation of Fort Delaware, Josh Gates hosts the second roundtable discussion with the members of TAPS. Sitting in the Soldiers' Barracks of Fort Delaware, Josh revisits old shows and asks questions about the technology, techniques, and future of TAPS. Among many other things, we hear about Steve's penchant for touching anything he sees, Tango's inability to turn down a dare, and the correct way to operate a K2 meter.

programme.title: Recycled Souls
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Clovis, California to investigate a run down Sanitarium. Joining the team will be a fellow TAPS member from Northern California, Amy Bruni who has investigated here before. Reports of shadows appear to come right at you only to disappear. During renovations, 911 calls would mysteriously manifest from the home only to not have any phones to speak of in the whole building.

programme.title: Spirits on the Water
programme.desc: TAPS goes to the Maritime Museum of San Diego to investigate the oldest active ship in the world, the Star of India, and her slipmate, the steam ferryboat Berkeley. The Star of India was built back in 1863 on the Isle of Man, originally christened as the Euterpe. On her first voyage, to India, the iron windjammer suffered a collision and her crew mutinied. The second trip didn't go even that well - she was trapped in a cyclone and her first captain died at sea.

programme.title: Portmouth Harbor Light House
programme.desc: This week, TAPS is called in to investigate the Portsmouth Harbor Lighthouse and Fort Constitution on Coast Guard Property. Caption Joshua card, an old lighthouse keeper, haunts the walkway to the lighthouse wearing a pea coat and hat. Near the powder magazine there has been sightings of a green mist where 14 people died in a massive forth of July explosion. The scene is historic and it's rumored that their spirits still haunt the fort.

programme.title: Betsy Ross House
programme.desc: A family living in a Revolutionary War era house in Pennsylvania fears for their child and urgently calls on the TAPS team for help. Jason and Grant have some extreme K2 hits and their own first hand experience with a shaking bed to confirm the many frightening claims. They leave the Hannum family with tools to help them deal with the entities that share their home

programme.title: Star Island
programme.desc: The TAPS team braves the wintery waters of the Atlantic to investigate Star Island off of the coast of Portsmouth, NH. Founded as a fishing village in the 1600's the island is ripe with activity and home to a suicide pact gone wrong. Jason and Grant collect some shocking EVP's and are joined by Kristyn Gartland who takes on the challenge of investigating one of the most dangerous claims.

programme.title: Edith Wharton Estate
programme.desc: TAPS is the first team to investigate The Mount in Lenox, MA, the astounding estate of famous author Edith Wharton. Claims of a jealous spirit, a crouching apparition, disembodied screams, and countless reports of footsteps are just some of the many reports haunting the century-old site. The TAPS team is challenged to cover all of the ground and to find out if Edith Wharton herself remains on the estate she once considered her retreat.

programme.title: Club Dead
programme.desc: The TAPS team travels south to Ybor City, Florida to the historic Cuban Club. Once the center of Cuban social life, the commemorated building is now the center of paranormal activity. While investigating Grant makes contact with an entity in the theatre and Britt Griffith joins the team in gathering enough evidence to confirm the club is still active with ghosts.

programme.title: Soul Searching
programme.desc: For the first time ever, TAPS revisits Belcourt Castle in Newport, Rhode Island to investigate claims surrounding a deceased friend. It's been ten years since TAPS investigated the 19th century castle and they are back with more sophisticated equipment to tackle old and new claims that persist in the manor. While investigating Jason and Grant catch a thermal hit that defies explanation and Kris and Amy catch an EVP that could be the ghost of former castle owner Mr. Tinney himself.

programme.title: Titanic Terror
programme.desc: TAPS gets on board the Titanic Exhibit at the Georgia Aquarium in Atlanta to investigate paranormal claims that have traveled around the world with the artifacts. A TAPS family member group reached out to the team to determine if it's really paranormal activity, or just the tragic tale of the sinking ship that haunts the exhibit. A unique challenge for the team, Kris questions how to approach the case and Jason and Grant encounter some physical contact with an invisible force.

programme.title: Crossing Over
programme.desc: TAPS calls in the GHI team to investigate the Spalding Inn, a historic property in Whitefield, New Hampshire owned by Jason and Grant. For over 80 years, numerous guests have reported seeing mysterious black masses, hearing strange voices, and being touched by something not visible. During their investigation, GHI team members Robb and Dustin chase a mysterious force through the kitchen, while Barry and Joe confront an elusive entity in the carriage house.

programme.title: Garden State Asylum
programme.desc: The TAPS team travels to New Jersey to investigate the infamous Essex County Hospital. The century-old site is reportedly haunted by some of the estimated 10,000 souls that died there. Numerous witnesses have reported seeing the apparition of a nurse, hearing voices calling for help, and even being physically grabbed. While investigating the miles of tunnels that run underneath the hospital, Jason and Grant capture a thermal image which defies explanation.

programme.title: Inhuman Entity
programme.desc: The TAPS team answers a call from a family in Blackstone, Massachusetts being plagued by a demonic entity. The Ladouceurs had always experienced strange events in their beloved home, but once major renovations began the benign activity turned violent. During the investigation, the team experiences a series of bizarre encounters including Jason being physically attacked.

programme.title: I Am Not Guilty
programme.desc: The TAPS team investigates the home of Dr. Samuel Mudd, an alleged conspirator to the assassination of Abraham Lincoln. Mudd was convicted for his role in the plot even though the evidence was highly circumstantial. Today, apparitions and other strange activity have been witnessed inside, and directly outside, the house. Through their investigation, the team uncovers evidence that Mudd may be trying to prove his innocence from beyond the grave.

programme.title: Civil War Spirits
programme.desc: The site of the bloodiest battle of the Revolutionary War sets the stage for an unforgettable investigation by TAPS. For decades, residents and visitors of Thornbury Farm have experienced horrifying events including the voice of a moaning child and the apparition of a soldier with a bloody limb. The team's overnight investigation yields shocking findings, including direct contact with a paranormal presence.

programme.title: Judgment Day
programme.desc: TAPS calls in Bruce Tango, father of Dave Tango, to help investigate a place close to his heart, the Union County Courthouse, a historic property in Elizabeth, NJ, Over the years, many staff members have reported phones ringing without anyone on the lines and seeing apparitions roaming the halls who is known to be of Hannah Coldwell or the four men who died at the hands of capital punishment, who haunt the halls of these historic building.

programme.title: Little Drummer Boy
programme.desc: TAPS has received an urgent call for help from a Chicago community center whose patrons are being chased away by a variety of menacing spirits. The Benton House is a historic set of two buildings that have served the city of Chicago for a century. Through the years, a number of residents have expired on the property from devastating illness.

programme.title: A Bat Out of Hell
programme.desc: This week TAPS heads to Thousand Island, NY to investigate a 4-acre private island and is joined by the " King of Rock and Roll" himself, Meatloaf. The 4-acre private island owned by the Claudia family houses a four-story, ten-bedroom mansion and a three-story, seven-bedroom boathouse. The immediate family of six resides in the boathouse while the mansion serves as guest quarters for visitors. The property has been in the family for fifty years and has always had a haunted history.

programme.title: Glimmer Men
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Quincy, Massachusetts to investigate the unexplainable paranormal events that are haunting a 716 foot long ship. The USS Salem spent decades sailing the oceans of the world as a witness to untold death and damage. In 1953, a large earthquake struck the Ionian Islands in Greece, completely devastating the communities and killing hundreds. The USS Salem was the first American ship to arrive on the scene and provided relief supplies and assistance.

programme.title: Fort Henry
programme.desc: This week, TAPS is called in to investigate the Fort Henry, where it once served as a cornerstone for Canada's military defense and execution site. Today, Fort Henry is considered by many to be the most haunted place in Canada. One frequently reported incident involves a male apparition seen wandering around the exterior and interiors of the fortress.

programme.title: Congress Theatre
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Chicago Illinois to investigate a Chicago landmark for nearly a century, the Congress Theater. Built in 1926, the massive building's original Italian Renaissance architecture remains mostly preserved. The Congress has transitioned through the decades of Chicago history and exists today as a renowned live concert venue. According to many present and past employees, there is also something undeniably paranormal present at the theater.

programme.title: Rocky Mountain Hauntings
programme.desc: This week TAPS answers the Wrights begging call heads to Manitou Springs, Colorado to investigate the Briarhurst Manor located at the base of Pike's Peak. The property was built in 1888 by Englishman William Bell and has had about 20 owners throughout the years. The property was made into apartment buildings in the early 70's and then became a restaurant now owned by Ken Healey. One of the prior owners Mrs.

programme.title: Ghost Buffalo Bill
programme.desc: The TAPS team has been called to wrangle some ghosts that seem to be haunting the resting place of Buffalo Bill. The museum staff has asked the TAPS team to help them figure out if the old cowboy has made this site his final rest stop. Cody died in Denver in 1917 and his final request was to be buried on Lookout Mountain with views of the mountains and plains where he spent most of his life.

programme.title: New Hampshire Gothic
programme.desc: The TAPS team heads to New Hampshire to help a group of volunteers figure out what is causing the lively paranormal activity in their otherwise quiet museum. The Amos J. Blake House was originally built in 1837 as a commercial building that was used for both business and to house tenants. Several deaths have occurred in the house, mostly children, before the turn of the 20th century. Amos J. Blake moved into the house with his wife Lizzie in the 1860's.

programme.title: Pensacola Lighthouse
programme.desc: TAPS heads to the Florida Panhandle to investigate a notoriously haunted lighthouse with over a century's worth of paranormal reports. Located on the Pensacola Naval Air Station, home of the Blue Angels, the Lighthouse stands 160 feet above Pensacola Bay and the Florida Gulf Coast. The beacon ranges in diameter from 30 feet at the base to 15 feet at the top and is total of 177 steps.

programme.title: Mark Twain House
programme.desc: TAPS is called to the former home of one of the world's most famous authors in order to investigate a series of startling paranormal occurrences. Mark Twain and his family occupied this architecturally unique house for nearly 20 years. After his daughter died in the home, Twain and his family abandoned the property. Today, the curators of the house are plagued with an array of strange sights and sounds.

programme.title: Unexplained Phenomena
programme.desc: This week, TAPS takes a call from the American Legion in Pennsylvania where people are terrified by paranormals. The building was established in the 1700s and was once rented out as apartments. The current owners have had the property since 1974 and are convinced that the place is haunted, so TAPS heads in to find out. Jason and Grant begin the hunt on the third floor where the current owner says she's too afraid to go.

programme.title: Hindenburg Crash Site
programme.desc: In the exciting season finale, TAPS travels to the site where Hindenburg, one of history's most infamous disasters, took place. The Hindenburg was a German airship filled with hydrogen for buoyancy. In 1937, while trying to dock at the Lakehurst Naval base, it caught fire and killed 36 people. The entire ordeal was caught on film and is still one of the most famous tragedies that have ever been reported.

programme.title: Alcatraz Island
programme.desc: For the 100th episode of Ghost Hunters, the team is allowed private access to Alcatraz Island, a dream come true for paranormal teams. From a two day prison revolt in 1946 known as the Battle of Alcatraz that occurred, people say they can still hear gun fire and crying. In Cell Block D, otherwise known as solitary confinement, there is a report of a run in with a spirit. Other activity reported is that of an apparition of a prisoner with glaring red eyes, and the sound of screams.

programme.title: Fort Ticonderoga
programme.desc: Fort Ticonderoga, located in upstate New York, is being haunted by the dead from three nations and needs help from the TAPS team. The fort was built in 1755 by the French army, and would be witness to several bloody battles over the next two decades. The British army suffered 2,000 casualties; it was the most devastating battle on American soil until the Civil War. Due largely to the amount of violence and death that took place, there is lots of paranormal activity reported.

programme.title: Shamrock Spirits
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team has been asked to go to Paddy Reilly's Bar in Manhattan, New York to help explain some after hours activity. Dark shadows have been seen in the basement, voices have been heard, glasses are known to move on their own, and bottles break for no apparent reason. In an upstairs apartment, three men saw an apparition riding a bike, and across the hall a tenant saw a man resembling Gene Hackman peering through a window.

programme.title: Phantom of Jersey
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team visits the Absecon Lighthouse in Atlantic City, NJ. This lighthouse has activity reported ranging from untraceable footsteps and doors opening spontaneously, to coughing coming from the keeper's quarters. In the lighthouse itself, people have reported smelling cigar smoke, hearing voices and laughter, and even seeing a persons hand.Jason and Grant start out in the tower, where they hear a possible conversation and footsteps.

programme.title: Touched By Evil
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to The Southern Mansion in Cape May, NJ, and have enlisted the help of Dave Tango's father, Bruce. Bruce has experienced first hand some of the reported activity here; some of it includes glasses dissolving into sand, people being grabbed, a soldier walking through walls, a soldier talking with a woman, and the smell of gardenias. It is believed that the ghost woman could possibly be the niece of the original owner, Esther.

programme.title: Haunted Reform School
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters the TAPS team investigates Preston Castle, a once notorious reform school for boys in Northern California. People have seen apparitions of a man in a white coat in the doctor's office. The infirmary seems to be haunted by a boy that was shot while trying to escape the school. Upstairs there are claims of humming noises, groups of voices, a mist and a woman who claims she was pinched on the butt.

programme.title: Ghosts in the Attic
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS has been called to the Grzelak house in Massachusetts where they have been experiencing paranormal activity since the day they moved in 30 years ago. A series of apparitions, shadow people, mysterious voices and even physical attacks have left the Grzelaks desperate for help, to the point where they want to move.

programme.title: Inn of the Dead
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called to Cape Cod to investigate the Orleans Inn. Some of the claims here are that candles light on their own, glasses slide off tables, hauntings by two separate men who hung themselves, doors opening and closing, and ghosts of naked women. Despite all this, the strangest claim comes from Room 5, where two separate guests have checked in and been driven to insanity inside the room.

programme.title: Spirits of the Night
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS visits the home of the Scully family, who are so terrified they are ready to pack up and move. Some of the activities reported in the house are confrontational shadows, spirits breathing down people's necks and, adult legs walking up the stairs. The greatest activity is in the 4-year-old son's bedroom, where he spends his time with the spirits of 2 small children, and talks to them as well as about them.

programme.title: Norwhich State
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS becomes the first paranormal team to be invited to investigate Norwich State Hospital, in Norwich, Connecticut. There have been lots of rumors of activity, including moving shadows, haunting faces, screams, moans, and apparitions of children. Excited to start investigating, Jason and Grant start out in the research building and right away they see a moving shadow followed by a strange noise, and faint light in the stairway.

programme.title: Haunted Hotel
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS drives to the Otesaga Resort Hotel in Cooperstown, NY. Employees are terrified by voices calling out to them and doors swinging all on their own. Guests in the hotel also hear non-existent children running the halls and furniture being dragged across the floor upstairs (even on the top floor), while shadows and orbs have been seen and moaning has been heard. Jason and Grant start out in the ballroom, and try to debunk the claim of an orb.

programme.title: Uninvited Guests
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS has been asked to help the 1875 Inn in Tilton, New Hampshire. The Inn has had two major fires, one of which supposedly took the life of a child named Laura, who now haunts the hotel. One claim is that about 30 people saw a gargoyle-like creature suspended in the air. Another claim is hair being stroked, and there are numerous "Laura" encounters.
