And see what the right care and attention can do for Rex.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Is one-eyed Maltese Harlie the right remedy for Karin, who is looking for a furry friend after an accident left her mostly immobile? Could German shepherd Seth's size be too much for gentle Sheppy?

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Lanita and her two grown-up kids meet a dog with a rough backstory, mum of five Danielle wants a furry friend to keep her company and avid cyclists Jo and Jarvie are ready to join the dog club.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: New Kiwis, the Bolton family meet a cheeky puppy. Kate and Neill are ready for a new four-legged friend after a bereavement and flatmates Amanda and Rob look for a canine addition.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Single Dad Rinesh and his two girls are looking for a puppy. Newlyweds Heidi and Steve are excited to rescue a fur baby and sisters Sally and Megan met a nervous dog with a traumatic history.

programme.title: Episode 13
programme.desc: Julian faces a massive challenge trying to save one of the biggest calves he's ever had to deliver. And farmer Rob, who lost a newborn two days ago, is fearing the worst.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: A young Ewe is struggling to birth, her not so little lamb has his head stuck which puts both their lives in jeopardy. If Peter pulls him out, it could kill mum, but a caesarean will take too long for the baby. They must make a difficult decision.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Peter treats two wild owls brought into his practice. Shona rushes to the aid of a horse that has trodden on a nail. Julian has to learn sign language in order to communicate with a deaf dachshund that requires surgery.

programme.title: Episode 11
programme.desc: Near Harrogate, Julian rushes to an emergency call out to see Cheryl the cow. When Julian delves further, he discovers her conditions are rare and it's serious. Going downhill rapidly, time is of the essence. Can Julian save Cheryl's life?

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Peter is tasked with castrating an over-amorous chinchilla, and devoted owner Rodney faces putting down his much-loved sheepdog, Millie. Elsewhere in the programme is a three-foot-monitor lizard that tends to bite and not let go, and a house-trained pig that is supposed to be 'micro', but in truth she is anything but.

programme.title: A 5 Legged Lamb and Other Curious Creatures
programme.desc: Over on young vet Katy's family farm a baby has arrived that everyone is talking about. A lamb has been born with five fully-formed legs! Peter is on a wild peacock chase when young male Percy turns up on a housing estate and ruffles some feathers.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: Staff tend to a poodle with a problem penis, a rabbit with an abscess, a cow with a neck wound and an overly-amorous donkey before gathering to say farewell to Sarah who is leaving to have a baby.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Peter battles to deliver lambs who are jumbled up and stuck inside their mum, and he is shocked by what he finds. Julian has to contend with an angry parrot that has escaped in the surgery. A rescue dog is attacked by another dog.

programme.title: Wetland Babies
programme.desc: This day takes place in some of the wetlands of the world with cygnets and baby crocodiles among the babies featured.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Julian battles to save a young cow who's prolapsed her uterus giving birth. Peter rushes to help a choking lamb and also meets Jemima - a little duck with a big attitude. Katy and Julian join forces to try to save a desperately ill, 6-month-old puppy.

programme.title: Episode 12
programme.desc: Can loving deaf couple Danni and Salomon break through cute cavoodle Milo's separation anxiety and will unconventional priest Steve and partner Fiona be the right match for abused border collie Bear'

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Star, a 3-legged sheep, might be given a new lease of life if Matt can fit her with a prosthetic leg. Julian meets Teddy, a 10-month-old dachshund and his owner Kerry, who believes Teddy saved her life when she went into cardiac arrest.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: The RSPCA are called to the aid of elderly crossbreed, Ben. In Lancashire, a couple must improve their living conditions or face losing their beloved Bichon Frise. We catch up with Molly. On Valentine's Day, Cardiologist Chris Linney tries to fix the tiny Terrier's broken heart. And see the incredible transformation of Zeus, a Dogue de Bordeaux is given a second chance.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Julian Norton receives an emergency call from alpaca breeder Jackie, whose prize-winning female Cinderella is having a difficult labour. Peter Wright has to castrate Larry the chinchilla who is responsible for a population explosion.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Missy the Shih tzu was surrendered with her four offspring when her owner died. She really needs some love and so does beautiful artistic Toni, who's waited 50 years to get a dog.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Julian gets a panic-stricken call from Alpaca farmer, Jackie Barlow. Two of her alpacas, Gavroche and Francesca, have sneaked into the barn and gorged themselves on the food stash. They're struggling to breathe, foaming at the mouth and choking. At Skeldale, Julian faces one of his toughest challenges to date - Bertram the Bloodhound has a nasty tumour, as big as an egg, above his eye.

programme.title: Baby Animals From Africa
programme.desc: We are going on safari through Africa. Catch some Jackal pups in action as they show off their best wrestling moves, be impressed at the way Gorilla babies put their own goofy spin on things.Don't miss the Cheetah cubs zipping around playing Tag.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: In this episode Peter braves the elements and heads out to pregnancy test a small herd of young cows. But the farm is on high ground and with heavy snow settling on Yorkshire's hills will winter's icy grip prevent him from getting there?

programme.title: Baby Animals From Polar Regions
programme.desc: We visit the young, hardy inhabitants of the Polar regions. A flock of zippy Dall lambs tearing around the frosty mountaintops. There's also an adorable litter of cuddly Polar Bear cubs in the north or some goofy Elephant seal pups in the south.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Inspector Helen Smith saves Turner and Hooch, two Dogue de Bordeauxs found abandoned in a garden. Inspector Becky Bedson tracks down a dog that was spotted stranded in a flood relief channel. It's a freezing day so she needs to act fast. Shih Tzu Olive was found on a building site, heavily matted and in pain. And meet Pepper, the Dalmatian stealing hearts across Merseyside.

programme.title: Episode 12
programme.desc: After enjoying a relaxing cycle into work, Julian soon faces an uphill struggle at the Thirsk practice. A Large Munsterlander has a cancerous tumour on his jaw, and another vet has already recommended having him put to sleep. Can Julian offer any hope?

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Sammy the Jack Russell has the wiggliest bum ever, and could be the perfect complement to young Alex's dry reserve. Plus, neglect victim Martin the Staffy may finally find the caring home he deserves.

programme.title: Winter On The Moors Special
programme.desc: Called out to remote farms to tend animals in labour and the sick and injured, vets Julian Norton and Peter Wright must battle the weather to treat and save patients including owls and cattle.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: A pet pig is brought to the practice to see Julian. Peter heads to see goat brothers because all isn't rosy in their garden. A German short-haired pointer requires surgery. A pregnant cow requires an emergency C-section.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Melissa is looking to begin her journey as a first-time dog owner, and carer for the elderly Jillian hopes for a furry companion who will enjoy the social side of her job.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: The Ashcroft-Schulz family are excited to adopt a rescue dog, but son Arlo is nervous. Hamilton mother of eight Jo wants a furry friend and newlyweds Hannah and Lynda meet a Swiss Shepherd.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Radio DJ Bree and her partner Sophia are looking for a bestie for their terrier, Whitney Houston. Barry and his daughter Lily are looking for a calm companion to join their family.

programme.title: More Zoo Babies
programme.desc: We are off round the planet getting face to face with zoo babies, great and small. Tiny hippos in the hippo pond, rhino calf romping around, and a roller coaster ride with a pair of baby marmosets.

programme.title: Baby Animals From North America
programme.desc: North America is the destination in this episode. Tag along with baby raccoons as they explore the woods. Have a need for speed? Then zoom along some mountain rapids with a Moose calf. And if you like non-stop action, simply hang out with baby Bears.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Will gentle giant Tessa the Bull Arab, a cruelty case rescue, find love with the Doyle family? And are newlyweds Craig and Rodney the right fit for bonded pair Zoe and Buster?

programme.title: Special On Call
programme.desc: In The Yorkshire Vet - On Call, Peter and Julian catch up with old friends and find out how they're getting on. Previously, Peter saved a bullock with pneumonia. He feared the worst but the next day the bullock was doing well and Peter was both amazed and thrilled. Now, he's back at the Greensit Brothers farm on call to yet another emergency.

programme.title: More Autumn Babies
programme.desc: Our day is being spent hanging around with more of autumn's babies. Goofy panda cubs, meerkats, and a show-off baby jaguar are some of the babies featuring this time.

programme.title: More Summer Babies
programme.desc: We are having fun in the sun with an energetic bunch of maritime babies and their families, tree topping with Koalas, and spend time with young chipmunks carving up a storm.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Matt delivers a calf, Peter removes a lump from a dog's eye, and Julian repairs a slipped patella on a cat and nips a sheep with a birth defect. Peter and Shona go 4-wheeling.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Inspector Anthony Joynes refuses to be intimidated as he rescues two dogs, one with a serious skin problem. When the owner becomes aggressive it's up to Anthony and the police to get the dogs out as safely as possible.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: In the Malawi Special, we follow Anthony and vet Riaz Rhemu as they rescue a roadside stray and go undercover to investigate the illegal puppy trade. They also help out at an open-air surgery on World Spay Day and vaccinate an astounding number of dogs against rabies.

programme.title: Extreme Heat Babies
programme.desc: Being wrapped around the Earth's belly it's no surprise that conditions in the equatorial regions are on the warm side year round. Our day this time is being spent with some wild youngsters in the hottest part of the planet. Baby elephants, monkeys and lion cubs are among some of the babies featured.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Julian races over to the llama trekking centre in the Dales, after one of the youngsters breaks his jaw in a freak accident. A goat with a painful foot condition is brought in to Peter. A bulldog is rushed in after eating some chewing gum.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Peter treats a lamb with a leg infection while Julian deals with a mysterious lump on a llama called Imposter. A greyhound with a crushed ankle receives an implant.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Julian is called out to treat two cattle from farmer Stuart Robinson's herd. Julian removes a stone from the first cow's hoof. But the second animal is a different proposition. Despite being sedated, one ton bull Merchant drags Julian around the barn. Chaos ensues as the bull simply refuses to be pulled to the ground for treatment.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: It's Autumn, and the start of what will prove to be the most punishing year of training for the students have ever faced. With places on the course more in-demand than Oxbridge, only the very best of over four thousand applicants have made it past the selection process, but now the lucky twenty-five must show they've got what it takes to go all the way.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Peter faces a late night emergency as Abbie rushes in her sheep who is pregnant with triplets. The babies aren't due for another three weeks, but Peter must act quickly. Julian is preparing for the opening of his new veterinary centre.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Peter heads to see a worried farmer whose newborn calf can't stand up. If it's a serious joint problem, as the farmer suspects, he might not make it. Julian welcomes Exotic Joe to the practice. Joe normally brings in all kinds of weird and wonderful creatures.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: Greg and Allan are flat mates hoping Betty the Staffy will become their 3rd roomie, she really brings some personality to the meeting pen. And Jason falls hard for husky Lara but is the feeling mutual?

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Julian has a mystery to solve when he treats two pet goats that have been attacked by an unknown animal. Peter visit an old friend's farm where he meets a pig that is under the weather. One of two dogs has eaten children's vitamin pills.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Elderly Timmy, a Collie cross, is discovered in a house with a huge painful tumour on his face, but inspector Anthony Joynes refuses to give up on him. Inspector Helen Smith meets Archie, a stroppy Shih-Tzu that has become so matted, he can barely see or hear. Inspector Simon Evans pays a visit to two French Bulldog puppies, Yoda and Mogwai, that were found in Pontypool Park in Wales.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Peter turns shoemaker to try and save a lame cow. An unusual case of llama colic poses a problem for Julian, who also has a fight on his hands with Rocky the cat. A pioneering new treatment is tried at Skeldale. And a plucky parrot needs a pedicure.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: Julian heads out to help a rare breed of cow named Bertha. She is a champion breeder with a troubling eye infection. Peter returns yet again to the Green's to check on one of their donkeys. It is just one of many visits Peter has made to the Greens in the 36 years he's been helping them, but will things go as routine as before?

programme.title: Big Ted and Little Ted, Victorian Lamp Post and Steam Car
programme.desc: Dominic Chinea has to future-proof an old Cornish museum sign; Steven Fletcher has to steer an old clunker back onto the road; Julie and Amanda start treatment on George, a very special teddy who has lost one of his eyes and his growl.

programme.title: Caputo Painting, Tricycle and Barometer Clock
programme.desc: Steven Fletcher and William Kirk combine their expert knowledge of clocks and woodwork to repair a broken barometer.

programme.title: Pub Sign, Spaceship Toy and Majolica Vase
programme.desc: Ceramics expert Kirsten Ramsay gets to work on a stunning Majolica Vase, which has fallen victim to more than one accident over the years, including a broken lid.

programme.title: Art Nouveau Mirror, Phonograph and Writing Case
programme.desc: A customer has a knotty nautical problem that leaves furniture restorer Will Kirk all at sea. Jay Blades and Tim Weeks get a vintage gramophone looking and sounding like new. Soft toy specialists Amanda and Julie take on a young lady suffering the effects of years of love and affection.

programme.title: War Watch, Louis Vuitton Trunk, Butter Churn
programme.desc: Clockmaker Steve Fletcher tackles a pocket watch that's come all the way from Holland; metalworker Dominic Chinea and master cooper Alastair Simms fix an ancient butter churn; leather expert Suzie Fletcher restores a trunk made by Louis Vuitton.

programme.title: Smyth Painting, Monkey Stick, Seaside Telescope
programme.desc: Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms back to life; guitar restorer David Kennett tackles a worn out bass guitar belonging to Tony Wilson, founding member of 1970s funk band Hot Chocolate.

programme.title: Chalet Music Box, Globe, Garnet Bracelet
programme.desc: Music box expert, Stephen Kember, and furniture restorer Will Kirk come together to work on a music box that is housed in a replica Swiss chalet.

programme.title: Riding Crop, Grandad Chair, Hungarian Vase
programme.desc: Sonnaz Nooranvary takes on a battered but beloved armchair; Steve and Suzie Fletcher try their hand at restoring a WWI-era military riding crop; Kirsten Ramsay tackles a damaged Hungarian vase.

programme.title: Yukio Tani, Porcelain Clock, Nursery Chair
programme.desc: Art conservator Lucia Scalisi works on a 1930s portrait of a Japanese martial arts master; upholsterer Sonnaz Nooranvary restores a Victorian chair; horologist Steve Fletcher and ceramics expert Kirsten Ramsay restore an ornate porcelain clock.

programme.title: Painted Glass Window, Art Deco Lamp, Sea Chest
programme.desc: Resident horologist Steve Fletcher and ceramics restorer Kirsten Ramsay work to fix an art deco lamp; stained-glass expert Matthew Nickels completely overhauls a precious painted window.

programme.title: Fred Bear, Piano Stool, Statuettes
programme.desc: Soft toy restorers Amanda Middleditch and Julie Tatchell work their magic on an old teddy called Fred; silver smith Brenton West comes to the rescue of a pair of Art Deco statuettes that miraculously survived the Blitz.

programme.title: Wall Clock, Piano Make-up Compact and Cradle
programme.desc: Resident clock expert Steve Fletcher restores an 18th century wall clock; Caner Rachael South restores a beautiful wicker cradle that has been in use for generations; Brenton West fixes a much loved powder compact, made in the shape of a piano.

programme.title: Dogs of Fo, Racing Car and JW Painting
programme.desc: Art conservator Lucia Scalisi repairs a much loved landscape; clockwork expert Steve Fletcher gets a treasured clockwork toy car back on the road; ceramics expert Kirsten Ramsay tackles a damaged porcelain Chinese guard dog.

programme.title: Barmaid Clock, Silver Mirror and Eames Chair
programme.desc: Resident clock expert Steven Fletcher receives an unusual time piece; Silversmith Brenton West is tasked with restoring a precious hand mirror that has lost its glass; specialist furniture restorer, Graeme Mancha, overhauls an Eames chair.

programme.title: Meissen Clock, Typewriter and Bomber Jacket
programme.desc: Resident clock expert Steven Fletcher and ceramics conservator Kirsten Ramsay toil on a fragile 19th Century clock; Saddle maker Suzie Fletcher answers a mayday call to restore a WW2 pilot's bomber jacket.

programme.title: Rocking Horse, Nursery Plaque and Stereoscope
programme.desc: Furniture restorer William Kirk takes on a cherished family rocking horse; ceramics conservator Kirsten Ramsay works wonders on a Royal Doulton plaque.

programme.title: Leaf Chair, Hercules and Smokers' Stand
programme.desc: Suzie Fletcher and Sonnaz Nooranvary restore a badly damaged leaf chair from the 60s; Matthew Boultwood rescues a 30 kilo cast iron statue of Hercules; Will Kirk takes on an interesting smokers' stand with the help of restorer Steven Fletcher.

programme.title: Grandmother Clock, Magnifying Glass and Blighty

programme.desc: Monty harvests his spuds and sows seeds for autumn veg. He also shows how to get plants for free by taking cuttings.

programme.title: Gardeners' World

She has great ideas and a budget to match, but growing citrus trees, olive trees and vines in a leafy London suburb is easier said than done. Will Monty be able to guide the sisters to a Mediterranean style success?

programme.title: Brighton/High Wycombe
programme.desc: In Brighton determined duo Helen and Dax have their hands full with twins, one of whom has special needs. Meanwhile in High Wycombe, newly single Valerie is looking for a fresh lease of life.

programme.title: Bury & Hackney

programme.title: Rome
programme.desc: Monty Don conducts a personal grand tour around Italy's magnificent gardens from the luxurious retreats of the moneyed north to the lavish hideaways of the romantic south. In this episode, he's in and around Rome, a power base of emperors and popes, to explore gardens that are among some of the most extravagant and flamboyant ever created in history.

programme.title: Florence
programme.desc: Monty Don is on a grand tour around Italy, this time visiting gardens both in Florence and around the sun-scorched Tuscan countryside. Monty discovers how, like a piece of sculpture, renaissance gardens were created as works of art, and how a group of Edwardian ex-pats mistakenly reinforced the idea that formal Italian gardens were flowerless.

programme.title: The South
programme.desc: Monty Don continues his grand garden tour of Italy. This time he is in Naples to visit some of the most sublime, romantic retreats in southern Italy. After all the formality of the green gardens around Rome and Florence, Monty seeks out idyllic horticultural gems set against the dramatic scenery of the Amalfi Coast to discover why, in the south, gardens are informal and, above all, filled with flowers.

programme.title: The Veneto, Lucca and The Lakes
programme.desc: Monty Don concludes his garden tour of Italy in the wealthy north where, in the Veneto and Lucca, extravagant pleasure gardens were created for flirtation and fun. In the Lakes, Monty meets up with the garden society, the Grandi Giardini Italiani, to peer over the fence at luxurious creations of the rich and famous. The journey ends on Lake Maggiore to see the most theatrical horticultural gem of Italy.

programme.title: Monty Don's Paradise Gardens
programme.desc: In Morocco, Monty discovers the wide variety of paradise gardens. He begins just outside the city of Marrakesh in an enormous royal walled meadow, The Agdal. From there he moves to the heart of the town where he comes upon a tiny garden where huge banana plants jostle with palms to create a secret paradise garden, a shelter from the busy world outside. And in another part of the city a rundown old palace has been turned into a stunning contemporary garden with a twist.

programme.title: Monty Don's Paradise Gardens
programme.desc: In Turkey Monty is dazzled by an extraordinary display of the Ottoman Empire's favourite flower, the tulip, and learns of its sacred significance. Travelling further East to India he encounters a new type of spirituality in the tomb gardens of the Mughal Empire. Stunning mausoleums were set in vast gardens as places where an earthly king could enter a divine paradise.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Join Adam in his garden for a seasonal catch-up. Toby Buckland gives timely tips on summer and autumn maintenance for borders, plus join singer-songwriter Billie Marten as she shares her passion for growing vegetables.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: With autumn fast approaching, Monty is preparing the borders for the change of seasons and looking ahead to spring. Adam Frost and Advolly Richmond visit a glorious historic garden in North Yorkshire - Scampston Hall.

programme.title: Monty Don's American Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels from Missouri to Chicago and then across to New York and Philadelphia. He begins his journey in a prairie, the original American flowering wilderness. Much of the prairie has disappeared, but he meets a couple who have revived the tradition and enjoy showing it to him in full bloom.

programme.title: Monty Don's American Gardens
programme.desc: Monty goes South to explore gardens of early independent America and learns how the history of this part of the country is still very much evident in the places and people he meets. He visits the famous garden where President Thomas Jefferson, one of America's founding fathers, enjoyed spending his time seeking out seeds and plants for his thousand-foot vegetable garden.

programme.title: Monty Don's American Gardens
programme.desc: Monty explores the extraordinary scenery of the west coast of America. He begins his journey in Arizona where he learns about cacti and marvels at the sight of them in the desert and in private gardens where they have replaced traditional plants and lawns.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty sows rocket, harvests chillies and tomatoes, and demonstrates how to take semi-ripe cuttings. Frances Tophill meets a head gardener in south London who's started gardening sustainably.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Adam Frost is in his garden, bringing viewers up to date on how it has been developing, as well as giving advice on growing hydrangeas. Toby Buckland shares his tips on dealing with damaged shrubs, tree pruning and transplanting perennials.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As autumn unfolds in the garden, Monty Don and Nigel make the most of the season and prepare for the winter ahead. Meanwhile, Carol Klein is in Surrey looking at wild and cultivated heathers.

programme.desc: Monty meets two sets of gardeners who have unimaginable ambitions for their outdoor spaces. In Essex Denise has never ventured beyond the decking area behind her house. Meanwhile in Ipswich, a father and daughter plan to build a terraced allotment.

programme.title: Stockport & Tufnell Park
programme.desc: Monty comes to the rescue of two couples in need of help transforming their rubble filled back gardens into havens of peace and tranquillity. They are in serious need of help and advice, but can Monty set them on the right track?

programme.title: Blackpool/Cumbria
programme.desc: Two gardeners, each living on their own, are hoping Monty can help them. In Blackpool, Alex dreams of turning her boring backyard into a magical enchanted forest. Also in Bristol, Ross has taken on a very over-grown allotment.

programme.desc: The team are in Daresbury in Chester with downsizers, Karen and Alan. The couple have a small, wedge-shaped garden with so little in it that the only thing to look at is the fences, but those fences don't even provide privacy from the neighbours.

programme.title: St Ives
programme.desc: The team visit Bernadette, a dedicated social worker for troubled adults who has always put the needs of others before her own. Having recently turned sixty, Bernadette finally wants some 'me time': a new garden could give her a well-deserved reward.

programme.title: Bristol Bradley Stoke
programme.desc: The team have an unusual challenge: to turn a long, pointed front garden into a water-saving, wildlife-friendly space. Mum Laura wants a place to encourage the bugs and creepy-crawlies that young son William loves.

programme.title: Salford
programme.desc: In Salford, the team meet Nicole, who grew up in Germany. She wants to recreate her family's German 'kleine' garden, a traditional community space divided into fruit, veg and lawn.

programme.title: Venice
programme.desc: Monty travels to Europe and explores the influence of the Venetians on gardening. To begin with, he explores Venice on one of the city's famous barges, stepping out to visit green spaces large and small that are often hidden from view behind high walls.

programme.title: Croatia
programme.desc: Monty begins in the city of Trieste, close to Italy's border with Croatia, to visit a public garden first created by an obsessive royal plantsman more than 150 years ago, which is now being carefully restored. He then heads down the Adriatic coast through Croatia to pick up the trail that the Venetians followed, ending his journey on the beautiful island of Lopud, near Dubrovnik.

programme.title: Greece
programme.desc: Monty begins the last leg of his journey in Corfu, a Greek island with strong Venetian links, including olive trees planted by them that are still grown today. Here, Monty visits a spectacular garden made by an Englishman with Greek connections.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty and the team celebrate the wonder of trees and explore the vital role they play in gardens and the wider landscape. Zoe Ball joins Toby Buckland on a visit to a tree project in North London.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty is back at Longmeadow, getting stuck into more seasonal tasks. Joe Swift heads to Houghton Lodge Gardens in Hampshire renowned for its walled kitchen garden and heritage fruit collection.

programme.title: Getting Even With Dad
programme.desc: Con man Ray Gleason (Ted Danson) is going after one last heist -- a stash of rare coins -- when his estranged son, Timmy (Macaulay Culkin), unexpectedly shows up. Ray is too busy with his robbery to spend much time with his son, so Timmy decides to blackmail Ray into acting like a father. He hides the coins and promises to give them back only after Ray takes him to amusement parks and baseball games. All the while, Detective Theresa Walsh (Glenne Headly) is closing in on Ray.

programme.title: Gina Brillon: The Floor Is Lava
programme.desc: The comic pulls no punches when discussing her childhood, culture and the transition from single to married life with her Midwestern husband.

programme.title: What's Cooking?

On the menu this November are turkey, sweet potatoes, and pumpkin pie -- but also tamales, spring rolls, kugel, mac & cheese, love, betrayal, sibling rivalry, prejudice, politics, uninvited guests, unexpected accidents, outrageous conversations -- and all the other succulent and spicy surprises that arise when modern families come together for an annual meal.

programme.title: Kung Fu Yoga

Using his vast knowledge of history and kung fu, Jack leads his team on a race around the world to beat the mercenaries to the treasure and save an ancient culture.

Desperate to reinvent herself, Bianca enlists the aid of Wesley (Robbie Amell), a charming jock. In order to save her senior year from becoming a complete disaster, Bianca must find the confidence to overthrow a judgmental student (Bella Thorne) and revolutionize the school's social order.

programme.title: UHF

When George's uncle (Stanley Brock) hands him the deed to a local TV station, George creates a series of television shows based on social satire and hyperactive humor, with the help of his best friend, Bob (David Bowe). However, a rival station's bitter CEO (Kevin McCarthy) tries to destroy George's wacky programming, forcing him to fight back.

programme.title: Whose Line Is It Anyway?

programme.title: Whose Line Is It Anyway?
programme.desc: "Film & Theater Styles"; "Animals"; "Let's Make a Date"; "World's Worst"; "Props"; "Party Quirks"; "Helping Hands."

programme.title: Loni Love: America's Sister
programme.desc: The comic's standup routine takes on the president, fat people, pirates, celebrities, and her love for those in America.

programme.title: Football Feuds and Surveillance Shenanigans
programme.desc: A brutal football match, stubborn divers, and strange surveillance footage await.

programme.title: Laundry, Love, and Forest Frustrations
programme.desc: A laundry room mishap, shady lab work, slow-burn romance, and a never-ending walk.

programme.title: Cravings, Chaos, and a Cookout to Remember

programme.title: Nostalgia, Construction, and Comedy Challenges
programme.desc: Nostalgia, lazy construction crews, bizarre riddles, and a desperate assistant take over.

programme.title: Taco Shop
programme.desc: A bitter rivalry forms when a taco truck parks right across the street from a taco shop.

programme.title: Home for Christmas

programme.title: No Place Like Home

As their relationship blossoms into something beyond physical attraction, her adolescent daughter (Tracey Ullman) begins to question the tingling sensations she experiences whenever she is in the company of a handsome local boy.

programme.title: The Spy Next Door

First however, he has one more mission to complete: Gain the approval of Gillian's children. Bob volunteers to baby-sit when Gillian is called away, but the operation hits a snag when one of the kids mistakenly downloads a top-secret formula, and a Russian terrorist takes aim at Bob's prospective family.

programme.title: Earth Girls Are Easy

After absorbing the native culture via television, the spacemen are ready to hit the dating scene in the 1980s Los Angeles.

programme.title: All Dogs Go to Heaven

Charlie sets out to take his revenge on Carface by means of an elaborate plan that involves an orphan girl, Anne-Marie. But as the plan progresses, Charlie discovers that Anne-Marie is being exploited by Carface. Charlie must decide whether to change his mission from one of revenge to one of rescue.

programme.title: All Dogs Go to Heaven 2

Even after his best pal, Itchy (Dom DeLuise), arrives in town, Charlie still longs to go back to Earth. When Charlie's old nemesis, Carface (Ernest Borgnine), steals the horn used by the archangel Gabriel, Charlie and Itchy quickly volunteer to retrieve it. Back on the planet, while scrambling to outwit Carface and get the horn, Charlie meets an alluring pooch named Anabelle (Bebe Neuwirth).

Before Larry gets a chance to react to the plan, it seems that Owen has already sealed Margaret's fate.

Nick can't stand kids and would happily send the boy back to live with his biological mother, but nobody knows who the woman might be. Having nowhere to turn, Nick must hit the road with the boy and the neurotic psychic to locate dozens of his ex-flings and ask one very awkward question to all of them.

He hides the coins and promises to give them back only after Ray takes him to amusement parks and baseball games. All the while, Detective Theresa Walsh (Glenne Headly) is closing in on Ray.

programme.title: Descubriendo el corazón
programme.desc: Omar descubre sus sentimientos hacia Carolina; las mujeres del cuartel se preparan para su cita con Fernando Colunga; Fernando le prepara una sorpresa a Lety.

programme.title: Indiferencia
programme.desc: Lety le dice a doña Julieta que se casará con Aldo; Omar está tan feliz con Carolina, que se muestra indiferente con Aurora; comienzan las grabaciones para el programa de televisión.

programme.title: Misterio perdido
programme.desc: Comienzan las complicaciones en la filmación del programa de televisión; Omar le rompe el corazón a Carolina; Fernando descubre la verdadera identidad de Aurora.

programme.title: Compulsiones
programme.desc: Lety está decidida a desaparecer a Aurora de su vida; Omar intenta recuperar a Carolina; Irmita y Sara llevan a Martha a una reunión de comedores compulsivos.

programme.title: Embarazada
programme.desc: Aldo, Fernando y los medios de comunicación presionan a Lety por la desaparición de Aurora; Alicia le dice a Tomás que está embarazada.

programme.title: En su lugar
programme.desc: Martha está decidida a remediar su desorden alimenticio; doña Julieta regaña a Lety por apresurar su boda con Aldo, ya que sigue queriendo a Fernando, además le pide que aclare el malentendido de Aurora.

programme.title: El sacrificio
programme.desc: Tomás le cuenta a Lety que doña Julieta está intentando sabotear su boda con Aldo; Omar acude con Tomás para poder conquistar a Carolina.

programme.title: Indiscreta
programme.desc: Gracias a doña Julieta, Fernando se entera de la verdadera identidad de Aurora; Alicia y Tomás pasan su primera noche juntos.

programme.title: Yo te apoyo
programme.desc: Fernando le dice a Lety que debe quedarse con Aldo y que él apoyará su relación; Simón les enseña a las del cuartel su título en informática; Marcia y Luigi salen de compras y alguien los sigue.

programme.title: Hombre nuevo
programme.desc: Simón recibe su nuevo puesto en Conceptos y le propone matrimonio a Paula María; Fernando y Omar llevan al nuevo coordinador de informática a celebrar su próxima boda.

programme.title: Malentendidos
programme.desc: Lety decide suspender su boda con Aldo, quien se pelea con Fernando; Simón se despide de Jaimito y Paula María.

programme.title: La boda de Paula María
programme.desc: Lety se da cuenta de que necesita a Aurora para ayudar a Aldo a recuperar su restaurante; Simón y Paula María se casan; los empleados de Conceptos se esfuerzan por juntar a Omar con Carolina.

programme.title: Intervención policial
programme.desc: La boda de Simón y Paula María continúa, pero la policía interrumpe la fiesta para llevarse detenido a Efrén; Carolina y Omar arreglan sus diferencias.

programme.title: Hombre libre
programme.desc: Aldo se molesta con Fernando, Lety y Omar por ocultarle la verdad sobre Aurora; Efrén sale de la cárcel y le dice a Lola que quiere regresar con ella y que está dispuesto a dejar a Jazmín.

programme.title: Casa nueva
programme.desc: Aldo recupera su restaurante y el programa de Conceptos resulta ser un éxito; Luigi se niega a recibir la visita de su padre; Martha y su familia por fin compran su casa.

programme.title: Mi verdadero yo
programme.desc: Luigi transforma a Lety en su verdadero yo y todos quedan fascinados en la oficina; Fernando intenta arreglar la relación entre Aldo y Leticia; Alicia decide robarle dinero a Tomás.

programme.title: Amor de padre
programme.desc: Alicia descubre que está embarazada: la familia Padilla se prepara para la boda de Lety con Aldo; don Erasmo se disculpa con Lety, pues se siente responsable por todo lo que le pasó.

programme.title: El millón que falta
programme.desc: Tomás descubre que Alicia robó el millón de pesos que le falta a Conceptos; Ariel hace todo lo posible por rastrear el dinero y desenmascarar al culpable; Lety le ofrece su ayuda a su amigo.

programme.title: Los dueños
programme.desc: Alicia intenta despedirse de Tomás y se arrepiente de haberlo lastimado; Aldo entrega Conceptos a sus verdaderos dueños.

programme.title: Final feliz
programme.desc: Lety prepara todo para su boda con Fernando; Tomás y Alicia deciden reanudar su relación; la tan esperada boda de los protagonistas.

programme.title: Currículum vitae
programme.desc: Lety se presenta a una entrevista de trabajo en Conceptos, una casa productora, para ser secretaria ejecutiva, pero compite con la bella pero inexperta Alicia.

programme.title: Comparaciones
programme.desc: Fernando y Marcia tienen conflictos por la contratación de Leticia, y Marcia le pide a Fernando una explicación; en el fondo, a Marcia le preocupa que Lety esté tan bien preparada.

programme.title: Asignación de funciones
programme.desc: Fernando les asigna a Lety y Alicia sus funciones en la empresa: Lety se encargará del papeleo y Alicia de las relaciones públicas.

programme.title: Regaños
programme.desc: Bajo las órdenes de Fernando, Simón le pide perdón a Lety por molestarla. Fernando regaña a Lety por dejar la agenda personal descuidada y le da indicaciones.

programme.title: Falso despido
programme.desc: Fernando se entera de que López despide a Lety y decide ir a salvarla, por lo que se enfurece con Marcia y amenaza a López con despedirlo.

programme.title: Tristezas
programme.desc: Román deja plantada a Lety, quien escucha que Fernando se casará con Marcia. Paula María y Jaimito van a la oficina. Simón le pide perdón a Lety.

programme.title: Corte de personal
programme.desc: Lety recibe y ordena la información de los ejecutivos de Conceptos, pero Alicia se lleva los créditos tras apropiarse del informe que realizó Lety.

programme.title: Festejo con tamales
programme.desc: Lety recibe el comentario de que Fernando es un don Juan, y la advertencia de que no se enamore. Ariel encuentra errores en la propuesta de Fernando para tener la presidencia.

programme.title: Plan de trabajo
programme.desc: Fernando le pide a Alicia elaborar un trabajo especial, pero ella no sabe cómo resolverlo. Lety trabaja fuertemente en el plan de trabajo de Fernando, pero lo pierde en el transporte público.

programme.title: Ineficiencia y mala muerte
programme.desc: Alicia le dice a Fernando que no hizo el trabajo que le pidió. Cuco y Adriana descubren que el CD que encontraron es de Lety. Omar se niega a ayudar a Alicia a preparar el plan de negocios. Don Erasmo llega a Conceptos.

programme.title: Despido falso
programme.desc: Lety tiene un malentendido con Fernando, y cree que la despidieron. Lola le reclama a Efrén por su pensión.

programme.title: Indiscreción
programme.desc: Fernando le pide a Lety acompañarlo a la junta con Ariel; Tomás le dice a don Erasmo que su hija es secretaria; Ariel se burla porque Leticia estará en la junta de ejecutivos.

programme.title: Táctica de celos
programme.desc: Alicia necesita una cita con Ariel para celar a Omar. Paula María invita a Lety a salir con amigos. Fernando está en casa de Marcia, aburrido decide ir algún lugar a bailar, Marcia se queda. Lety y Fernando se encuentran en el antro y bailan juntos.

programme.title: Apoyo incondicional
programme.desc: Fernando decide pasar la noche con Marcia en su apartamento; Don Erasmo reprende a Lety por salir sin permiso.

programme.title: Nombramiento merecido
programme.desc: Marcia se niega a comunicar a Lety con Fernando porque está concursando en el hipódromo; Lety obliga a Simón a llevarla al club para hablar con Fernando de inmediato.

programme.title: Ascenso oficial
programme.desc: Alicia le cuenta a Marcia cómo la humillaron las otras secretarias y sobre el nombramiento de Lety; Marcia le reclama a Fernando por el ascenso de su secretaria.

programme.title: Balance maquillado
programme.desc: Olarte le dice a Ariel que Fernando es capaz de maquillar el balance que presentará en la junta del comité; Ariel se le insinúa a Alicia y ella se molesta, pero igual lo usa para poner celoso a Omar.

programme.title: Gran oportunidad
programme.desc: El ingeniero Ortiz le dice a Olarte que Lety bloqueó el acceso a los archivos; la niña que iba a grabar el comercial se enferma, Lola aprovecha la oportunidad y le sugiere a Irma usar a Adrianita.

programme.title: Sin respaldo
programme.desc: Lety no hace las copias de seguridad y la computadora se descompone, no hay forma de presentar el balance. El ingeniero Ortiz le comunica al Comité los problemas con la computadora de Lety. Ariel reprende a Lety por no tener respaldo de sus archivos.

programme.title: Nuevo nombramiento merecido
programme.desc: Lety se integra a la junta del Comité para explicar el balance financiero de Conceptos. Lety da una explicación detallada y logra rebatir todas las objeciones y dudas de Ariel respecto a la buena situación de la empresa.

programme.title: Nuevas responsabilidades
programme.desc: El club casi descubre al responsable de lo sucedido con la computadora de Lety; Lety está más cerca de ser vicepresidenta financiera.

programme.title: Una espía
programme.desc: Omar deja a Paula María en un bar; un zapato de Lety se cae en una fuente; Ariel le pide a Alicia informarle todo lo que pase en Conceptos; Fernando le pide a Lety supervisar la compra de unas cámaras de video.

programme.title: Confianza que incomoda
programme.desc: Marcia le da a Alicia un cheque para pagar la luz y el gas; Fernando le pide a Luigi usar otra cámara mientras llega la de cine, pero él se niega; Marcia se molesta porque Fernando autorizará la firma de Lety en los bancos.

programme.title: Comisión comprometedora
programme.desc: Alicia decide no salir con Omar; Lety convence a Fernando de que Cine Rent es la mejor opción; Ariel llega al departamento de Alicia; Omar se encuentra a Paula María y le ofrece llevarla a su casa.

programme.title: Negocio redondo
programme.desc: Alicia escucha a Fernando contarle a Marcia del contrato con Cine Rent y se lo dice a Ariel; Fernando le cuenta a Miguel que Lety lo convenció para aceptar su propuesta.

programme.title: Recapacitando
programme.desc: Don Erasmo le pide a Lety no aceptar la comisión que le ofrecieron, pues sería un soborno y cuestionaría su honestidad. Lety le cuenta a Fernando acerca de la comisión que le ofrecieron en Cine Rent y él a su vez, se lo cuenta a Marcia.

programme.title: Empresa nueva
programme.desc: Carolina critica a Fernando y Omar por burlarse de la fealdad de Lety; Luigi se molesta al ver sus bocetos pintarrajeados; Lola le pide a Simón que se lleve a los niños y que tire las evidencias que los delaten.

programme.title: Más problemas
programme.desc: Fernando supervisa la recepción de Beni; Marcia le dice a Fernando que Fabiola y Gregorio tienen parados los nuevos foros por problemas con los clientes de los comerciales.

programme.title: La nueva presidenta
programme.desc: Luigi se molesta porque Fernando le entrega una cámara de video en vez de una de 35 milímetros que le pidió; el Club de las Feas decide festejar que Lety se quedará como presidenta de Conceptos.

programme.title: Desilusión
programme.desc: Carolina le dice a Fernando lo que acordó con la prensa; las secretarias del Club de las Feas se desilusionan cuando descubren que Rolando es el novio de Luigi; Arturo le cancela a Fernando el contrato con la disquera.

programme.title: Emborrachadas
programme.desc: Fernando, Marcia y Omar van a Los Ángeles a cerrar un contrato. Lety y sus amigas se van de antro y terminan borrachas.

programme.title: Travesuras

programme.title: Niño cruza frontera; Violada abandona hijos por ocho años
programme.desc: Elsa exige que su esposo e hijo regresen a México; el chico cruzó solo la frontera en busca de su padre. María abandona a su familia sin explicación; tras ocho años regresa para pedir perdón.

programme.title: Voces animadas en intimidad; El rencor de un transexual
programme.desc: Joahana pide el divorcio, su esposo imita las voces de los dibujos animados cuando hacen el amor. Marcos le suplica a su hermano que visite a su madre que está a punto de morir, él se niega.

programme.title: Hijo maneja página cristiana; Mi hijo no será venezolano
programme.desc: Claudia reclama el dinero que le prestó a su exesposo, pero él cambió la intención del negocio. Cristina exige que su cuñada regrese a Venezuela; su hermano quiere que su esposa e hijo lo apoyen.

programme.title: Solo quiere abrazar a la Dra. Polo; Exesposa alcohólica
programme.desc: María demanda a sus padres biológicos y exige compensación, ellos le piden perdón. Beto no establece prioridades, le exige a su esposa, que su ex, alcohólica y desempleada, viva con ellos.

programme.title: Mamporreo; Por regresión es lesbiana
programme.desc: Esteban quiere que su esposa renuncie a su trabajo, ella es mamporrera, experta en limpiar penes de caballos. Paloma demanda a su hijo, él no le quiere regresar sus bienes porque es lesbiana.

programme.title: Abridor de closet; La aspiradora
programme.desc: Paco exige su pago, él es experto en homosexuales, si se sospecha que un marido es gay, él da su diagnóstico. Manuel solo siente placer cuando usa una aspiradora, su esposa pide el divorcio.

programme.title: Mentira criminal; Domadora de hombres
programme.desc: José pasa años en prisión acusado de abusar de su hijastra, pero fue la madre quien forjó las pruebas. Samuel demanda a su esposa Marian, quien lo obliga a usar un collar eléctrico para perros.

programme.title: Dieciocho meses muerto, pero me violó; Reemplazando la muerta
programme.desc: Lorena afirma que un narco la violó antes de ser asesinado, tuvo un hijo y ahora exige la herencia. Juan Carlos pide la paternidad de su hija y su custodia, la tía se hace pasar por la madre.

programme.title: Mata a tu padre con cuchillo; Contrato para sentirse famoso
programme.desc: Simón exige establecer la paternidad de la hija que tiene con Catalina, así como la custodia total. Mario pide una orden de alejamiento para Guadalupe, ella insiste en que él es un estafador.

programme.title: Por honor a mi patria; Sobrina acosada
programme.desc: José, veterano del ejército, le pide a su padre que no se divorcie y que cuide a su madre mientras él esté ausente. Karla quiere alejarse de su tía, dice que ella es peor que Maduro y Chávez juntos.

programme.title: El baile de la gorda; Mi suegro es un ladrón
programme.desc: Jorge demanda a Silvia, la acusa de usar a su hermana con problemas mentales y de sobrepeso como bailarina erótica. Natacha le exige a su suegro, Rafael, que le devuelva el dinero que le robó.

programme.title: No american flag; Caña o ballet
programme.desc: Una escuela prohíbe el uso de prendas de vestir con la bandera, pero Jack viola la regla y lo despiden. Su madre descubre que es gay y lo echa de la casa, ahora regresa para cumplir su sueño.

programme.title: Curar a mi hija con cuy; Falsas acusaciones
programme.desc: Lucía exige que Jorge firme el permiso para someter a su hija a un tratamiento experimental, pero él cree que es brujería. La vida de un maestro se destruye por la acusación de una de sus alumnas.

programme.title: Crossfit sex; El caso de Nerson
programme.desc: Por culpa del CrossFit quiere solo sexo violento, su esposo ya no aguanta, pide ayuda psicológica para ella o el divorcio. Rosa exige que Jinnette adopte a su hermana menor, no quiere criarla.

programme.title: El difunto no está muerto; ¿A quién pertenece la niña?
programme.desc: Lorena queda viuda y se casa con Daniel, pero el difunto regresa y ella quiere que viva en la casa. Cambian a dos niñas por error, una muere y la otra sobrevive, las dos familias la reclaman.

programme.title: Sombrero para el miembro; Cerebro frito
programme.desc: Inventa fábrica de sombreros que adornan los miembros sexuales masculinos cuando están erectos y lo demandan. Erick quiere demostrar que los teléfonos celulares destruyen el cerebro humano.

programme.title: La última nalgada; Evidencia en teléfono
programme.desc: Alicia exige que su marido deje su práctica de masajes con nalgadas o se divorcia. Jessica demanda a su amiga Karla, porque le entregó a la policía un teléfono celular que la llevó a la cárcel.

programme.title: Padre sale de prisión; Éxtasis mortal
programme.desc: Después de años preso, este padre sale de la cárcel y exige la custodia de su hija. Lola quiere emanciparse, su padrastro practica la autoestrangulación en el sexo y así murió su madre.

programme.title: Pasteles grotescos; Chica malcriada exige manutención
programme.desc: Francisco es repostero y prepara impactantes pasteles con imágenes eróticas y sexuales. A Mariana la echan de su casa por malcriada, ella demanda a sus padres, exige que ellos la mantengan.

programme.title: El ojo del amor; Enemas de cloro para autistas
programme.desc: Boris es tuerto y su único ojo es para Ana, ella lo amaba, pero él se volvió violento. Raúl pide la custodia de su hija con Isabel, quien quiere curar el autismo de la niña con enemas de cloro.

programme.title: Colonia nudista cristiana; Pago infame
programme.desc: Elizabeth exige un cambio en la póliza de su complejo residencial que respete el nudismo-cristianismo. Blanca pide una orden de desalojo y una de alejamiento para Pablo, pero él no piensa marcharse.

programme.title: Hijo adoptivo padre de mi hijo; M. Broun abuso policíaco
programme.desc: Maritza adopta a Santiago, cuando crece se enamora de él y sale embarazada. Williams quiere impedir que su esposa mexicana entre a la academia de policía. El momento es muy conflictivo.

programme.title: Hombre como objeto sexual; Santo cachón con un negro
programme.desc: Bárbara demanda a Estefany, porque se llevó de la casa el juguete sexual que compartían. Sebastián pide el divorcio, cree que su esposa lo engañó, tuvo gemelas, una es negra y la otra blanca.

programme.title: Babalawo mexicano; Preso, viudo y casi papá
programme.desc: Hugo quiere las cenizas de su bebé para llevarlas a Cuba, es Babalawo y necesita recuperar su energía. David debe ir a la cárcel, pero antes, quiere darle a su cuñada la custodia de su hijo.

programme.title: Trío pide examen de paternidad; Parto naturista
programme.desc: Dos hombres y una mujer tienen una relación y ella se embaraza, quieren saber quién tiene derechos sobre el bebé. Flor desea dar a luz de manera natural en el Amazonas, su esposo está aterrado.

programme.title: La hockey y el acróbata; Colegio expulsa actor porno
programme.desc: Roberto exige que Carolina cumpla el contrato que firmaron, ella quiere anularlo porque él está obsesionado. Expulsan a Manolo de la escuela por hacer una película porno, su madre lo defiende.

programme.title: Tapón de bañadera con dólares; Me excita mi hermano porno
programme.desc: Loraine es una niña de 15 años y tiene un novio de 40; quiere emanciparse de su madre. Diego pide ayuda psicológica para su esposa; ella solo tiene sexo si ve las películas porno de su hermano.

programme.title: Amarrada en daycare; Desafío del hielo
programme.desc: Una madre descubre que en el jardín de infantes amarran a su hija de cuatro años, por lo que demanda a la dueña. Laura denuncia que la despidieron por negarse a participar en el desafío de las cubetas.

programme.title: Carlitos bacteria; La dejé de amar por loca
programme.desc: Carlitos le teme tanto a los gérmenes y bacterias que no hace el amor con su esposa, ella intenta una locura. Bruno exige una orden de alejamiento para su exmujer, ella lo persigue y lo acosa.

programme.title: Porno japonés; Aborto premeditado
programme.desc: María exige que su marido reciba ayuda psicológica, está obsesionado con las caricaturas pornográficas. Mónica acusa a su novio de darle pastillas abortivas, pero él asegura que ella miente.

programme.title: Vendida antes de nacer; El próximo asesino en serie
programme.desc: A Julieta la contratan como madre subrogada y tras dar a luz, ella se niega a entregar al niño. Vivian le exige a su esposo que corra de la casa a su hijastro, lo considera un asesino.

programme.title: La rumana, meditación orgásmica; Niño no sabe de padres separados
programme.desc: Alexandra quiere un sexo más placentero, por eso pide que su esposo aprenda meditación orgásmica. Yesica exige el divorcio y la custodia de su hijo; aunque están separados, aún vive con Noel.

programme.title: Mamá abusadora fuera; Me niego amor por premonición
programme.desc: Cuando era pequeña, su madre la vendió como esclava sexual. Ahora solo quiere vengarse. Rodrigo, novio de Celeste, tuvo una relación con la gemela de su pareja. Ella muere y él quiere terminar.

programme.title: Propuesta cibernética del nerd; Con cáncer terminal y un ...
programme.desc: Paola pide el divorcio, su joven marido es un nerd que pasa todo el día conectado a la computadora. Juan tiene solo 16 años y padece de un cáncer terminal, solo quiere cumplir con un sueño.

programme.title: Marido de papá hereda; Madre humilla hijos en FB
programme.desc: Angelina pide invalidar el testamento de su padre, quien le dejó todos sus bienes a su pareja gay. Una madre castiga a sus hijos y comparte las imágenes en internet; ellos se sienten humillados.

programme.title: Quinceañera pompis y chichis; Hija de 17 casada con haitiano
programme.desc: Mariana quiere la custodia de su hermana menor porque su madre insiste en regalarle una cirugía plástica. Es una niña y se casa sin permiso con un negro haitiano porque su madre es racista.

programme.title: Amante embarazada y loca; Agente inmobiliario se adueñó de casa
programme.desc: Jack tiene un romance con Angélica y la embaraza. Ahora la difama para quedarse con el bebé. Sofía comete el error de tener sexo en una de las casas que ella vende; el dueño lo graba todo.

programme.title: El vende esperma; Tres hijos enfermos, madre sin papeles
programme.desc: Gabriela descubre que su esposo vende su esperma a mujeres desesperadas por quedar embarazadas. Gilma quiere que su esposo autorice la salida de sus hijos del país y de la pesadilla americana.

programme.title: Madre obsesionada con hija; Llegó la hora de partir
programme.desc: Luisa pide internar a su madre, afirma que se ha vuelto loca y está obsesionada con ser idéntica a ella. Ángela le exige a Rocío, su mamá, no desconectar a su padre, quien se encuentra en coma.

programme.title: Cincuenta mil dólares del jefe para Hawái; Santa esperma
programme.desc: Venecia, acosada por su jefe, acepta dinero por su silencio, pero detalles del acuerdo se filtran en internet. Héctor se considera un apóstol con la misión de traer al mundo al hijo de Dios.

programme.title: Apuñaló con destornillador; Salchicha morena por gato
programme.desc: Sale de un hospital psiquiátrico y le pide a la doctora Polo que la ayude a recuperar a su hija. Valeria le sugiere a David usar una crema para aumentar el tamaño de su pene, y termina lastimado.

programme.title: Hipnotizado o embrujado; Por una firma prenupcial
programme.desc: No puede tener sexo con su marido porque la exesposa le hizo brujería. Raúl exige que Diana le pague por los gastos de boda que canceló al enterarse de que debía firmar un contrato prenupcial.

programme.title: Sexo a la portuguesa; Máquina paga renta
programme.desc: Rodrigo y Liliana llevan a su casa a una chica portuguesa para tener sexo en trío, pero él se siente desplazado. Una joven, que vive con sus suegros, graba videos porno en vivo; quieren echarla.

programme.title: Inocencia burlada; Amante embarazada y loca: Parte 2
programme.desc: Adriana quiere quitarle a su cuñada la custodia de su hija, la perdió años atrás. La doctora Polo le pide a esta mujer los exámenes médicos para determinar qué hacer con la criatura que espera.

programme.title: Vivir con tía y mamá; Hijo le entró a batazos
programme.desc: Rocío quiere recuperar la custodia de su hija, pero la niña no desea vivir con ella. Bárbara se siente culpable porque perdió al bebé que esperaba cuando su hijo la golpeó en la barriga con un bate.

programme.title: El muñeco de Bruselas: Herencia por cuidados
programme.desc: Sebastián exige la custodia de la hija que tiene con Patricia. Sospecha que la madre abusa de ella. Juan Manuel cuidó de su madre enferma y tras su muerte, su hermana quiere sacarlo de la casa.

programme.title: Los morenos si saltan; Aborto en nombre del arte
programme.desc: Javier adopta a una niña de raza negra y la obliga a entrenar para convertirla en una deportista millonaria. Ligia es una artista y usa sus abortos para expresar su arte poco convencional.

programme.title: Se drogan para estudiar; La impostora
programme.desc: Para obtener mejores calificaciones en la universidad usa drogas regularmente. Andrés exige anular su matrimonio con Patricia y la custodia de su hijo. Ella se casó con una identidad falsa.

programme.title: Enano como bebé; Trasplante en coma
programme.desc: En su empresa, usan enanos que actúan como bebés para enseñar a los padres cómo criar a sus hijos. Mario exige que se cumpla la voluntad de su hermano, ser desconectado y donar sus órganos.

programme.title: Cada país tiene su cabeza; Tu hermano me violó
programme.desc: Raúl exige el divorcio y que Juana lo indemnice, ella tiene varios amantes y todos duermen en su cama. La hija de Valeria es producto de una violación, su difunto cuñado fue quien abusó de ella.

programme.title: Reciclaje de niños; Violación premeditada
programme.desc: Lo adopta, pero se arrepiente y le regala el niño a un hombre que conoció en internet. Manuel está preso por violación, pero quiere tener derechos como padre de la niña que nació del abuso.

programme.title: Supernalgatón; Contrato de matrimonio abierto
programme.desc: Martín pide el divorcio, organiza un maratón de caridad y su esposa usa su trasero para recaudar más fondos. Oscar quiere anular el contrato prenupcial que firmó. Vania se embarazó de otro.

programme.title: Licencia por madre subrogada; Niño quiere ver a hermano gay
programme.desc: Natalia acusa a su ex empleada de engañarla, pidió un permiso de maternidad, pero no tuvo ningún niño. Gio demanda a su madre, ella no le permite ver a su hermano mayor porque es homosexual.

programme.title: Esos senos son míos; Terapia orgánica
programme.desc: Julio exige que Sofía le devuelva el dinero que pagó por sus cirugías; ella lo acusa de querer prostituirla. Anabel quiere recuperar la custodia de su hijo; teme por el bienestar del niño.

programme.title: Enano borracho; No resucitar vive
programme.desc: Marie quiere que Rodolfo le devuelva su hijo, él dice que lo hará solo si ella cambia de pareja. Jesús exige una indemnización, Mercedes resucitó a su anciana madre y ahora ella debe cuidarla.

programme.title: Cenizas para facial; Abusada y sin sus hijas
programme.desc: Yamily demanda a su hermano; él pretende invertir las cenizas de su abuela en un novedoso negocio. Susana pierde la custodia de sus hijos, intentó suicidarse por un trauma, fue abusada de niña.

programme.title: Empleadita caliente; Cementerio homófobo
programme.desc: Diana exige que Iván le pague salarios atrasados y reconozca la paternidad de su hijo. David quiere enterrar juntas a su madre y a la esposa de esta, pero la directora del cementerio no lo permite.

programme.title: Boxeador desmemoriado; Ciudadanía en cuestión por droga
programme.desc: Antonella pide ayuda psicológica para su esposo, su trabajo lo convirtió en un hombre violento. Luisa se casa con Javier, él le ofrece los papeles, pero oculta su pasado como narcotraficante.

programme.title: Ébola mortal; Ley en California: Sí significa sí
programme.desc: Miller quiere anular su matrimonio con José, tiene ébola y lo ocultó, además vende su sangre infectada. Luis demanda a su exnovia, ella le complicó la vida al acusarlo de forzarla a tener sexo.

programme.desc: Case 1: The plaintiff paid the defendant for materials to make outfits, but after delays, he demands a refund. Case 2: The plaintiff claims the defendant owes for beverages for a church event, while the defendant argues the church should pay.

programme.title: Jason's Letter
programme.desc: A 12-year-old boy is still grieving from the loss of his best friend, the most recent of many unarmed shooting victims in his small community. After realizing the marches and protests have done nothing, he decides to take matters into his own hands.

programme.title: Janet Jackson: In Control
programme.desc: She may have been the youngest of 10 of the Jackson children, but that did not stop Janet Jackson from embracing her own identity. Her unquestioned talent has built an empire of success as Ms. Janet remains In Control.

programme.title: Rugby Challenge
programme.desc: Warrick attempts to upstage his fellow Man Cavenomineesat the You Spectacular and Siv is pushed to his limits with the U19 Western Cape Rugby Team.

programme.title: Night of the Living Dead
programme.desc: A ragtag group of Pennsylvanians barricade themselves in an old farmhouse to remain safe from a bloodthirsty, flesh-eating breed of monsters who are ravaging the East Coast of the United States.

programme.title: Season Finale
programme.desc: We look back at the best and worst experiences of the season as Bridget and Dene finally come to terms with each other.

programme.title: The Kwa-Zulu Natal Coastline
programme.desc: Bridget and Dene journey the Kwa-Zulu Natal coastline, and while Dene feels at home in the sun and surf, Bridget finds her happiness in a traditional Durban curry.

programme.title: Master Bedroom Challenge
programme.desc: Our design duos get briefed on their fourth challenge, decorating the master bedroom. They collaborate with local designers and meet with their mentors.

programme.title: Bathroom Winner
programme.desc: It is deadline day for the double bathroom challenge, Will the designers manage to finish this mammoth task in time? One duo's bathroom is seen as very controversial. Who will be crowned as the winners of challenge three by our panel of judges?

programme.title: Spare Room Winner
programme.desc: It is deadline day for the second spare room challenge, and things are tense. Will all three duos finish in time? Stay tuned to find out who will be crowned as the winners of challenge two by our panel of judges

programme.title: Bathroom Challenge
programme.desc: Our design duos get briefed on their third challenge, a double room challenge they must decorate both bathrooms. They meet with their mentors to discuss their ideas. Breaking down walls seems to be the trend for this challenge.

programme.title: Paris
programme.desc: Paris, a place where the romantics are as common as the cobblestone streets. There is a new wave of African immigrants and expats, searching for not only the creative and cultural but also the notion of identity.

programme.title: Abidjan
programme.desc: The festival of Urban Music of Anoumabo celebrates 10 years of cultural and artistic brewing, tourism, professional exchanges, training and sharing in Cote d'Ivoire's thriving capital, Abidjan.

programme.title: Lucky Dube
programme.desc: One of South Africa's most-loved reggae artists, Lucky Dube, was murdered in a botched hijacking. Crimes Uncovered delves deeper into exactly what happened on the night South Africa lost a true icon.

programme.title: Sordid Lies: The Cezanne Visser Story
programme.desc: In an enthralling tale that spans two continents Crimes Uncovered follows the story of Cezanne Visser, her partner Dirk Prinsloo and how they callously broke the law and left a trail of broken lives in their wake.

programme.title: The Rise
programme.desc: The first chapter analyses the origins of Afrobeat and its musical evolution. We dig into the history of its creation with Fela Kuti but also with the other music genres related to recent Afrobeats, such as the Nigerian Highlife of the 70s and 80s.

programme.title: The Takeover
programme.desc: Afrobeats continues to grow whilst having a huge influence on pop culture. African superstars now regularly sell out concerts overseas and receive airplay on platforms around the world.

programme.title: Italian Cuisine
programme.desc: Di italiani sono famosi per il loro cibo. And while that may have you lost in translation, it doesn't take a linguist to enjoy linguine, as we dine on some irresistible Italian cuisine.

programme.title: Dancing & Dishes
programme.desc: Janez may not be the greatest dancer, but these Latin American dishes are sure to get your hips moving!
